text:
English Club Wants You!
Do you like English? Do you want to improve your English? Come and join our English Club! We meet every Friday afternoon from 4:00 to 5:30 in Room 302. In the club, you can watch English films, sing English songs and play English games. You can also make friends with other students. If you are interested, please call Mary at 6789-1234 before next Wednesday. Don't miss the chance!
translation: 英语俱乐部招募啦！你喜欢英语吗？你想提高英语水平吗？来加入我们的英语俱乐部吧！我们每周五下午4:00到5:30在302室活动。在俱乐部里，你可以看英文电影、唱英文歌、玩英语游戏。你还可以和其他同学交朋友。如果你感兴趣，请在下周三之前拨打6789-1234联系玛丽。不要错过机会！

questions.stem: When does the English Club meet?
questions.stemZh: 英语俱乐部什么时候活动？
questions.answerText: It meets every Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 根据文中“We meet every Friday afternoon...”可知。

questions.stem: What can students do in the club?
questions.stemZh: 学生们在俱乐部里能做什么？
questions.answerText: They can watch English films, sing English songs and play English games.
questions.explanation: 根据文中“you can watch English films...”可知。

questions.stem: How can you join the club?
questions.stemZh: 你怎样加入俱乐部？
questions.answerText: You can call Mary at 6789-1234.
questions.explanation: 根据最后一句“please call Mary at 6789-1234”可知。

text:
City Library Weekend Activities
Welcome to the City Library! This weekend we have some interesting activities for you. On Saturday morning, there is a story time for children aged 5-10. It starts at 10:00. On Saturday afternoon, you can join a free English corner from 2:00 to 4:00. On Sunday, we will show a science film at 3:00. All the activities are free. You just need to bring your library card. For more information, please visit our website or call 1234-5678.
translation: 市图书馆周末活动。欢迎来到市图书馆！这个周末我们为你准备了一些有趣的活动。周六上午10:00有一场面向5-10岁儿童的故事会。周六下午2:00到4:00可以参加免费英语角。周日下午3:00我们将放映一部科学电影。所有活动均免费，只需带上你的借书证。更多信息请访问我们的网站或致电1234-5678。

questions.stem: Who is the story time for?
questions.stemZh: 故事会是给谁准备的？
questions.answerText: It is for children aged 5-10.
questions.explanation: 根据“a story time for children aged 5-10”可知。

questions.stem: When is the English corner?
questions.stemZh: 英语角在什么时候？
questions.answerText: It is on Saturday afternoon from 2:00 to 4:00.
questions.explanation: 根据“On Saturday afternoon, you can join a free English corner from 2:00 to 4:00.”可知。

questions.stem: What do people need to bring?
questions.stemZh: 人们需要带什么？
questions.answerText: They need to bring their library cards.
questions.explanation: 根据“You just need to bring your library card.”可知。

text: Last Sunday, Li Ming was on his way home. He saw an old man standing by the road. The old man looked worried. Li Ming went up and asked, 'Can I help you?' The old man said he wanted to go to the hospital, but he didn't know the way. Li Ming decided to take him there. They walked for about twenty minutes. The old man thanked Li Ming and said he was very kind. Li Ming felt happy. He thought helping others is a good thing.
translation: 上周日，李明在回家的路上。他看见一位老人站在路边。老人看起来很着急。李明走上前问：“我能帮您吗？”老人说他想去医院，但不知道路。李明决定带他去。他们走了大约二十分钟。老人感谢李明，说他非常善良。李明感到很开心。他认为帮助别人是一件好事。

questions.stem: Where did Li Ming see the old man?
questions.stemZh: 李明在哪里看见那位老人？
questions.answerText: He saw him by the road.
questions.explanation: 根据“He saw an old man standing by the road.”可知。

questions.stem: Where did the old man want to go?
questions.stemZh: 老人想去哪里？
questions.answerText: He wanted to go to the hospital.
questions.explanation: 根据“he wanted to go to the hospital”可知。

questions.stem: How did Li Ming feel after helping the old man?
questions.stemZh: 帮助老人后李明感觉怎样？
questions.answerText: He felt happy.
questions.explanation: 根据“Li Ming felt happy.”可知。

text: Our school sports meeting was held last Friday. It was a sunny day. All the students were excited. There were many events, such as running, jumping and throwing. I took part in the 100-meter race. I ran as fast as I could, but I didn't win. However, I didn't feel sad. My classmates cheered for me and said I did a good job. In the afternoon, our class won the relay race. We were all very happy. The sports meeting was tiring but fun.
translation: 我们学校的运动会上周五举行。那天阳光明媚，所有学生都很兴奋。运动会有许多项目，如跑步、跳远和投掷。我参加了100米赛跑。我尽力跑得很快，但没有赢。不过，我并不难过。同学们为我加油，说我做得很好。下午，我们班赢得了接力赛。我们都很高兴。运动会很累但很有趣。

questions.stem: When was the school sports meeting?
questions.stemZh: 学校运动会什么时候举行？
questions.answerText: It was last Friday.
questions.explanation: 根据“Our school sports meeting was held last Friday.”可知。

questions.stem: What event did the writer take part in?
questions.stemZh: 作者参加了什么项目？
questions.answerText: The writer took part in the 100-meter race.
questions.explanation: 根据“I took part in the 100-meter race.”可知。

questions.stem: How did the writer feel at last?
questions.stemZh: 作者最后感觉怎样？
questions.answerText: The writer felt tired but happy.
questions.explanation: 根据“The sports meeting was tiring but fun.”可知。

text: Sleep is very important for our health. When we sleep, our body can rest and our brain can work better. Most students need about nine hours of sleep every night. But many students stay up late to do homework or play games. This is bad for their health. If you don't get enough sleep, you may feel tired in class. You may also find it hard to remember things. So we should go to bed early and get up early. A good sleep makes us healthy and happy.
translation: 睡眠对我们的健康非常重要。当我们睡觉时，身体可以休息，大脑可以更好地工作。大多数学生每晚需要大约九小时的睡眠。但许多学生熬夜做作业或玩游戏。这对他们的健康有害。如果你睡眠不足，上课可能会感到疲倦，也可能发现很难记住东西。所以我们应该早睡早起。良好的睡眠使我们健康快乐。

questions.stem: Why is sleep important?
questions.stemZh: 为什么睡眠重要？
options: It helps our body rest and brain work better.
optionsZh: 它帮助身体休息、大脑更好地工作。
questions.answerText: It helps our body rest and our brain work better.
questions.explanation: 根据第一句“When we sleep, our body can rest and our brain can work better.”可知。

questions.stem: How many hours of sleep do most students need?
questions.stemZh: 大多数学生需要多少小时睡眠？
questions.answerText: They need about nine hours.
questions.explanation: 根据“Most students need about nine hours of sleep every night.”可知。

questions.stem: What may happen if students don't get enough sleep?
questions.stemZh: 如果学生睡眠不足可能会怎样？
options: They may feel tired in class.
optionsZh: 他们上课可能会感到疲倦。
questions.answerText: They may feel tired in class and find it hard to remember things.
questions.explanation: 根据“you may feel tired in class... hard to remember things.”可知。

text: Bees are very important to us. They help plants grow. When bees fly from flower to flower, they carry pollen. This helps plants make fruits and seeds. Without bees, many plants cannot grow well. But the number of bees is becoming smaller and smaller. Why? Because people use too many chemicals and cut down trees. We should protect bees. We can plant more flowers and stop using harmful chemicals. Let's do something to save the bees.
translation: 蜜蜂对我们非常重要。它们帮助植物生长。当蜜蜂从一朵花飞到另一朵花时，它们携带花粉。这帮助植物结出果实和种子。没有蜜蜂，许多植物无法很好地生长。但蜜蜂的数量正变得越来越少。为什么？因为人们使用太多化学品并砍伐树木。我们应该保护蜜蜂。我们可以种植更多花朵，停止使用有害化学品。让我们做点事情来拯救蜜蜂。

questions.stem: What do bees help plants do?
questions.stemZh: 蜜蜂帮助植物做什么？
questions.answerText: They help plants grow.
questions.explanation: 根据“They help plants grow.”可知。

questions.stem: Why are bees becoming fewer?
questions.stemZh: 为什么蜜蜂越来越少？
options: Because people use too many chemicals and cut down trees.
optionsZh: 因为人们使用太多化学品并砍伐树木。
questions.answerText: Because people use too many chemicals and cut down trees.
questions.explanation: 根据“Because people use too many chemicals and cut down trees.”可知。

questions.stem: What can we do to protect bees?
questions.stemZh: 我们能做什么来保护蜜蜂？
questions.answerText: We can plant more flowers and stop using harmful chemicals.
questions.explanation: 根据“We can plant more flowers and stop using harmful chemicals.”可知。

text: Tea is a traditional drink in China. It has a long history of thousands of years. Chinese people like drinking tea very much. There are many kinds of tea, such as green tea, black tea and white tea. People in different places have different ways of making tea. In some places, people drink tea with milk or sugar. In China, many people drink tea without anything. Tea is not only a drink but also a part of Chinese culture. When friends come, we often make tea for them. Drinking tea can also help us relax.
translation: 茶是中国的传统饮品，有几千年的悠久历史。中国人非常喜欢喝茶。茶有许多种类，如绿茶、红茶和白茶。不同地方的人有不同的泡茶方式。在一些地方，人们喝茶加牛奶或糖。在中国，很多人喝茶什么都不加。茶不仅是一种饮品，也是中国文化的一部分。朋友来访时，我们常为他们泡茶。喝茶还能帮助我们放松。

questions.stem: How long is the history of Chinese tea?
questions.stemZh: 中国茶有多久的历史？
questions.answerText: It has a history of thousands of years.
questions.explanation: 根据“It has a long history of thousands of years.”可知。

questions.stem: What kinds of tea are mentioned?
questions.stemZh: 文中提到了哪些种类的茶？
options: Green tea, black tea and white tea.
questions.answerText: Green tea, black tea and white tea are mentioned.
questions.explanation: 根据“such as green tea, black tea and white tea”可知。

questions.stem: What do Chinese people often do when friends come?
questions.stemZh: 朋友来访时中国人常做什么？
questions.answerText: They often make tea for them.
questions.explanation: 根据“When friends come, we often make tea for them.”可知。

text: The Lantern Festival is a traditional Chinese festival. It comes on the 15th day of the first lunar month. On this day, people eat yuanxiao, a kind of sweet food. They also watch lanterns and guess lantern riddles. In the evening, there are dragon dances and lion dances in many places. Children carry beautiful lanterns and play with their friends. The Lantern Festival is a time for family to get together. It marks the end of the Spring Festival celebrations.
translation: 元宵节是中国的传统节日，在农历正月十五。这一天，人们吃元宵——一种甜食。他们还赏花灯、猜灯谜。晚上，许多地方有舞龙舞狮。孩子们提着漂亮的花灯和朋友们玩耍。元宵节是家人团聚的时刻，它标志着春节庆祝活动的结束。

questions.stem: When is the Lantern Festival?
questions.stemZh: 元宵节在什么时候？
options: On the 1st day of the first lunar month.
On the 15th day of the first lunar month.
On the 15th day of the eighth lunar month.
questions.answerText: It comes on the 15th day of the first lunar month.
questions.explanation: 根据“It comes on the 15th day of the first lunar month.”可知。

questions.stem: What do people eat on this day?
questions.stemZh: 人们在这一天吃什么？
questions.answerText: They eat yuanxiao.
questions.explanation: 根据“people eat yuanxiao”可知。

questions.stem: What does the Lantern Festival mark?
questions.stemZh: 元宵节标志着什么？
options: The beginning of the Spring Festival.
The end of the Spring Festival celebrations.
questions.answerText: It marks the end of the Spring Festival celebrations.
questions.explanation: 根据最后一句可知。

text: Mr. Wang is an English teacher in our school. He is over fifty years old, but he is always full of energy. He has taught English for more than thirty years. His classes are very interesting. He often tells us stories and plays games with us. He is strict with us, but he is also very kind. Once, I was ill and missed his class. He came to my home after school and helped me with my lessons. I was deeply moved. I will never forget him.
translation: 王老师是我们学校的一位英语老师。他五十多岁了，但总是精力充沛。他教英语三十多年了。他的课非常有趣，经常给我们讲故事、和我们做游戏。他对我们很严格，但也非常和善。有一次我生病缺了他的课，他放学后到我家帮我补课。我深受感动。我永远不会忘记他。

questions.stem: What does Mr. Wang teach?
questions.stemZh: 王老师教什么？
questions.answerText: He teaches English.
questions.explanation: 根据“Mr. Wang is an English teacher”可知。

questions.stem: How long has he taught English?
questions.stemZh: 他教英语多久了？
questions.answerText: He has taught English for more than thirty years.
questions.explanation: 根据“He has taught English for more than thirty years.”可知。

questions.stem: What did Mr. Wang do when the writer was ill?
questions.stemZh: 作者生病时王老师做了什么？
options: He visited and helped with lessons.
He gave the writer a gift.
questions.answerText: He came to the writer's home and helped with lessons.
questions.explanation: 根据“He came to my home after school and helped me with my lessons.”可知。

text: Our environment is getting worse and worse. People cut down too many trees and use too many plastic bags. Rivers are polluted. The air is not clean. We must do something to protect the environment. First, we can plant more trees. Trees can make the air clean. Second, we should use cloth bags instead of plastic bags. Third, we can save water and electricity. For example, turn off the lights when we leave a room. Fourth, we can ride bikes or walk to school. These small actions can make a big difference. Let's start from now on.
translation: 我们的环境正变得越来越糟。人们砍伐太多树木，使用太多塑料袋。河流被污染，空气不干净。我们必须做点什么来保护环境。首先，我们可以种更多树，树木能使空气清洁。其次，我们应该用布袋代替塑料袋。第三，我们可以节约用水用电，比如离开房间时关灯。第四，我们可以骑自行车或步行上学。这些小行动能带来大改变。让我们从现在开始。

questions.stem: What problems does the environment have?
questions.stemZh: 环境存在哪些问题？
options: The air is clean and rivers are clear.
People cut down too many trees and use too many plastic bags.
There are too many cloth bags.
optionsZh: 人们砍伐太多树木并使用太多塑料袋。
questions.answerText: People cut down too many trees, use too many plastic bags, rivers are polluted and the air is not clean.
questions.explanation: 根据短文第一、二句可知：人们砍伐树木、使用塑料袋，河流被污染，空气不干净。

questions.stem: What can trees do?
questions.stemZh: 树木能做什么？
options: They can make the air clean.
questions.answerText: They can make the air clean.
questions.explanation: 根据“Trees can make the air clean.”可知。

questions.stem: What should we use instead of plastic bags?
questions.stemZh: 我们应该用什么代替塑料袋？
questions.answerText: We should use cloth bags.
questions.explanation: 根据“we should use cloth bags instead of plastic bags.”可知。

questions.stem: How can we save electricity?
questions.stemZh: 我们怎样节约用电？
options: By turning off the lights when we leave a room.
By keeping the lights on all day.
questions.answerText: We can turn off the lights when we leave a room.
questions.explanation: 根据“For example, turn off the lights when we leave a room.”可知。

questions.stem: How can students go to school to protect the environment?
questions.stemZh: 学生怎样上学来保护环境？
questions.answerText: They can ride bikes or walk to school.
questions.explanation: 根据“we can ride bikes or walk to school.”可知。

text: Hi, I'm Peter. I'm 12 years old. I have a new friend at school. His name is David. David is tall and has short brown hair. He wears glasses. He is from Canada, but now he lives in Beijing with his parents. David is friendly and funny. He often tells us interesting stories after class. We both like playing basketball. After school, we often play basketball on the playground. David is good at maths, but I am good at English. We help each other. I am happy to have a friend like David.
translation: 嗨，我是彼得。我12岁。我在学校有一个新朋友。他叫大卫。大卫个子高，留着棕色短发。他戴眼镜。他来自加拿大，但现在和父母住在北京。大卫友好又风趣。他经常在课后给我们讲有趣的故事。我们都喜欢打篮球。放学后，我们经常在操场上打篮球。大卫擅长数学，但我擅长英语。我们互相帮助。我很高兴有大卫这样的朋友。

questions.stem: Where is David from?
questions.stemZh: 大卫来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文中说“He is from Canada”，因此选A。他现在住在北京，但来自加拿大。

questions.stem: What do Peter and David both like doing?
questions.stemZh: 彼得和大卫都喜欢做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We both like playing basketball”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is David good at?
questions.stemZh: 大卫擅长什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“David is good at maths”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What can we learn about David?
questions.stemZh: 关于大卫我们可以了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 短文描述大卫“friendly and funny”并且“wears glasses”，因此选C。

text: My name is Kate. This is my school. It is not very big, but it is very beautiful. There are three buildings in my school: a teaching building, a library and a dining hall. My classroom is on the second floor of the teaching building. There is a big playground in front of the teaching building. We do morning exercises there every day. The library is next to the teaching building. I often read books there after class. The dining hall is behind the library. We have lunch there.
translation: 我叫凯特。这是我的学校。它不是很大，但非常漂亮。我的学校有三栋楼：一栋教学楼、一个图书馆和一个食堂。我的教室在教学楼的二楼。教学楼前面有一个大操场。我们每天在那里做早操。图书馆在教学楼旁边。我经常课后在那里看书。食堂在图书馆后面。我们在那里吃午饭。

questions.stem: How many buildings are there in Kate's school?
questions.stemZh: 凯特的学校有几栋楼？
questions.answerText: Three. / There are three buildings.
questions.explanation: 短文说“There are three buildings in my school”，因此参考答案为“Three.”或“There are three buildings.”。

questions.stem: Where is Kate's classroom?
questions.stemZh: 凯特的教室在哪里？
questions.answerText: It is on the second floor of the teaching building.
questions.explanation: 短文说“My classroom is on the second floor of the teaching building”，因此参考答案为该句。

questions.stem: What does Kate often do after class?
questions.stemZh: 凯特课后经常做什么？
questions.answerText: She often reads books in the library.
questions.explanation: 短文说“I often read books there after class”，there指图书馆，因此参考答案为“She often reads books in the library.”。

questions.stem: Where do students have lunch?
questions.stemZh: 学生们在哪里吃午饭？
questions.answerText: In the dining hall.
questions.explanation: 短文说“The dining hall is behind the library. We have lunch there”，因此参考答案为“In the dining hall.”。

text: There are many rules in my family. I have to get up at six thirty every morning. I must make my bed before breakfast. After school, I have to finish my homework first. I can't watch TV before that. I can only play computer games for half an hour on weekends. I have to go to bed before ten o'clock. At first, I didn't like these rules. But now I understand them. They help me form good habits and use time well. Rules are not always bad.
translation: 我家有很多规则。我每天早上必须六点半起床。我必须在早饭前整理床铺。放学后，我必须先完成作业。在那之前我不能看电视。周末我只能玩半小时电脑游戏。我必须在十点前上床睡觉。起初，我不喜欢这些规则。但现在我理解它们了。它们帮助我养成好习惯，好好利用时间。规则并不总是坏的。

questions.stem: What does the writer have to do before breakfast?
questions.stemZh: 作者早饭前必须做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I must make my bed before breakfast”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How long can the writer play computer games on weekends?
questions.stemZh: 作者周末可以玩多长时间电脑游戏？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I can only play computer games for half an hour on weekends”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How did the writer feel about the rules at first?
questions.stemZh: 作者起初对这些规则感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文说“At first, I didn't like these rules”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer think of the rules now?
questions.stemZh: 作者现在怎么看待这些规则？
options: They help him form good habits.
optionsZh: 它们帮助他养成好习惯。
questions.explanation: 短文说“They help me form good habits and use time well”，因此选B。

text: Keeping fit is important for teenagers. How can we keep fit? First, do exercise every day. You can run, swim or play ball games. Exercise makes your body strong. Second, eat healthy food. Eat more fruit and vegetables, and drink enough water. Don't eat too much junk food. Third, get enough sleep. Teenagers need about nine hours of sleep every night. Fourth, keep a good mood. Talk to your friends or parents when you feel stressed. If you follow these tips, you will be healthier and happier.
translation: 保持健康对青少年很重要。我们怎样保持健康？首先，每天锻炼。你可以跑步、游泳或打球。运动使你的身体强壮。其次，吃健康的食物。多吃水果和蔬菜，喝足够的水。不要吃太多垃圾食品。第三，获得充足的睡眠。青少年每晚需要大约九小时的睡眠。第四，保持良好的心情。当你感到压力时，和朋友或父母谈谈。如果你遵循这些建议，你会更健康、更快乐。

questions.stem: How many tips does the passage give?
questions.stemZh: 短文给出了几条建议？
questions.explanation: 短文列出了四条建议：锻炼、健康饮食、充足睡眠和保持好心情，因此选C。

questions.stem: How long should teenagers sleep every night according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，青少年每晚应该睡多久？

questions.stemZh: 当你感到压力时应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Talk to your friends or parents when you feel stressed”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.stemZh: 这篇文章主要关于什么？
questions.explanation: 短文开头提出“How can we keep fit?”，然后从运动、饮食、睡眠和心情四个方面给出建议，因此选B。

text: Last summer, Tina went to a small village with her parents. They stayed there for a week. The village was quiet and beautiful. There was a river and many green hills around it. Tina's grandparents lived there. Every morning, Tina got up early and went for a walk with her grandfather. They walked along the river and watched the birds. In the afternoon, Tina helped her grandmother pick vegetables in the garden. In the evening, the family sat outside and talked. Tina didn't use her phone for a whole week. She felt relaxed and happy. She hopes to go back next summer.
translation: 去年夏天，蒂娜和父母去了一个小村庄。他们在那里待了一周。村庄安静而美丽。村庄周围有一条河和许多绿色的山丘。蒂娜的祖父母住在那里。每天早上，蒂娜早起和祖父去散步。他们沿着河边走，看鸟。下午，蒂娜帮祖母在花园里摘蔬菜。晚上，一家人坐在外面聊天。蒂娜整整一周没有用手机。她感到放松和快乐。她希望明年夏天再回去。

questions.stem: Who did Tina go for a walk with every morning?
questions.stemZh: 蒂娜每天早上和谁去散步？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Tina got up early and went for a walk with her grandfather”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What did Tina help her grandmother do?
questions.stemZh: 蒂娜帮祖母做了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Tina helped her grandmother pick vegetables in the garden”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How long did Tina stay in the village?
questions.stemZh: 蒂娜在村庄待了多久？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They stayed there for a week”，因此选C。

questions.stem: How did Tina feel after the trip?
questions.stemZh: 旅行后蒂娜感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文说“She felt relaxed and happy”，因此选B。

text: Food is not just something we eat. It also carries memories and feelings. Many people have a special dish that reminds them of home or family. For example, a bowl of noodles may remind you of your grandmother's kitchen. The smell of dumplings may bring back memories of the Spring Festival. Cooking is a way to show love. When parents cook for their children, they put their care into the food. Family recipes are often passed down from generation to generation. They connect us with our past and with the people we love.
translation: 食物不仅仅是我们吃的东西。它还承载着记忆和情感。许多人有一道特别的菜，能让他们想起家或家人。例如，一碗面条可能让你想起祖母的厨房。饺子的香味可能唤起春节的回忆。烹饪是表达爱的一种方式。当父母为孩子做饭时，他们把关怀放进食物里。家庭食谱常常代代相传。它们把我们与过去以及我们爱的人联系起来。

questions.stem: What does food carry besides taste according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，食物除了味道还承载着什么？
questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“It also carries memories and feelings”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What may the smell of dumplings remind people of?
questions.stemZh: 饺子的香味可能让人们想起什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The smell of dumplings may bring back memories of the Spring Festival”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How does the writer describe cooking?
questions.stemZh: 作者如何描述烹饪？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Cooking is a way to show love”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.stemZh: 这篇文章的主旨是什么？
options: Food connects us with memories, feelings and loved ones.
optionsZh: 食物把我们与记忆、情感和爱的人联系起来。
questions.explanation: 短文围绕食物承载记忆、表达爱和连接家人展开，最后说“They connect us with our past and with the people we love”，因此选C。

text:
NOTICE
Dear students,
We are going to have an English Corner this Friday. The topic is "How to Make Small Talk." Small talk is a short and friendly conversation about simple things, like the weather or sports. It can help you make new friends and feel more confident. Here is the plan:
2:00 p.m. – 2:30 p.m.: Learn useful expressions for small talk.
2:30 p.m. – 3:30 p.m.: Talk with your partners in groups.
3:30 p.m. – 4:00 p.m.: Share your ideas with the whole group.
Place: Room 305, Green Building.
Please come on time and bring a notebook.
The English Club
translation:
通知
亲爱的同学们：
我们本周五将举办英语角。主题是“如何闲聊”。闲聊是关于简单事情（如天气或运动）的简短友好的对话。它可以帮助你交新朋友，感到更自信。计划如下：
下午2:00–2:30：学习闲聊的有用表达。
下午2:30–3:30：分组与搭档交谈。
下午3:30–4:00：与全组分享你的想法。
地点：绿色楼305室。
请准时到达并带一个笔记本。
英语俱乐部

questions.stem: What is the topic of the English Corner?
questions.stemZh: 英语角的主题是什么？
questions.explanation: 通知中明确说“The topic is "How to Make Small Talk."”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How long will the group talk last?
questions.stemZh: 小组交谈将持续多长时间？
questions.explanation: 通知中“2:30 p.m. – 3:30 p.m.: Talk with your partners in groups”，时长为一小时，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where will the English Corner be held?
questions.stemZh: 英语角将在哪里举行？
questions.explanation: 通知中写明“Place: Room 305, Green Building”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should students bring?
questions.stemZh: 学生应该带什么？
questions.explanation: 通知最后说“Please come on time and bring a notebook”，因此选B。

text: Students today often feel stressed because of schoolwork and exams. How can we relax? Here are some ways. First, do something you enjoy. Listen to music, draw a picture or play a sport. Doing fun things helps you forget your worries for a while. Second, talk to someone you trust. Sharing your feelings with a friend or a parent can make you feel better. Third, take a short break. Go for a walk or look out of the window. Fresh air and a change of scene can clear your mind. Finally, remember that it is OK not to be perfect. Everyone makes mistakes. Be kind to yourself.
translation: 如今的学生常常因为学业和考试感到压力。我们怎样放松？这里有一些方法。首先，做一些你喜欢的事情。听音乐、画画或做运动。做有趣的事情帮助你暂时忘记烦恼。其次，和你信任的人谈谈。与朋友或父母分享你的感受可以让你感觉好一些。第三，短暂休息一下。去散步或看看窗外。新鲜空气和场景的变化可以让你头脑清醒。最后，记住不完美也没关系。每个人都会犯错。对自己好一点。

questions.stemZh: 根据短文，如今的学生为什么常常感到压力？
questions.answerText: Because of schoolwork and exams.
questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“Students today often feel stressed because of schoolwork and exams”，因此参考答案为“Because of schoolwork and exams.”。

questions.answerText: Someone you trust, like a friend or a parent.
questions.explanation: 短文说“talk to someone you trust. Sharing your feelings with a friend or a parent can make you feel better”，因此参考答案为“Someone you trust, like a friend or a parent.”。

questions.explanation: 短文最后说“Everyone makes mistakes. Be kind to yourself”，因此参考答案为“Everyone makes mistakes, and it is OK not to be perfect.”。

text: Reading has always been a big part of my life. When I was young, my mother read bedtime stories to me every night. My favourite book was about a little girl and her dog. I loved the adventures they had together. As I grew older, I started to read on my own. I read storybooks, science books and history books. Reading opened a new world to me. It taught me about people and places I had never seen. Now I read for at least half an hour every day. I hope I can pass my love of reading on to my children one day.
translation: 阅读一直是我生活的重要组成部分。小时候，妈妈每晚给我读睡前故事。我最喜欢的书是关于一个小女孩和她的狗。我喜欢他们一起经历的冒险。长大后，我开始自己读书。我读故事书、科学书和历史书。阅读向我打开了一个新世界。它教会我关于我从未见过的人和地方的事情。现在我每天至少读半小时。我希望有一天我能把对阅读的热爱传给我的孩子。

questions.stem: Who read bedtime stories to the writer when he was young?
questions.stemZh: 作者小时候谁给他读睡前故事？
questions.explanation: 短文说“my mother read bedtime stories to me every night”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What was the writer's favourite book about?
questions.stemZh: 作者最喜欢的书是关于什么的？
options: A little girl and her dog.
optionsZh: 一位科学家和他的发明。
questions.explanation: 短文说“My favourite book was about a little girl and her dog”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How long does the writer read every day now?
questions.stemZh: 作者现在每天读多长时间？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Now I read for at least half an hour every day”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer hope to do one day?
questions.stemZh: 作者希望有一天做什么？
options: Pass his love of reading on to his children.
optionsZh: 把对阅读的热爱传给他的孩子。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“I hope I can pass my love of reading on to my children one day”，因此选C。

text: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a special time for family reunion in China. It falls on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month, when the moon is brightest and roundest. On this night, family members get together, eat mooncakes and admire the moon. Mooncakes are round, just like the full moon. They are a symbol of reunion and happiness. There is also a beautiful story about Chang'e, a woman who flew to the moon and has lived there ever since. People tell this story to children year after year. The festival is not only about food and stories; it is about being with the people we love.
translation: 中秋节在中国是家庭团聚的特殊时刻。它在农历八月十五，那时月亮最亮最圆。这天晚上，家人聚在一起，吃月饼，赏月。月饼是圆的，就像满月。它们是团圆和幸福的象征。还有一个关于嫦娥的美丽故事，一个飞上月亮并一直住在那里女子。人们年复一年地给孩子们讲这个故事。这个节日不仅仅是关于食物和故事；它是关于和我们爱的人在一起。

questions.stem: When is the Mid-Autumn Festival?
questions.stemZh: 中秋节是什么时候？
options: On the 1st day of the 1st lunar month.
On the 15th day of the 8th lunar month.
On the 5th day of the 5th lunar month.
On the 15th day of the 1st lunar month.
questions.explanation: 短文说“It falls on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What do mooncakes symbolize?
questions.stemZh: 月饼象征什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They are a symbol of reunion and happiness”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Who is Chang'e?
questions.stemZh: 嫦娥是谁？
options: A woman who flew to the moon.
A man who shot the suns.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Chang'e, a woman who flew to the moon”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is the festival really about according to the writer?
questions.stemZh: 根据作者，这个节日真正是关于什么的？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“it is about being with the people we love”，因此选C。

text: I used to be a very shy girl. I was afraid to speak in class because I thought my classmates would laugh at me. I had only one or two friends. But in Grade 8, something changed. Our teacher asked us to work in groups. I had to talk with my group members to finish the task. At first, I was nervous. But my group members were kind and patient. They listened to me and encouraged me. Slowly, I became more confident. Now I can speak in front of the whole class without feeling afraid. I have also made many new friends. I learned that being brave doesn't mean you are not afraid; it means you don't let fear stop you.
translation: 我曾经是一个非常害羞的女孩。我不敢在课堂上发言，因为我认为同学会嘲笑我。我只有一两个朋友。但在八年级，一些事情改变了。老师让我们分组学习。我不得不与小组成员交谈来完成任务。起初，我很紧张。但我的小组成员善良又有耐心。他们听我说，鼓励我。慢慢地，我变得更自信了。现在我可以当着全班的面发言而不感到害怕。我也交了许多新朋友。我学到勇敢并不意味着你不害怕；它意味着你不让恐惧阻止你。

questions.stem: Why was the writer afraid to speak in class?
questions.stemZh: 作者为什么不敢在课堂上发言？
options: She thought classmates would laugh at her.
questions.explanation: 短文说“I was afraid to speak in class because I thought my classmates would laugh at me”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What changed the writer in Grade 8?
questions.stemZh: 八年级时什么改变了作者？
options: She moved to a new school.
She had to work in groups and talk with others.
She read a book about confidence.
optionsZh: 她不得不分组学习并与他人交谈。
她读了一本关于自信的书。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Our teacher asked us to work in groups. I had to talk with my group members”，这促使她开始改变，因此选C。

questions.stem: How did the writer's group members help her?
questions.stemZh: 作者的小组成员如何帮助她？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They listened to me and encouraged me”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What does the writer mean by "being brave"?
questions.stemZh: 作者所说的“勇敢”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“being brave doesn't mean you are not afraid; it means you don't let fear stop you”，因此选B。

text: Many everyday objects are made from materials we can find in nature. Glass is made from sand. Paper is made from wood. Cotton clothes are made from plants. But some materials are man-made. Plastic is one of them. It is made from oil. Plastic is cheap, light and useful. We use it to make bottles, bags, toys and many other things. However, plastic causes problems for the environment. It does not break down easily. It can stay in the ground or in the sea for hundreds of years. That is why many people are trying to use less plastic.
translation: 许多日常物品是由我们可以在自然界找到的材料制成的。玻璃由沙子制成。纸由木材制成。棉衣服由植物制成。但有些材料是人造的。塑料就是其中之一。它由石油制成。塑料便宜、轻便、有用。我们用它来制作瓶子、袋子、玩具和许多其他东西。然而，塑料对环境造成问题。它不容易分解。它可以在土壤或海洋中留存数百年。这就是为什么许多人正在努力少用塑料。

questions.stem: What is glass made from?
questions.stemZh: 玻璃是由什么制成的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Glass is made from sand”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is plastic made from?
questions.stemZh: 塑料是由什么制成的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Plastic is one of them. It is made from oil”，因此选C。

questions.stem: Why is plastic bad for the environment?
questions.stemZh: 为什么塑料对环境有害？
options: It does not break down easily.
questions.explanation: 短文说“It does not break down easily”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What are many people trying to do?
questions.stemZh: 许多人正在努力做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“many people are trying to use less plastic”，因此选B。

text: Last Saturday, I planned to meet my friend at the library at 2 p.m. I left home early, but on the way, my bike broke down. I tried to fix it, but I couldn't. I had to walk to the library. When I finally got there, it was 2:30. My friend was waiting outside. I said sorry, but she smiled and said, "It's OK. I know you always try to be on time." We went in and studied together for two hours. Later, we had ice cream and talked about our week. The day didn't start well, but it ended happily.
translation: 上周六，我计划下午两点在图书馆和我的朋友见面。我很早就离开了家，但路上我的自行车坏了。我试图修理它，但修不好。我不得不步行去图书馆。当我最终到达那里时，已经两点半了。我的朋友在外面等着。我说了对不起，但她笑着说：“没关系。我知道你总是尽量准时。”我们进去一起学习了两个小时。后来，我们吃了冰淇淋，聊了聊我们这一周。这一天开始得不太顺利，但结束得很愉快。

questions.stem: Where did the writer plan to meet her friend?
questions.stemZh: 作者计划在哪里和朋友见面？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I planned to meet my friend at the library at 2 p.m.”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why was the writer late?
questions.stemZh: 作者为什么迟到了？
options: Her bike broke down and she had to walk.
She went to the wrong place.
optionsZh: 她的自行车坏了，她不得不步行。
questions.explanation: 短文说“my bike broke down... I had to walk to the library”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How did the friend react when the writer said sorry?
questions.stemZh: 作者道歉时朋友如何反应？
questions.explanation: 短文说朋友“smiled and said, "It's OK."”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How did the day end?
questions.stemZh: 这一天如何结束？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“The day didn't start well, but it ended happily”，因此选B。

text: As we leave school, it is a good time to look back on the past three years. I remember the first day of Grade 7. We were all nervous and didn't know each other. Now we are like a family. I remember the school sports meeting. Our class worked together and won the relay race. I remember the teachers who helped me when I was struggling with maths. They never gave up on me. I also remember the small moments: laughing in the classroom, sharing snacks, and walking home together. These memories will stay with me forever. I wish all my classmates the best in the future.
translation: 当我们离开学校时，回顾过去的三年是一个好时机。我记得七年级的第一天。我们都很紧张，彼此不认识。现在我们就像一家人。我记得学校运动会。我们班齐心协力，赢得了接力赛。我记得那些在我数学学习困难时帮助我的老师。他们从未放弃我。我也记得那些小瞬间：在教室里大笑、分享零食、一起走路回家。这些记忆将永远伴随着我。我祝愿所有同学未来一切顺利。

questions.stem: How did the students feel on the first day of Grade 7?
questions.stemZh: 七年级第一天学生们感觉如何？
questions.answerText: They felt nervous and didn't know each other.
questions.explanation: 短文说“We were all nervous and didn't know each other”，因此参考答案为“They felt nervous and didn't know each other.”。

questions.stem: What did the writer's class win at the sports meeting?
questions.stemZh: 作者的班级在运动会上赢得了什么？
questions.answerText: The relay race.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Our class worked together and won the relay race”，因此参考答案为“The relay race.”。

questions.stem: What did the teachers do when the writer struggled with maths?
questions.stemZh: 作者数学学习困难时老师做了什么？
questions.answerText: They helped the writer and never gave up on him/her.
questions.explanation: 短文说“the teachers who helped me when I was struggling with maths. They never gave up on me”，因此参考答案为“They helped the writer and never gave up on him/her.”。

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.stemZh: 这篇文章主要关于什么？
questions.answerText: The writer's memories of the past three years at school.
questions.explanation: 短文以“look back on the past three years”开头，回忆了七年级第一天、运动会、老师和日常瞬间，主旨是回顾三年的学校记忆，因此参考答案为“The writer's memories of the past three years at school.”。

text: Hello, everyone! My name is Li Hua. I'm a new student at Sunshine Middle School. Today is my first day here. I meet a boy at the school gate. He says, "Hello! I'm Tom. Nice to meet you!" I smile and say, "Hi, Tom. I'm Li Hua. Nice to meet you, too." Tom is friendly. He shows me the way to my classroom. In the classroom, our teacher, Ms. Wang, asks us to introduce ourselves. I stand up and say, "Hello, class! I'm Li Hua. I like playing basketball and reading books. I hope we can be good friends." Everyone claps. I feel very happy.
translation: 大家好！我叫李华。我是阳光中学的一名新生。今天是我在这里的第一天。我在校门口遇到一个男孩。他说：“你好！我是汤姆。很高兴见到你！”我微笑着说：“嗨，汤姆。我是李华。我也很高兴见到你。”汤姆很友好。他给我指了去教室的路。在教室里，我们的老师王老师让我们自我介绍。我站起来说：“同学们好！我是李华。我喜欢打篮球和读书。我希望我们能成为好朋友。”大家鼓掌。我感到非常开心。

questions.stem: Where does Li Hua meet Tom?
questions.stemZh: 李华在哪里遇到汤姆？
questions.explanation: 根据短文第二句“I meet a boy at the school gate”可知，李华是在校门口遇到汤姆的，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does Li Hua like doing?
questions.stemZh: 李华喜欢做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文中李华自我介绍时说“I like playing basketball and reading books”，直接给出了答案，因此选C。

questions.stem: How does Li Hua feel at the end of the story?
questions.stemZh: 故事结尾李华感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文最后一句是“I feel very happy”，说明李华在介绍完自己并得到大家掌声后感到很开心，因此选D。

questions.stem: What is the best title for the passage?
questions.stemZh: 这篇文章最好的标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文主要讲述了李华作为新生第一天的经历，包括在校门口遇到汤姆、被老师要求自我介绍等，整体围绕“第一天上学的经历”展开，因此“My First Day at School”最贴切。

text: Keeping our things tidy is important. A tidy desk helps us find our books and pens quickly. How can we keep tidy? First, put your school things in the right places. Books can go on the shelf, and pens can go in the pencil box. Second, clean your desk every day after school. Don't leave rubbish on it. Third, make a habit of putting things back after using them. If you follow these simple steps, your room and your desk will always look nice. A tidy place also makes us feel good and helps us study better.
translation: 保持物品整洁很重要。整洁的书桌能帮助我们快速找到书本和钢笔。我们怎样保持整洁呢？首先，把学习用品放在正确的位置。书可以放在书架上，钢笔可以放进铅笔盒里。其次，每天放学后清理书桌。不要把垃圾留在上面。第三，养成用完东西后放回原处的习惯。如果你遵循这些简单的步骤，你的房间和书桌就会一直看起来很棒。整洁的环境也让我们感觉良好，帮助我们更好地学习。

questions.stem: Why is a tidy desk important according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，为什么整洁的书桌很重要？
options: It makes the classroom look bigger.
It helps us find things quickly.
It helps us make more friends.
optionsZh: 它帮助我们快速找到东西。
它帮助我们交更多朋友。
questions.explanation: 短文第二句明确指出“A tidy desk helps us find our books and pens quickly”，即整洁的书桌帮助我们快速找到物品，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where should pens go according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，钢笔应该放在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文中说“pens can go in the pencil box”，明确指出了钢笔应该放在铅笔盒里，因此选C。

questions.stem: What should you do after using things?
questions.stemZh: 用完东西后你应该怎么做？
questions.explanation: 短文提到的第三个建议是“make a habit of putting things back after using them”，即用完东西后要放回原处，因此选C。

questions.stem: The passage is mainly about ______.
questions.stemZh: 这篇文章主要关于______。
options: why we should buy school things
optionsZh: 为什么我们应该买学习用品
questions.explanation: 短文开头点明“Keeping our things tidy is important”，随后给出三条保持整洁的具体建议，全文围绕“如何保持整洁”展开，因此选C。

text: Welcome to Green Farm! Come and have fun here. You can see many animals: cows, sheep, chickens and ducks. You can also pick fresh vegetables and fruit. Opening time: 9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. every day. Tickets: Adults (成年人) $10; Children (aged 6–12) $5; Children under 6: free. Please do not feed the animals. For more information, call 555-0123.
translation: 欢迎来到绿野农场！来这里尽情玩耍吧。你可以看到许多动物：奶牛、绵羊、鸡和鸭子。你还可以采摘新鲜的蔬菜和水果。开放时间：每天上午9点至下午5点。门票：成人10美元；6至12岁儿童5美元；6岁以下儿童免费。请勿喂食动物。如需更多信息，请致电555-0123。

questions.stem: What can visitors do on Green Farm?
questions.stemZh: 游客在绿野农场可以做什么？
questions.explanation: 广告中明确提到“You can also pick fresh vegetables and fruit”，而喂动物是被禁止的（“Please do not feed the animals”），因此选C。

questions.stem: How much should a 10-year-old child pay?
questions.stemZh: 一个10岁的孩子应该付多少钱？
questions.explanation: 10岁属于“Children (aged 6–12)”，票价为$5，因此选B。

questions.stem: When can you visit Green Farm?
questions.stemZh: 你什么时候可以参观绿野农场？
questions.explanation: 开放时间是“9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.”，上午10点在这个范围内，因此选C。

questions.stem: What is the text?
questions.stemZh: 这段文字是什么？
questions.explanation: 文字以“Welcome to Green Farm!”开头，介绍了活动、票价和开放时间，并提供了联系电话，具有明显的广告性质，因此选B。

text: Making new friends at school is not hard if you follow some simple tips. First, don't be shy. Say hello to your classmates and smile. A smile makes people feel warm. Second, ask questions. You can ask, "What's your favourite subject?" or "Do you like sports?" Questions show that you care. Third, share something about yourself. Tell them your name, your hobby, or something interesting. Finally, be a good listener. When your classmates talk, listen carefully. If you do these things, you will soon make new friends and have a good time at school.
translation: 在学校交新朋友并不难，只要你遵循一些简单的建议。首先，不要害羞。向同学问好并微笑。微笑让人感到温暖。其次，问问题。你可以问：“你最喜欢的科目是什么？”或者“你喜欢运动吗？”问题表明你关心对方。第三，分享一些关于你自己的事情。告诉他们你的名字、爱好或有趣的事情。最后，做一个好的倾听者。当同学说话时，认真听。如果你做到这些，你很快就会交到新朋友，在学校过得愉快。

questions.stem: What should you do first when making new friends?
questions.stemZh: 交新朋友时你首先应该做什么？
options: Don't be shy and say hello.
questions.explanation: 短文列出的第一条建议是“First, don't be shy. Say hello to your classmates and smile”，因此选C。

questions.stem: Why should you ask questions according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，为什么要问问题？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Questions show that you care”，即问问题能表明你关心对方，因此选A。

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a tip?
questions.stemZh: 以下哪一项不是短文中提到的建议？
questions.explanation: 短文中提到了微笑、问问题、分享自己、认真倾听，但没有提到“带礼物”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the passage?
questions.stemZh: 这篇文章的主要目的是什么？
options: To tell a story about school life.
To give advice on making friends.
optionsZh: 讲述一个关于学校生活的故事。
描述一位最喜欢的老师。
questions.explanation: 短文开头说“Making new friends at school is not hard if you follow some simple tips”，然后列出了几条具体建议，目的是给读者提供交朋友的方法，因此选B。

text: My name is Jenny. I have a big and happy family. There are six people in my family: my grandparents, my parents, my little brother and me. My grandfather likes reading newspapers. My grandmother is good at cooking. She often makes delicious cakes for us. My father is a doctor. He works in a hospital near our home. My mother is a teacher. She teaches English at a primary school. My little brother is only five years old. He likes playing with toys. We often have dinner together and talk about our day. I love my family very much.
translation: 我叫珍妮。我有一个大家庭，很幸福。我家有六口人：我的祖父母、我的父母、我的小弟弟和我。我的祖父喜欢看报纸。我的祖母擅长做饭。她经常给我们做美味的蛋糕。我的父亲是一名医生。他在我们家附近的一家医院工作。我的母亲是一名老师。她在一所小学教英语。我的小弟弟只有五岁。他喜欢玩玩具。我们经常一起吃晚饭，谈论我们的一天。我非常爱我的家人。

questions.stem: How many people are there in Jenny's family?
questions.stemZh: 珍妮家有几口人？
questions.explanation: 短文明说“There are six people in my family”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What does Jenny's grandmother like doing?
questions.stemZh: 珍妮的祖母喜欢做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“My grandmother is good at cooking”，因此选B。A是祖父的爱好，C是弟弟的爱好，D是母亲的职业。

questions.stem: What is Jenny's father's job?
questions.stemZh: 珍妮的父亲的职业是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文中说“My father is a doctor”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What do the family often do together?
questions.stemZh: 这家人经常一起做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文提到“We often have dinner together and talk about our day”，因此选B。

text: My school is not very big, but it is beautiful. There are three buildings in my school: a teaching building, a library and a dining hall. The teaching building has four floors. My classroom is on the second floor. In front of the teaching building, there is a big playground. We do morning exercises and play sports there. The library is next to the teaching building. It has many interesting books. I often read there after class. The dining hall is behind the library. We have lunch there. I like my school because it is clean and my teachers and classmates are friendly.
translation: 我的学校不是很大，但很漂亮。我的学校有三栋楼：一栋教学楼、一个图书馆和一个食堂。教学楼有四层。我的教室在二楼。教学楼前面有一个大操场。我们在那里做早操和进行体育运动。图书馆在教学楼旁边。它有许多有趣的书。我经常课后在那里看书。食堂在图书馆后面。我们在那里吃午饭。我喜欢我的学校，因为它很干净，而且我的老师和同学都很友好。

questions.stem: Where is the library?
questions.stemZh: 图书馆在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The library is next to the teaching building”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer often do after class?
questions.stemZh: 作者课后经常做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文提到“I often read there after class”，“there”指代图书馆，因此选C。

questions.stem: Which building has four floors?
questions.stemZh: 哪栋楼有四层？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The teaching building has four floors”，因此选C。

questions.stem: Why does the writer like the school?
questions.stemZh: 作者为什么喜欢这所学校？
options: Because it has a long history.
Because it is clean and people are friendly.
Because it is near the writer's home.
optionsZh: 因为它干净，而且人们很友好。
questions.explanation: 短文最后一句说“I like my school because it is clean and my teachers and classmates are friendly”，因此选C。

text: Different students like different subjects. Amy's favourite subject is English. She thinks it is interesting and useful. She often listens to English songs and watches English cartoons. Tom likes maths best. He says maths is like a game and he enjoys solving problems. Jack's favourite subject is PE. He loves playing basketball and running. He thinks PE classes are relaxing. As for me, I like history. I can learn about the past and many great people. I think every subject is important, and we should work hard at all of them.
translation: 不同的学生喜欢不同的科目。艾米最喜欢的科目是英语。她认为它有趣又有用。她经常听英文歌曲和看英语动画片。汤姆最喜欢数学。他说数学就像游戏，他喜欢解决问题。杰克最喜欢的科目是体育。他喜欢打篮球和跑步。他认为体育课令人放松。至于我，我喜欢历史。我可以了解过去和许多伟大的人物。我认为每个科目都很重要，我们应该努力学好所有科目。

questions.stem: What is Amy's favourite subject?
questions.stemZh: 艾米最喜欢的科目是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文第二句说“Amy's favourite subject is English”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why does Tom like maths?
questions.stemZh: 汤姆为什么喜欢数学？
questions.explanation: 短文说汤姆“enjoys solving problems”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What does Jack love doing?
questions.stemZh: 杰克喜欢做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“He loves playing basketball and running”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What does the writer think of all the subjects?
questions.stemZh: 作者认为所有科目怎么样？
questions.explanation: 短文最后一句说“I think every subject is important”，因此选B。

text: Do you want to join a school club? Here are three clubs for you. The Music Club meets on Monday afternoons. You can learn to sing and play the guitar. The Sports Club meets on Wednesday afternoons. You can play basketball and football. The Reading Club meets on Friday afternoons. You can share your favourite books with others. If you are interested, please come to Room 201 and fill in a form.
translation: 你想加入学校社团吗？这里有三个社团供你选择。音乐社团在周一下午活动。你可以学习唱歌和弹吉他。体育社团在周三下午活动。你可以打篮球和踢足球。阅读社团在周五下午活动。你可以和其他人分享你最喜欢的书。如果你感兴趣，请到201室填写一张表格。

questions.stem: When does the Music Club meet?
questions.stemZh: 音乐社团什么时候活动？
questions.explanation: 广告中明确说“The Music Club meets on Monday afternoons”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What can you do in the Sports Club?
questions.stemZh: 你在体育社团可以做什么？
questions.explanation: 广告中关于体育社团的描述是“You can play basketball and football”，因此选C。

questions.stem: Where should you go if you want to join a club?
questions.stemZh: 如果你想加入社团，应该去哪里？
questions.explanation: 广告最后说“please come to Room 201 and fill in a form”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is the text mainly about?
questions.stemZh: 这段文字主要关于什么？
questions.explanation: 文字开头说“Do you want to join a school club?”，然后介绍了三个社团的活动时间和内容，因此主要关于学校社团，选B。

text: I am Mike. I usually get up at six thirty in the morning. Then I wash my face and brush my teeth. At seven o'clock, I have breakfast. I often have bread and milk. I go to school at seven thirty. Classes begin at eight. I have four classes in the morning and two in the afternoon. I have lunch at school at twelve o'clock. After school, I often play football with my friends. I go home at five. In the evening, I do my homework and have dinner with my family. I go to bed at nine thirty. This is my day.
translation: 我是迈克。我通常早上六点半起床。然后我洗脸刷牙。七点我吃早饭。我经常吃面包喝牛奶。我七点半去上学。八点开始上课。我上午有四节课，下午有两节课。我十二点在学校吃午饭。放学后，我经常和朋友们踢足球。我五点回家。晚上，我做作业，和家人一起吃晚饭。我九点半上床睡觉。这就是我的一天。

questions.stem: What time does Mike get up?
questions.stemZh: 迈克几点起床？
questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“I usually get up at six thirty in the morning”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How many classes does Mike have in a day?
questions.stemZh: 迈克一天有几节课？
questions.explanation: 迈克上午有四节课，下午有两节课，总共六节，因此选C。

questions.stem: What does Mike often do after school?
questions.stemZh: 迈克放学后经常做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“After school, I often play football with my friends”，因此选B。

questions.stem: When does Mike go to bed?
questions.stemZh: 迈克什么时候上床睡觉？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“I go to bed at nine thirty”，因此选C。

text: It is October 12th. It is my birthday. My parents have a birthday party for me at home. My friends come to the party. They give me some nice presents. Lily gives me a storybook. Tom gives me a basketball. Anna gives me a birthday card. The card says, "Happy birthday, Jack! Best wishes!" My mother makes a big cake. There are twelve candles on it. I make a wish and blow out the candles. We sing songs, play games and eat cake. We have a great time. I am very happy.
translation: 今天是10月12日。是我的生日。我的父母在家为我举办了一个生日聚会。我的朋友们来参加聚会。他们送给我一些精美的礼物。莉莉送给我一本故事书。汤姆送给我一个篮球。安娜送给我一张生日贺卡。卡片上写着：“生日快乐，杰克！最美好的祝愿！”我的妈妈做了一个大蛋糕。上面有十二根蜡烛。我许愿并吹灭蜡烛。我们唱歌、玩游戏、吃蛋糕。我们玩得很开心。我非常高兴。

questions.stem: When is Jack's birthday?
questions.stemZh: 杰克的生日是什么时候？
questions.explanation: 短文开头说“It is October 12th. It is my birthday”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does Lily give Jack?
questions.stemZh: 莉莉送给杰克什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Lily gives me a storybook”，因此选C。

questions.stem: How many candles are there on the cake?
questions.stemZh: 蛋糕上有多少根蜡烛？
questions.explanation: 短文说“There are twelve candles on it”，因此选C。

questions.stem: How does Jack feel at the party?
questions.stemZh: 杰克在聚会上感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“I am very happy”，因此选B。

text: Animals are our friends. Many people like to keep pets. Dogs and cats are the most popular pets. Dogs are friendly and loyal. They can help people in many ways. Some dogs even help blind people cross the street. Cats are quiet and clean. They like sleeping in the sun. Keeping a pet can make us happy, but it also needs time and money. We must feed them, clean them and play with them. Before you get a pet, think carefully: can you take good care of it?
translation: 动物是我们的朋友。许多人喜欢养宠物。狗和猫是最受欢迎的宠物。狗友好又忠诚。它们能在很多方面帮助人们。有些狗甚至帮助盲人过马路。猫安静又干净。它们喜欢在阳光下睡觉。养宠物能让我们快乐，但也需要时间和金钱。我们必须喂它们、给它们清洁、和它们玩耍。在养宠物之前，仔细想一想：你能好好照顾它吗？

questions.stem: What are the most popular pets according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，最受欢迎的宠物是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Dogs and cats are the most popular pets”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What can some dogs do to help people?
questions.stemZh: 有些狗能做什么来帮助人们？
options: Help blind people cross the street.
questions.explanation: 短文提到“Some dogs even help blind people cross the street”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does keeping a pet need?
questions.stemZh: 养宠物需要什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“it also needs time and money”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What is the writer's advice before getting a pet?
questions.stemZh: 作者对养宠物前的建议是什么？
options: Think carefully about whether you can care for it.
optionsZh: 仔细考虑你能否照顾好它。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“Before you get a pet, think carefully: can you take good care of it?”，因此选B。

text: Every school has rules. Rules help us learn and keep safe. In our school, we must wear school uniforms from Monday to Friday. We must arrive at school before eight o'clock. In class, we must listen to the teacher carefully. We must not eat or drink in the classroom. After class, we must not run in the hallways. We can play on the playground. We must not fight with others. If we break the rules, we will be punished. Rules are good for everyone, so we should follow them.
translation: 每所学校都有规则。规则帮助我们学习和保持安全。在我们学校，周一到周五我们必须穿校服。我们必须在八点前到校。在课堂上，我们必须认真听老师讲课。我们不能在教室里吃东西或喝饮料。下课后，我们不能在走廊里跑。我们可以在操场上玩。我们不能和别人打架。如果我们违反规则，就会受到惩罚。规则对每个人都有好处，所以我们应该遵守规则。

questions.stem: When must students arrive at school?
questions.stemZh: 学生必须什么时候到校？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We must arrive at school before eight o'clock”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What must students NOT do in the classroom?
questions.stemZh: 学生在教室里不能做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We must not eat or drink in the classroom”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where can students play after class?
questions.stemZh: 学生下课后可以在哪里玩？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We can play on the playground”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What happens if students break the rules?
questions.stemZh: 如果学生违反规则会怎样？
questions.explanation: 短文说“If we break the rules, we will be punished”，因此选B。

text: Exercise is important for our health. Doctors say teenagers should exercise for at least one hour every day. There are many ways to exercise. You can run, swim, play ball games or ride a bike. Exercise makes our heart and muscles strong. It also helps us sleep well and feel less stressed. You don't need to go to a gym. You can exercise anywhere: in a park, at school or even at home. The important thing is to find an activity you enjoy and do it regularly.
translation: 运动对我们的健康很重要。医生说青少年每天应该至少运动一小时。运动的方式有很多。你可以跑步、游泳、打球或骑自行车。运动使我们的心脏和肌肉强壮。它还帮助我们睡得好，感觉压力更小。你不需要去健身房。你可以在任何地方运动：在公园、在学校，甚至在家里。重要的是找到一项你喜欢的活动，并经常去做。

questions.stem: How long should teenagers exercise every day according to doctors?
questions.stemZh: 根据医生，青少年每天应该运动多长时间？
questions.explanation: 短文说“teenagers should exercise for at least one hour every day”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Which is NOT mentioned as a way to exercise?
questions.stemZh: 哪一项没有作为运动方式被提到？
questions.explanation: 短文提到了跑步、游泳、打球、骑自行车，没有提到下棋，因此选C。

questions.stem: What does exercise do for us?
questions.stemZh: 运动对我们有什么作用？
options: It makes us tired all the time.
It makes our heart and muscles strong.
optionsZh: 它使我们的心脏和肌肉强壮。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Exercise makes our heart and muscles strong”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where can you exercise according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，你可以在哪里运动？
options: Anywhere, like a park or at home.
optionsZh: 任何地方，比如公园或家里。
questions.explanation: 短文说“You can exercise anywhere: in a park, at school or even at home”，因此选C。

text: Eating well is very important. We need different kinds of food to stay healthy. We should eat a lot of fruit and vegetables every day. They give us vitamins. We also need some rice, bread or noodles for energy. Milk, eggs and meat give us protein. But we should not eat too much sugar or fast food. They are bad for our teeth and our body. A good eating habit means eating three meals a day at regular times. Breakfast is especially important because it gives us energy for the whole morning.
translation: 吃得好非常重要。我们需要不同种类的食物来保持健康。我们每天应该吃大量的水果和蔬菜。它们给我们维生素。我们还需要一些米饭、面包或面条来提供能量。牛奶、鸡蛋和肉给我们蛋白质。但是我们不应该吃太多糖或快餐。它们对我们的牙齿和身体有害。良好的饮食习惯意味着每天三餐定时吃。早餐尤其重要，因为它为我们整个上午提供能量。

questions.stem: What do fruit and vegetables give us?
questions.stemZh: 水果和蔬菜给我们什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We should eat a lot of fruit and vegetables every day. They give us vitamins”，因此选C。

questions.stem: Which food gives us energy according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，哪种食物给我们能量？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We also need some rice, bread or noodles for energy”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Why is breakfast especially important?
questions.stemZh: 为什么早餐尤其重要？
options: It gives us energy for the whole morning.
optionsZh: 它为我们整个上午提供能量。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“Breakfast is especially important because it gives us energy for the whole morning”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the underlined word "regular" probably mean?
questions.stemZh: 划线单词“regular”可能是什么意思？
questions.explanation: “regular times”与“每天三餐”搭配，指“固定的时间”，因此选B。

text: It is a sunny Saturday. Many people are in the park. Look! A group of boys are playing football on the grass. Two girls are flying kites. An old man is walking his dog. A young woman is reading a book under a tree. Some children are running and laughing. There is a small lake in the park. A few people are boating on it. Everyone is enjoying the beautiful day. The park is full of life and happiness.
translation: 这是一个晴朗的星期六。公园里有很多人。看！一群男孩正在草地上踢足球。两个女孩正在放风筝。一位老人正在遛狗。一位年轻女子正在树下看书。一些孩子正在奔跑和大笑。公园里有一个小湖。几个人正在湖上划船。每个人都在享受这美好的一天。公园里充满了生机和欢乐。

questions.stem: What are the boys doing?
questions.stemZh: 男孩们正在做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A group of boys are playing football on the grass”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where is the young woman reading?
questions.stemZh: 年轻女子在哪里看书？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A young woman is reading a book under a tree”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is the old man doing?
questions.stemZh: 老人正在做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“An old man is walking his dog”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is the best word to describe the park?
questions.stemZh: 哪个词最能描述这个公园？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“The park is full of life and happiness”，说明公园充满活力，因此选C。

text: Last Sunday, the weather was sunny and warm. My friends and I went to the beach. We left home at eight in the morning and arrived at nine. The beach was beautiful. The sky was blue and the water was clean. We played volleyball on the sand. Then we swam in the sea. At noon, we had a picnic under an umbrella. We ate sandwiches, fruit and ice cream. In the afternoon, we collected some shells and took many photos. We went home at five. We were tired but very happy. It was a great day.
translation: 上周日，天气晴朗温暖。我和朋友们去了海滩。我们早上八点离开家，九点到达。海滩很美。天空湛蓝，海水清澈。我们在沙滩上打排球。然后我们在海里游泳。中午，我们在伞下野餐。我们吃了三明治、水果和冰淇淋。下午，我们收集了一些贝壳，拍了很多照片。我们五点回家。我们很累但非常开心。这是很棒的一天。

questions.stem: What was the weather like last Sunday?
questions.stemZh: 上周日天气怎么样？
questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“Last Sunday, the weather was sunny and warm”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What did they do in the morning?
questions.stemZh: 他们上午做了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说上午“We played volleyball on the sand. Then we swam in the sea”，因此选B。收集贝壳和拍照是下午的活动。

questions.stem: Where did they have a picnic?
questions.stemZh: 他们在哪里野餐？
questions.explanation: 短文说“At noon, we had a picnic under an umbrella”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How did they feel at the end of the day?
questions.stemZh: 一天结束时他们感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We were tired but very happy”，因此选B。

text: Last summer, I went to Beijing with my parents. We visited the Great Wall first. It was very long and great. Many people from different countries were climbing it. We took a lot of photos. Then we went to the Palace Museum. We saw many old and beautiful things there. We also ate Beijing Duck. It was delicious. We stayed in Beijing for three days. We had a wonderful time. I hope I can go there again one day.
translation: 去年夏天，我和父母去了北京。我们先参观了长城。它非常长，非常壮观。许多来自不同国家的人正在攀登。我们拍了很多照片。然后我们去了故宫博物院。我们在那里看到了许多古老而美丽的东西。我们还吃了北京烤鸭。它很美味。我们在北京待了三天。我们玩得很开心。我希望有一天能再去那里。

questions.stem: Who did the writer go to Beijing with?
questions.stemZh: 作者和谁一起去了北京？
questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“I went to Beijing with my parents”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What did they visit first?
questions.stemZh: 他们先参观了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We visited the Great Wall first”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How long did they stay in Beijing?
questions.stemZh: 他们在北京待了多久？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We stayed in Beijing for three days”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What food did they eat in Beijing?
questions.stemZh: 他们在北京吃了什么食物？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We also ate Beijing Duck”，因此选C。

text: Once upon a time, there was a poor farmer. He had a goose. Every day, the goose laid a golden egg. The farmer sold the eggs and got money. Soon he became rich. But the farmer was greedy. He wanted to get all the golden eggs at once. He thought, "If I cut open the goose, I can get all the eggs inside." So he killed the goose. But there was nothing inside. He lost the goose and could not get any more golden eggs. The story tells us: do not be too greedy.
translation: 从前，有一个贫穷的农夫。他有一只鹅。每天，这只鹅都会下一个金蛋。农夫卖掉金蛋，得到了钱。很快他变得富有了。但是农夫很贪婪。他想一次得到所有的金蛋。他想：“如果我剖开这只鹅，我就能得到里面所有的蛋。”于是他杀死了鹅。但里面什么也没有。他失去了鹅，再也得不到金蛋了。这个故事告诉我们：不要太贪婪。

questions.stem: What did the goose lay every day?
questions.stemZh: 鹅每天下什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Every day, the goose laid a golden egg”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why did the farmer kill the goose?
questions.stemZh: 农夫为什么杀死了鹅？
options: Because he wanted all the golden eggs at once.
Because he wanted to eat it.
optionsZh: 因为他想一次得到所有的金蛋。
questions.explanation: 短文说农夫想“If I cut open the goose, I can get all the eggs inside”，即他想一次得到所有金蛋，因此选B。

questions.stem: What happened after the farmer killed the goose?
questions.stemZh: 农夫杀死鹅之后发生了什么？
options: The goose came back to life.
questions.explanation: 短文说“But there was nothing inside”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What lesson does the story teach us?
questions.stemZh: 这个故事教给我们什么道理？
options: We should not be too greedy.
questions.explanation: 故事最后点明“The story tells us: do not be too greedy”，因此选B。

text: Last summer, my family and I went to Sanya for a holiday. We went there by plane. The weather was hot and sunny. We stayed in a hotel near the beach. Every morning, we walked on the beach and swam in the sea. In the afternoon, we visited some interesting places. We also tried different kinds of seafood. It was delicious. One day, it rained heavily, so we stayed in the hotel and played cards. We had a lot of fun. We stayed in Sanya for a week. It was an unforgettable holiday.
translation: 去年夏天，我和家人去三亚度假。我们乘飞机去的。天气炎热晴朗。我们住在海滩附近的一家酒店。每天早上，我们在海滩上散步，在海里游泳。下午，我们参观了一些有趣的地方。我们还品尝了不同种类的海鲜。非常美味。有一天雨下得很大，所以我们待在酒店里打牌。我们玩得很开心。我们在三亚待了一周。那是一个难忘的假期。

questions.stem: How did the writer's family go to Sanya?
questions.stemZh: 作者一家怎么去三亚的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We went there by plane”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What did they do every morning?
questions.stemZh: 他们每天早上做什么？
options: Walked on the beach and swam.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Every morning, we walked on the beach and swam in the sea”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What did they do on the rainy day?
questions.stemZh: 下雨天他们做了什么？
options: Stayed in the hotel and played cards.
questions.explanation: 短文说“One day, it rained heavily, so we stayed in the hotel and played cards”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How long did they stay in Sanya?
questions.stemZh: 他们在三亚待了多久？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We stayed in Sanya for a week”，因此选C。

text: How often do you exercise? This is an important question. Many students say they are too busy to exercise. But doctors say exercise is necessary for everyone. You should exercise at least three times a week. You don't need to do very hard sports. Walking, running or riding a bike is enough. Exercise helps you keep a healthy weight. It also makes your heart strong and helps you think better. So, find time to exercise. Get off the bus one stop earlier and walk home. Take the stairs instead of the lift. Small changes can make a big difference.
translation: 你多久锻炼一次？这是一个重要的问题。许多学生说他们太忙了，没时间锻炼。但医生说运动对每个人都是必要的。你应该每周至少锻炼三次。你不需要做非常剧烈的运动。散步、跑步或骑自行车就足够了。运动帮助你保持健康的体重。它还使你的心脏强壮，帮助你更好地思考。所以，找时间锻炼吧。提前一站下车走回家。走楼梯而不是坐电梯。小的改变能带来大的不同。

questions.stem: How often should you exercise according to doctors?
questions.stemZh: 根据医生，你应该多久锻炼一次？
options: At least three times a week.
questions.explanation: 短文说“You should exercise at least three times a week”，因此选C。

questions.stem: Which is NOT mentioned as a way of exercise?
questions.stemZh: 哪一项没有作为运动方式被提到？
questions.explanation: 短文提到了散步、跑步、骑自行车，没有提到游泳，因此选C。

questions.stem: What does exercise do for us?
questions.stemZh: 运动对我们有什么作用？
options: It helps us keep a healthy weight.
optionsZh: 它帮助我们保持健康的体重。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Exercise helps you keep a healthy weight”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.stemZh: 这篇文章的主旨是什么？
options: Students are too busy to exercise.
Exercise is necessary and small changes can help.
Only hard sports are good for health.
You should take the bus to school.
optionsZh: 运动是必要的，小的改变也能有帮助。
只有剧烈运动才对健康有益。
questions.explanation: 短文强调运动是必要的，并建议通过“提前一站下车”“走楼梯”等小改变来增加运动量，因此选B。

text: My best friend is Linda. We are in the same class. Linda is taller and more outgoing than me. She likes telling jokes and making people laugh. I am quieter and more serious. But we have a lot in common. We both like reading and playing tennis. Linda is better at tennis than me, but I am better at maths. We often help each other. Linda helps me with my tennis, and I help her with her maths. A good friend is not the same as you. Differences make friendship more interesting.
translation: 我最好的朋友是琳达。我们在同一个班。琳达比我高，也比我外向。她喜欢讲笑话，逗人笑。我更安静、更严肃。但我们有很多共同之处。我们都喜欢阅读和打网球。琳达网球比我打得好，但我数学更好。我们经常互相帮助。琳达帮我练网球，我帮她学数学。好朋友不一定和你一样。差异让友谊更有趣。

questions.stem: Who is more outgoing?
questions.stemZh: 谁更外向？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Linda is taller and more outgoing than me”，因此琳达更外向，选A。

questions.stem: What do Linda and the writer both like?
questions.stemZh: 琳达和作者都喜欢什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We both like reading and playing tennis”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Who is better at maths?
questions.stemZh: 谁数学更好？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I am better at maths”，因此作者数学更好，选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer think of differences in friendship?
questions.stemZh: 作者怎么看待友谊中的差异？
questions.explanation: 短文最后一句说“Differences make friendship more interesting”，因此选B。

text: Welcome to City Cinema! This week we have three great movies for you. "The Lion King" is a cartoon for children. It is on Saturday morning at 10:00. "Fast & Furious" is an action movie. It is on Friday evening at 7:30. "The Notebook" is a love story. It is on Sunday afternoon at 3:00. Tickets are $8 for adults and $5 for students. You can buy tickets at the cinema or on our website. Don't miss them!
translation: 欢迎来到城市电影院！本周我们为你准备了三部精彩电影。《狮子王》是一部儿童动画片。周六上午10点上映。《速度与激情》是一部动作片。周五晚上7:30上映。《恋恋笔记本》是一部爱情片。周日下午3点上映。票价：成人8美元，学生5美元。你可以在电影院或我们的网站上买票。不要错过！

questions.stem: When is "The Lion King" on?
questions.stemZh: 《狮子王》什么时候上映？
questions.explanation: 广告说“It is on Saturday morning at 10:00”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What kind of movie is "Fast & Furious"?
questions.stemZh: 《速度与激情》是什么类型的电影？
questions.explanation: 广告说“"Fast & Furious" is an action movie”，因此选C。

questions.stem: How much is a ticket for a student?
questions.stemZh: 学生票多少钱？
questions.explanation: 广告说“Tickets are $8 for adults and $5 for students”，学生票是5美元，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where can you buy tickets?
questions.stemZh: 你可以在哪里买票？
options: At the cinema or on the website.
questions.explanation: 广告说“You can buy tickets at the cinema or on our website”，因此选C。

text: Do you have any plans for the future? Different people have different dreams. Tina wants to be a doctor. She says she wants to help sick people. Tom wants to be a pilot. He thinks flying a plane is exciting. Mary wants to be a teacher because she likes children. As for me, I want to be a writer. I love reading and writing stories. I will study hard and read more books to make my dream come true. What about you? What do you want to be when you grow up?
translation: 你对未来有什么计划吗？不同的人有不同的梦想。蒂娜想成为一名医生。她说她想帮助生病的人。汤姆想成为一名飞行员。他认为开飞机很刺激。玛丽想成为一名老师，因为她喜欢孩子。至于我，我想成为一名作家。我喜欢阅读和写故事。我会努力学习，多读书，让我的梦想成真。你呢？你长大后想做什么？

questions.stem: Why does Tina want to be a doctor?
questions.stemZh: 蒂娜为什么想成为医生？
options: Because she wants to help sick people.
optionsZh: 因为她想帮助生病的人。
questions.explanation: 短文说“She says she wants to help sick people”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does Tom think of flying a plane?
questions.stemZh: 汤姆觉得开飞机怎么样？
questions.explanation: 短文说“He thinks flying a plane is exciting”，因此选C。

questions.stem: Why does Mary want to be a teacher?
questions.stemZh: 玛丽为什么想成为老师？
options: Because she wants to be rich.
Because her mother is a teacher.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Mary wants to be a teacher because she likes children”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does the writer want to be?
questions.stemZh: 作者想成为什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“As for me, I want to be a writer”，因此选D。

text: Robots are becoming more and more common in our lives. Some robots can clean floors, and some can even cook meals. In factories, robots do dangerous and difficult jobs. In hospitals, robots can help doctors do operations. Some people worry that robots will take away human jobs. But scientists say robots will create new jobs too. People will need to learn new skills to work with robots. In the future, robots and humans will probably work together. What do you think of robots?
translation: 机器人在我们的生活中越来越常见。有些机器人能打扫地板，有些甚至能做饭。在工厂里，机器人从事危险和困难的工作。在医院里，机器人可以帮助医生做手术。有些人担心机器人会夺走人类的工作。但科学家说机器人也会创造新的工作。人们需要学习新技能来与机器人合作。未来，机器人和人类可能会一起工作。你怎么看机器人？

questions.stem: What can some robots do according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，有些机器人能做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Some robots can clean floors, and some can even cook meals”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What do robots do in factories?
questions.stemZh: 机器人在工厂里做什么？
optionsZh: 从事危险和困难的工作。
questions.explanation: 短文说“In factories, robots do dangerous and difficult jobs”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What do some people worry about?
questions.stemZh: 有些人担心什么？
options: Robots will take away human jobs.
Robots will become smarter than humans.
optionsZh: 机器人会夺走人类的工作。
机器人会比人类更聪明。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Some people worry that robots will take away human jobs”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What do scientists say about robots and jobs?
questions.stemZh: 科学家对机器人和工作怎么说？
options: Robots will create new jobs too.
People will not need to work.
optionsZh: 机器人会夺走所有工作。
机器人也会创造新的工作。
机器人什么工作都不做。
questions.explanation: 短文说“scientists say robots will create new jobs too”，因此选B。

text: How do you make a banana milk shake? It is easy. First, peel three bananas. Next, cut up the bananas. Then, put the bananas and some ice cream into a blender. After that, pour some milk into the blender. Turn on the blender and wait for a few minutes. Finally, pour the milk shake into a glass and drink it. You can also add some honey if you like. It is delicious and healthy. Try it at home!
translation: 你怎样制作香蕉奶昔？很简单。首先，剥三根香蕉。接下来，把香蕉切碎。然后，把香蕉和一些冰淇淋放进搅拌机。之后，往搅拌机里倒一些牛奶。打开搅拌机，等几分钟。最后，把奶昔倒进杯子里喝。如果你喜欢，还可以加一些蜂蜜。它美味又健康。在家试试吧！

questions.stem: How many bananas do you need?
questions.stemZh: 你需要几根香蕉？
questions.explanation: 短文说“peel three bananas”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What should you do after cutting up the bananas?
questions.stemZh: 切碎香蕉后你应该做什么？
options: Put the bananas and ice cream into a blender.
optionsZh: 把香蕉和冰淇淋放进搅拌机。
questions.explanation: 短文顺序是：切碎香蕉→“put the bananas and some ice cream into a blender” →倒牛奶→打开搅拌机，因此选B。

questions.stem: What can you add if you like?
questions.stemZh: 如果你喜欢，可以加什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“You can also add some honey if you like”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.stemZh: 这篇文章主要关于什么？
options: How to make a banana milk shake.
questions.explanation: 短文开头问“How do you make a banana milk shake?”，然后详细介绍了制作步骤，因此选A。

text: Dear friends, please come to our New Year party! It will be on Saturday, January 1st, from 7:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. in the school hall. We will have singing, dancing and games. There will be a lot of food and drinks. Please bring a small gift for the gift exchange. If you want to come, please tell Li Ming before December 28th. We hope you can join us. It will be a great night!
translation: 亲爱的朋友们，请来参加我们的新年聚会！聚会将于1月1日星期六晚上7点至10点在学校礼堂举行。我们将有唱歌、跳舞和游戏。会有很多食物和饮料。请带一份小礼物用于交换礼物。如果你想参加，请在12月28日前告诉李明。我们希望你能加入我们。那将是一个美妙的夜晚！

questions.stem: When is the New Year party?
questions.stemZh: 新年聚会是什么时候？
questions.explanation: 邀请函说“It will be on Saturday, January 1st, from 7:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where is the party?
questions.stemZh: 聚会在哪里举行？
questions.explanation: 邀请函说“in the school hall”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should you bring?
questions.stemZh: 你应该带什么？
questions.explanation: 邀请函说“Please bring a small gift for the gift exchange”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Who should you tell if you want to come?
questions.stemZh: 如果你想参加应该告诉谁？
questions.explanation: 邀请函说“please tell Li Ming before December 28th”，因此选A。

text: If you go to a party, you should follow some rules. First, arrive on time. If you are late, you should say sorry to the host. Second, bring a small gift. It can be some flowers or a box of chocolates. Third, dress properly. Don't wear too casual clothes. Fourth, talk with other guests. Be friendly and smile. Don't just sit alone. Finally, don't stay too late. Say goodbye and thank the host before you leave. If you follow these rules, you will have a good time at the party.
translation: 如果你去参加聚会，你应该遵循一些规则。首先，准时到达。如果你迟到了，应该向主人道歉。其次，带一份小礼物。可以是一些花或一盒巧克力。第三，穿着得体。不要穿太随便的衣服。第四，和其他客人交谈。要友好并微笑。不要只是独自坐着。最后，不要待得太晚。离开前要道别并感谢主人。如果你遵循这些规则，你会在聚会上玩得开心。

questions.stem: What should you do if you are late for a party?
questions.stemZh: 如果你参加聚会迟到了应该怎么做？
questions.answerText: You should say sorry to the host.
questions.explanation: 短文说“If you are late, you should say sorry to the host”，因此参考答案为“You should say sorry to the host.”。

questions.stem: What kind of gift can you bring?
questions.stemZh: 你可以带什么样的礼物？
questions.answerText: You can bring some flowers or a box of chocolates.
questions.explanation: 短文说“It can be some flowers or a box of chocolates”，因此参考答案为“You can bring some flowers or a box of chocolates.”。

questions.stem: How should you talk with other guests?
questions.stemZh: 你应该怎样和其他客人交谈？
questions.answerText: You should be friendly and smile.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Be friendly and smile”，因此参考答案为“You should be friendly and smile.”。

questions.stem: What should you do before you leave the party?
questions.stemZh: 离开聚会前你应该做什么？
questions.answerText: You should say goodbye and thank the host.
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“Say goodbye and thank the host before you leave”，因此参考答案为“You should say goodbye and thank the host.”。

text: The Spring Festival is the most important festival in China. It usually comes in January or February. Before the festival, people clean their houses and buy new clothes. On the eve of the festival, families get together and have a big dinner. Dumplings are a traditional food. After dinner, people watch the Spring Festival Gala on TV. Children get red packets with money from their parents and relatives. During the festival, people visit their friends and say "Happy New Year" to each other. The Spring Festival is a time for family and happiness.
translation: 春节是中国最重要的节日。它通常在一月或二月。节前，人们打扫房子，买新衣服。除夕夜，家人团聚，吃一顿丰盛的年夜饭。饺子是传统食物。晚饭后，人们看电视上的春节联欢晚会。孩子们从父母和亲戚那里得到装有压岁钱的红包。节日期间，人们拜访朋友，互相说“新年快乐”。春节是家庭和幸福的时刻。

questions.stem: When does the Spring Festival usually come?
questions.stemZh: 春节通常什么时候到来？
questions.explanation: 短文说“It usually comes in January or February”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What do families do on the eve of the Spring Festival?
questions.stemZh: 家人在除夕夜做什么？
options: Get together and have a big dinner.
questions.explanation: 短文说“On the eve of the festival, families get together and have a big dinner”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What do children get from their parents and relatives?
questions.stemZh: 孩子们从父母和亲戚那里得到什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Children get red packets with money from their parents and relatives”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What is the Spring Festival a time for according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，春节是什么的时刻？
questions.explanation: 短文最后一句说“The Spring Festival is a time for family and happiness”，因此选C。

text: Volunteering is a great way to help others and make a difference. Many people volunteer in their free time. You can volunteer at a hospital, a library, an animal shelter or a community centre. For example, you can read to sick children, help clean up a park, or walk dogs at an animal shelter. Volunteering is good for you too. It helps you learn new skills, meet new people and feel good about yourself. You don't need to be an adult to volunteer. Teenagers can also help. Even a few hours a week can make a big difference.
translation: 志愿服务是帮助他人和产生影响的好方法。许多人在空闲时间做志愿者。你可以在医院、图书馆、动物收容所或社区中心做志愿者。例如，你可以给生病的孩子读书，帮助清理公园，或在动物收容所遛狗。志愿服务对你自己也有好处。它帮助你学习新技能，结识新朋友，让你自我感觉良好。你不需要是成年人才能做志愿者。青少年也可以帮忙。即使每周几个小时也能带来很大的不同。

questions.stem: Where can you volunteer according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，你可以在哪里做志愿者？
options: At a hospital, a library or an animal shelter.
optionsZh: 在医院、图书馆或动物收容所。
questions.explanation: 短文说“You can volunteer at a hospital, a library, an animal shelter or a community centre”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is an example of volunteering mentioned in the passage?
questions.stemZh: 短文中提到的志愿服务例子是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“you can read to sick children”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why is volunteering good for you?
questions.stemZh: 为什么志愿服务对你有好处？
options: It helps you learn new skills and meet new people.
optionsZh: 它帮助你学习新技能和结识新朋友。
questions.explanation: 短文说“It helps you learn new skills, meet new people and feel good about yourself”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Who can volunteer according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，谁可以做志愿者？
optionsZh: 成年人和青少年都可以。
questions.explanation: 短文说“You don't need to be an adult to volunteer. Teenagers can also help”，说明成年人和青少年都可以，因此选D。

text: The Earth is our home, but it is in danger. People throw rubbish everywhere. Cars and factories produce harmful gases. Forests are disappearing. What can we do to protect the Earth? First, we can reduce, reuse and recycle. Don't use plastic bags. Bring your own bag when you go shopping. Second, save water and electricity. Turn off the lights when you leave a room. Third, plant trees. Trees can clean the air. Fourth, tell your friends and family to protect the Earth too. If everyone does a little, the world will be a better place.
translation: 地球是我们的家园，但它处于危险之中。人们到处扔垃圾。汽车和工厂产生有害气体。森林正在消失。我们能做什么来保护地球？首先，我们可以减少使用、重复使用和回收利用。不要使用塑料袋。购物时自带袋子。其次，节约水和电。离开房间时关灯。第三，种树。树木可以净化空气。第四，告诉你的朋友和家人也保护地球。如果每个人都做一点，世界将会变得更美好。

questions.stem: What is one problem mentioned in the passage?
questions.stemZh: 短文中提到的一个问题是什么？
questions.answerText: People throw rubbish everywhere. / Forests are disappearing. (Either is acceptable.)
questions.explanation: 短文提到了多个问题，如“People throw rubbish everywhere”“Forests are disappearing”，任选其一即可。

questions.stem: What does "reduce, reuse and recycle" mean for shopping?
questions.stemZh: “减少使用、重复使用和回收利用”在购物方面意味着什么？
questions.answerText: It means bringing your own bag instead of using plastic bags.
questions.explanation: 短文紧接着说“Don't use plastic bags. Bring your own bag when you go shopping”，因此参考答案为自带购物袋。

questions.stem: How can trees help the Earth?
questions.stemZh: 树木如何帮助地球？
questions.answerText: Trees can clean the air.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Trees can clean the air”，因此参考答案为“Trees can clean the air.”。

questions.stem: What should you do when you leave a room?
questions.stemZh: 离开房间时你应该做什么？
questions.answerText: You should turn off the lights.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Turn off the lights when you leave a room”，因此参考答案为“You should turn off the lights.”。

text: Communication is important in our lives. Good communication can help us solve problems and build good relationships. How can we communicate better? First, listen carefully. When someone is talking, don't interrupt. Try to understand their feelings. Second, speak clearly and politely. Use words like "please" and "thank you". Third, look at the person when you talk. This shows you are interested. Fourth, if you disagree, say it in a friendly way. Don't shout or get angry. Good communication takes practice, but it is worth it.
translation: 沟通在我们的生活中很重要。良好的沟通可以帮助我们解决问题，建立良好的关系。我们怎样才能更好地沟通？首先，认真倾听。当别人说话时，不要打断。试着理解他们的感受。其次，清楚而有礼貌地说话。使用“请”和“谢谢”这样的词。第三，说话时看着对方。这表明你感兴趣。第四，如果你不同意，用友好的方式说出来。不要大喊大叫或生气。良好的沟通需要练习，但它是值得的。

questions.stem: What should you do when someone is talking?
questions.stemZh: 当别人说话时你应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“When someone is talking, don't interrupt”，即认真倾听、不要打断，因此选B。

questions.stem: What words should you use to speak politely?
questions.stemZh: 你应该使用什么词来礼貌地说话？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Use words like "please" and "thank you"”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why should you look at the person when talking?
questions.stemZh: 为什么说话时要看着对方？
questions.explanation: 短文说“This shows you are interested”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should you do if you disagree with someone?
questions.stemZh: 如果你不同意某人，应该怎么做？
options: Say it in a friendly way.
questions.explanation: 短文说“if you disagree, say it in a friendly way”，因此选C。

text: Last week, Jack had a bad day. On Monday, he got up late and missed the school bus. He had to run to school, but he was still late. His teacher was angry. On Tuesday, he forgot his homework at home. His teacher asked him to call his parents. On Wednesday, he had a headache and went to the hospital. The doctor told him to rest. On Thursday, he felt better and went back to school. But he found he had lost his keys. He had to wait for his parents to come home. What a bad week!
translation: 上周，杰克度过了糟糕的一周。周一，他起床晚了，错过了校车。他不得不跑到学校，但还是迟到了。他的老师很生气。周二，他把作业忘在家里了。老师让他给父母打电话。周三，他头疼，去了医院。医生让他休息。周四，他感觉好多了，回到学校。但他发现钥匙丢了。他不得不等父母回家。多糟糕的一周啊！

questions.stem: What happened to Jack on Monday?
questions.stemZh: 杰克周一发生了什么？
options: He missed the school bus and was late.
optionsZh: 他错过了校车并迟到了。
questions.explanation: 短文说“On Monday, he got up late and missed the school bus... he was still late”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why did Jack go to the hospital on Wednesday?
questions.stemZh: 杰克周三为什么去医院？
