questions.explanation: 短文说“On Wednesday, he had a headache and went to the hospital”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What did Jack lose on Thursday?
questions.stemZh: 杰克周四丢了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“he found he had lost his keys”，因此选C。

questions.stem: How did Jack probably feel at the end of the week?
questions.stemZh: 杰克周末可能感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文最后感叹“What a bad week!”，说明杰克这一周过得很糟糕，心情应该是不开心的，因此选B。

text: The Great Wall is one of the most famous places in the world. It is in the north of China. It is very long—about 21,000 kilometres. People started to build the Great Wall more than 2,000 years ago. They built it to protect the country. Today, the Great Wall is a symbol of China. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to see it every year. The best time to visit is in spring or autumn because the weather is pleasant. If you go there, you can walk on the wall and enjoy the beautiful views.
translation: 长城是世界上最著名的地方之一。它位于中国北方。它非常长——大约21000公里。人们开始在2000多年前建造长城。他们建造它是为了保护国家。今天，长城是中国的象征。每年有数百万来自世界各地的游客来参观。最好的参观时间是春天或秋天，因为天气宜人。如果你去那里，你可以在长城上散步，欣赏美丽的景色。

questions.stem: Where is the Great Wall?
questions.stemZh: 长城在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“It is in the north of China”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How long is the Great Wall?
questions.stemZh: 长城有多长？
questions.explanation: 短文说“about 21,000 kilometres”，因此选C。

questions.stem: Why did people build the Great Wall?
questions.stemZh: 人们为什么建造长城？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They built it to protect the country”，因此选B。

questions.stem: When is the best time to visit the Great Wall?
questions.stemZh: 参观长城的最佳时间是什么时候？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The best time to visit is in spring or autumn”，因此选B。

text: Traditional stories are an important part of culture. Every country has its own stories. In China, we have stories like "Yu Gong Moves a Mountain" and "Hou Yi Shoots the Suns". These stories teach us lessons. "Yu Gong Moves a Mountain" tells us that we should never give up. "Hou Yi Shoots the Suns" is about a hero who saves people. In the West, there are stories like "Cinderella" and "Snow White". They often teach children to be kind and brave. Reading traditional stories helps us understand different cultures and learn important values.
translation: 传统故事是文化的重要组成部分。每个国家都有自己的故事。在中国，我们有“愚公移山”和“后羿射日”这样的故事。这些故事教给我们道理。“愚公移山”告诉我们永远不要放弃。“后羿射日”讲的是一个拯救人民的英雄。在西方，有“灰姑娘”和“白雪公主”这样的故事。它们常常教孩子们善良和勇敢。阅读传统故事帮助我们理解不同的文化，学习重要的价值观。

questions.stem: What does "Yu Gong Moves a Mountain" teach us?
questions.stemZh: “愚公移山”教给我们什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“"Yu Gong Moves a Mountain" tells us that we should never give up”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Which story is about a hero who saves people?
questions.stemZh: 哪个故事讲的是拯救人民的英雄？
questions.explanation: 短文说“"Hou Yi Shoots the Suns" is about a hero who saves people”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What do Western stories like "Cinderella" often teach children?
questions.stemZh: 像“灰姑娘”这样的西方故事常常教孩子们什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They often teach children to be kind and brave”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why should we read traditional stories?
questions.stemZh: 我们为什么要读传统故事？
options: To learn about different cultures and values.
To learn a new language quickly.
optionsZh: 为了了解不同的文化和价值观。
为了快速学习一门新语言。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“Reading traditional stories helps us understand different cultures and learn important values”，因此选A。

text: Technology has changed our lives in many ways. Smartphones are one of the most important inventions. We can use them to call people, send messages, take photos and go online. We can also use apps to order food, book tickets and learn new things. But technology also has problems. Some people spend too much time on their phones. This is bad for their eyes and their health. We should use technology wisely. Set a time limit for using the phone. Take breaks and go outside. Technology is a tool, not a toy.
translation: 科技在很多方面改变了我们的生活。智能手机是最重要的发明之一。我们可以用它们打电话、发信息、拍照和上网。我们还可以使用应用程序点餐、订票和学习新事物。但科技也有问题。有些人花太多时间在手机上。这对他们的眼睛和健康有害。我们应该明智地使用科技。给手机使用设定时间限制。休息一下，到户外去。科技是工具，不是玩具。

questions.stem: What can we use smartphones to do according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，我们可以用智能手机做什么？
options: Call people, send messages, take photos and go online.
optionsZh: 打电话、发信息、拍照和上网。
questions.explanation: 短文说“We can use them to call people, send messages, take photos and go online”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What problem does technology cause according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，科技造成了什么问题？
options: People spend too much time on their phones.
optionsZh: 人们在手机上花太多时间。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Some people spend too much time on their phones”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is bad for people's eyes and health?
questions.stemZh: 什么对人们的眼睛和健康有害？
options: Spending too much time on phones.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Some people spend too much time on their phones. This is bad for their eyes and their health”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer think technology is?
questions.stemZh: 作者认为科技是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“Technology is a tool, not a toy”，因此选B。

text: Come and visit Sunny Island! It is a great place for a holiday. You can swim in the clear blue sea and lie on the golden beach. You can also go hiking in the green mountains. There are many hotels and restaurants on the island. You can enjoy delicious seafood. The best time to visit is from May to October. The weather is warm and sunny. You can get there by plane or by ship. Book your trip now and have a wonderful time!
translation: 来阳光岛游玩吧！这是一个度假的好地方。你可以在清澈的蓝色大海中游泳，躺在金色的沙滩上。你还可以在绿色的山间徒步。岛上有许多酒店和餐馆。你可以享用美味的海鲜。最好的参观时间是五月到十月。天气温暖晴朗。你可以乘飞机或乘船到达。现在就预订你的旅行，度过美好的时光！

questions.stem: What can you do on Sunny Island?
questions.stemZh: 你在阳光岛可以做什么？
questions.explanation: 广告说“You can swim in the clear blue sea... You can also go hiking in the green mountains”，因此选A。

questions.stem: When is the best time to visit Sunny Island?
questions.stemZh: 参观阳光岛的最佳时间是什么时候？
questions.explanation: 广告说“The best time to visit is from May to October”，因此选C。

questions.stem: How can you get to Sunny Island?
questions.stemZh: 你怎么去阳光岛？
questions.explanation: 广告说“You can get there by plane or by ship”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What food can you enjoy on the island?
questions.stemZh: 你在岛上可以享用什麼食物？
questions.explanation: 广告说“You can enjoy delicious seafood”，因此选B。

text: Different countries have different customs. In China, when you meet someone for the first time, you usually shake hands. In Japan, people bow. In France, people often kiss on the cheek. In the United States, people usually shake hands too. When you visit a Chinese family, you should bring a small gift. But don't give a clock, because it means bad luck. When you eat in a Chinese restaurant, you should let the older people start eating first. Learning about customs helps us communicate better with people from other countries.
translation: 不同的国家有不同的习俗。在中国，当你第一次见到某人时，你通常握手。在日本，人们鞠躬。在法国，人们常常亲吻脸颊。在美国，人们通常也握手。当你拜访中国家庭时，你应该带一份小礼物。但不要送钟，因为它意味着坏运气。当你在中餐馆吃饭时，你应该让长辈先吃。了解习俗帮助我们更好地与其他国家的人交流。

questions.stem: What do people do when they meet for the first time in Japan?
questions.stemZh: 在日本，人们第一次见面时做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“In Japan, people bow”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What gift should you NOT give a Chinese family?
questions.stemZh: 你不应该送给中国家庭什么礼物？
questions.explanation: 短文说“don't give a clock, because it means bad luck”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Who should start eating first in a Chinese restaurant?
questions.stemZh: 在中餐馆谁应该先吃？
questions.explanation: 短文说“you should let the older people start eating first”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why should we learn about customs?
questions.stemZh: 我们为什么要了解习俗？
options: To communicate better with people from other countries.
optionsZh: 为了更好地与其他国家的人交流。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“Learning about customs helps us communicate better with people from other countries”，因此选B。

text: I have had this bike for three years. It was a birthday present from my parents. I like it very much because it is blue, my favourite colour. I ride it to school every day. It takes me about fifteen minutes. On weekends, I often ride it to the park with my friends. Sometimes I ride it to the library. I take good care of it. I clean it every week and put it in the garage when I don't use it. I hope I can keep it for many more years.
translation: 这辆自行车我已经拥有三年了。它是我父母送给我的生日礼物。我非常喜欢它，因为它是蓝色的，我最喜欢的颜色。我每天骑它上学。大约需要十五分钟。周末，我经常和朋友们骑它去公园。有时我骑它去图书馆。我好好照顾它。我每周清洁它，不用时把它放在车库里。我希望我能再保留它很多年。

questions.stem: How long has the writer had the bike?
questions.stemZh: 作者拥有这辆自行车多久了？
questions.answerText: For three years.
questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“I have had this bike for three years”，因此参考答案为“For three years.”。

questions.stem: Who gave the bike to the writer?
questions.stemZh: 谁送给作者这辆自行车？
questions.answerText: The writer's parents.
questions.explanation: 短文说“It was a birthday present from my parents”，因此参考答案为“The writer's parents.”。

questions.stem: How long does it take the writer to ride to school?
questions.stemZh: 作者骑车上学需要多长时间？
questions.answerText: About fifteen minutes.
questions.explanation: 短文说“It takes me about fifteen minutes”，因此参考答案为“About fifteen minutes.”。

questions.stem: What does the writer do with the bike every week?
questions.stemZh: 作者每周对自行车做什么？
questions.answerText: The writer cleans it every week.
questions.explanation: 短文说“I clean it every week”，因此参考答案为“The writer cleans it every week.”。

text: Wei Fen used to be afraid of learning English. She didn't understand her teacher because the teacher spoke too fast. She was afraid to ask questions because her pronunciation was poor. Then one day, she watched an English movie. She loved the movie and wanted to understand the actors. She started to watch English movies and repeat the sentences. She also read English books and looked up new words in the dictionary. Slowly, she improved. Now she is one of the best English students in her class. She says, "Learning English is like learning to swim. You have to practice every day."
translation: 魏芬过去害怕学英语。她听不懂老师的话，因为老师说太快了。她不敢问问题，因为她的发音不好。后来有一天，她看了一部英语电影。她喜欢那部电影，想听懂演员的话。她开始看英语电影并重复句子。她还读英语书，在字典里查新单词。慢慢地，她进步了。现在她是班上英语最好的学生之一。她说：“学英语就像学游泳。你必须每天练习。”

questions.stem: Why didn't Wei Fen understand her teacher at first?
questions.stemZh: 魏芬一开始为什么听不懂老师的话？
questions.explanation: 短文说“She didn't understand her teacher because the teacher spoke too fast”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What changed Wei Fen's attitude towards English?
questions.stemZh: 什么改变了魏芬对英语的态度？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Then one day, she watched an English movie. She loved the movie and wanted to understand the actors”，这部电影促使她开始努力学习英语，因此选A。

questions.stem: What did Wei Fen do to improve her English?
questions.stemZh: 魏芬做了什么来提高英语？
options: She watched English movies and read English books.
She only asked her teacher for help.
optionsZh: 她看英语电影和读英语书。
questions.explanation: 短文提到她“started to watch English movies and repeat the sentences”以及“read English books and looked up new words”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does Wei Fen compare learning English to?
questions.stemZh: 魏芬把学英语比作什么？
questions.explanation: 短文最后引用魏芬的话“Learning English is like learning to swim”，因此选A。

text: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a traditional Chinese festival. It is on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month. On this day, families get together and eat mooncakes. Mooncakes are round, like the full moon. They symbolize reunion and happiness. There are many stories about this festival. The most famous one is about Chang'e, a beautiful woman who flew to the moon. People also admire the full moon and tell stories. The Mid-Autumn Festival is a time for family and thanks.
translation: 中秋节是中国的传统节日。它在农历八月十五。这一天，家人团聚，吃月饼。月饼是圆的，像满月。它们象征团圆和幸福。关于这个节日有很多故事。最著名的是关于嫦娥的，一个飞上月亮的美丽女子。人们也赏月、讲故事。中秋节是家庭和感恩的时刻。

questions.stem: When is the Mid-Autumn Festival?
questions.stemZh: 中秋节是什么时候？
options: On the 1st day of the 1st lunar month.
On the 15th day of the 8th lunar month.
On the 5th day of the 5th lunar month.
On the 15th day of the 1st lunar month.
questions.explanation: 短文说“It is on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What do mooncakes symbolize?
questions.stemZh: 月饼象征什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They symbolize reunion and happiness”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Who is Chang'e?
questions.stemZh: 嫦娥是谁？
options: A woman who flew to the moon.
A man who shot the suns.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Chang'e, a beautiful woman who flew to the moon”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is the Mid-Autumn Festival a time for?
questions.stemZh: 中秋节是什么的时刻？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“The Mid-Autumn Festival is a time for family and thanks”，因此选A。

text: Excuse me, could you please tell me where the nearest bank is? Walk along this street and turn left at the second crossing. The bank is on your right. It is between a bookstore and a restaurant. If you want to go to the post office, go past the bank and turn right. You will see it on your left. Is there a supermarket near here? Yes, there is one next to the post office. You can buy food and drinks there.
translation: 打扰一下，你能告诉我最近的银行在哪里吗？沿着这条街走，在第二个十字路口左转。银行在你的右边。它在书店和餐馆之间。如果你想去邮局，经过银行后右转。你会看到它在你的左边。这附近有超市吗？是的，邮局旁边就有一家。你可以在那里买食物和饮料。

questions.stem: Where is the bank?
questions.stemZh: 银行在哪里？
options: On the left of the street.
Between a bookstore and a restaurant.
questions.explanation: 对话说“It is between a bookstore and a restaurant”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How do you get to the post office from the bank?
questions.stemZh: 从银行怎么去邮局？
options: Go past the bank and turn right.
Go past the post office and turn right.
questions.explanation: 对话说“If you want to go to the post office, go past the bank and turn right”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Where is the supermarket?
questions.stemZh: 超市在哪里？
options: Between the bank and the restaurant.
questions.explanation: 对话说“there is one next to the post office”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What can you buy in the supermarket?
questions.stemZh: 你可以在超市买什么？
questions.explanation: 对话说“You can buy food and drinks there”，因此选B。

text: My name is Emily. I used to be afraid of the dark. When I was a little girl, I always asked my parents to leave the light on at night. I also used to be shy. I was afraid to speak in front of the class. But things have changed. Now I am not afraid of the dark anymore. I can sleep with the light off. I am also more outgoing. I have joined the school debate club and I can speak confidently in public. How did I change? I think it is because I have grown up and I have learned to face my fears.
translation: 我叫艾米丽。我过去怕黑。当我还是个小女孩时，我总是让父母晚上开着灯。我也曾经很害羞。我不敢在全班面前发言。但事情已经改变了。现在我不再怕黑了。我可以关灯睡觉。我也更外向了。我加入了学校辩论社，我可以在公共场合自信地发言。我是怎么改变的？我认为是因为我长大了，学会了面对恐惧。

questions.stem: What was Emily afraid of when she was little?
questions.stemZh: 艾米丽小时候害怕什么？
options: The dark and speaking in public.
questions.explanation: 短文说“I used to be afraid of the dark”和“I also used to be shy. I was afraid to speak in front of the class”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does Emily do now that shows she is more outgoing?
questions.stemZh: 艾米丽现在做了什么表明她更外向了？
options: She sleeps with the light on.
questions.explanation: 短文说“I have joined the school debate club and I can speak confidently in public”，这体现了她更外向，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why did Emily change?
questions.stemZh: 艾米丽为什么改变了？
options: Because she grew up and faced her fears.
Because she moved to a new school.
optionsZh: 因为她长大了并面对恐惧。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“I think it is because I have grown up and I have learned to face my fears”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.stemZh: 这篇文章主要关于什么？
options: How Emily changed from shy and fearful to confident.
How to join a debate club.
optionsZh: 艾米丽如何从害羞害怕变得自信。
questions.explanation: 短文对比了艾米丽过去和现在的变化，并解释了变化的原因，核心是她的成长和转变，因此选A。

text: What are the shirts made of? They are made of cotton or silk. Cotton comes from plants, and silk comes from silkworms. Glass is made from sand. Paper is made from wood. Many things in our daily life are made of natural materials. But some things are made of man-made materials, like plastic. Plastic is cheap and useful, but it is bad for the environment because it does not break down easily. We should use fewer plastic bags and bottles. We can use cloth bags and glass bottles instead.
translation: 衬衫是用什么制成的？它们由棉或丝绸制成。棉来自植物，丝绸来自蚕。玻璃由沙子制成。纸由木材制成。我们日常生活中的许多东西都是由天然材料制成的。但有些东西是由人造材料制成的，比如塑料。塑料便宜又有用，但对环境有害，因为它不容易分解。我们应该少用塑料袋和塑料瓶。我们可以改用布袋和玻璃瓶。

questions.stem: What are shirts made of according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，衬衫是用什么制成的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They are made of cotton or silk”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where does silk come from?
questions.stemZh: 丝绸来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“silk comes from silkworms”，因此选C。

questions.stem: Why is plastic bad for the environment?
questions.stemZh: 为什么塑料对环境有害？
options: It does not break down easily.
questions.explanation: 短文说“it is bad for the environment because it does not break down easily”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer suggest we use instead of plastic bags?
questions.stemZh: 作者建议我们用什么代替塑料袋？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We can use cloth bags and glass bottles instead”，因此选B。

text: Tea is one of the most popular drinks in the world. It was first discovered in China. According to an old story, Emperor Shen Nong discovered tea when some leaves fell into his hot water. Tea was later brought to other countries. Today, people in many countries drink tea. In China, people like green tea and black tea. In Britain, people like to drink tea with milk and sugar. In Japan, there is a special tea ceremony. Tea is not just a drink; it is also a part of culture.
translation: 茶是世界上最受欢迎的饮料之一。它最早在中国被发现。根据一个古老的故事，神农皇帝在一些叶子掉进热水时发现了茶。茶后来被带到其他国家。今天，许多国家的人喝茶。在中国，人们喜欢绿茶和红茶。在英国，人们喜欢加牛奶和糖喝茶。在日本，有一种特殊的茶道。茶不仅仅是一种饮料；它也是文化的一部分。

questions.stem: Where was tea first discovered?
questions.stemZh: 茶最早在哪里被发现？
questions.explanation: 短文说“It was first discovered in China”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Who discovered tea according to the old story?
questions.stemZh: 根据古老的故事，谁发现了茶？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Emperor Shen Nong discovered tea”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How do British people like to drink tea?
questions.stemZh: 英国人喜欢怎么喝茶？
questions.explanation: 短文说“In Britain, people like to drink tea with milk and sugar”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does the passage say tea is besides a drink?
questions.stemZh: 短文说茶除了是饮料还是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“Tea is not just a drink; it is also a part of culture”，因此选B。

text: Teenagers should be allowed to make some decisions. But they should also follow rules. For example, teenagers should be allowed to choose their own clothes. But they should not be allowed to get their ears pierced without permission. They should be allowed to watch TV after finishing homework. But they should not be allowed to play computer games late at night. Parents and teenagers may disagree, but talking calmly can help. The key is to find a balance between freedom and responsibility.
translation: 应该允许青少年做一些决定。但他们也应该遵守规则。例如，应该允许青少年选择自己的衣服。但不应该允许他们未经允许打耳洞。应该允许他们完成作业后看电视。但不应该允许他们深夜玩电脑游戏。父母和青少年可能意见不同，但平静地交谈会有帮助。关键是在自由和责任之间找到平衡。

questions.stem: What should teenagers be allowed to do according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，应该允许青少年做什么？
options: Get their ears pierced without permission.
Play computer games late at night.
questions.explanation: 短文说“teenagers should be allowed to choose their own clothes”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should teenagers NOT be allowed to do?
questions.stemZh: 不应该允许青少年做什么？
options: Get their ears pierced without permission.
questions.explanation: 短文说“they should not be allowed to get their ears pierced without permission”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What can help when parents and teenagers disagree?
questions.stemZh: 当父母和青少年意见不同时，什么会有帮助？
questions.explanation: 短文说“talking calmly can help”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is the key according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，关键是什么？
options: A balance between freedom and responsibility.
optionsZh: 自由和责任之间的平衡。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“The key is to find a balance between freedom and responsibility”，因此选C。

text: One day, a poor man found a magic lamp. When he rubbed it, a genie came out. The genie said, "I will give you three wishes." The man was very excited. First, he wished for a lot of money. Second, he wished for a big house. Third, he wished for a beautiful car. The genie gave him all these things. But the man was still not happy. He had no friends. He realized that money and things cannot buy happiness. He used his last wish to ask for true friends. From then on, he lived happily with his friends.
translation: 有一天，一个穷人找到了一盏神灯。当他摩擦它时，一个精灵出来了。精灵说：“我会给你三个愿望。”这个人非常兴奋。首先，他想要很多钱。其次，他想要一栋大房子。第三，他想要一辆漂亮的汽车。精灵给了他所有这些。但这个人仍然不快乐。他没有朋友。他意识到金钱和东西买不到幸福。他用最后一个愿望祈求真正的朋友。从那时起，他和朋友们幸福地生活在一起。

questions.stem: How many wishes did the genie give the man?
questions.stemZh: 精灵给了这个人几个愿望？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I will give you three wishes”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What was the man's first wish?
questions.stemZh: 这个人的第一个愿望是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“First, he wished for a lot of money”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why was the man still unhappy after getting money, a house and a car?
questions.stemZh: 为什么这个人在得到钱、房子和车之后仍然不快乐？
questions.explanation: 短文说“But the man was still not happy. He had no friends”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What lesson does the story teach us?
questions.stemZh: 这个故事教给我们什么道理？
options: Money and things cannot buy happiness.
optionsZh: 金钱和东西买不到幸福。
questions.explanation: 短文说“He realized that money and things cannot buy happiness”，这是故事传达的道理，因此选C。

text: Do you like music? Music is good for us in many ways. It can make us feel happy or relaxed. When we are sad, listening to soft music can help us feel better. When we are tired, upbeat music can give us energy. Music can also help us learn. Some studies show that listening to music while studying can improve concentration. Many students like to listen to music when they do homework. But it is important to choose the right kind of music. Loud and noisy music may distract you.
translation: 你喜欢音乐吗？音乐在很多方面对我们有好处。它能让我们感到快乐或放松。当我们悲伤时，听轻柔的音乐可以帮助我们感觉好一些。当我们疲倦时，欢快的音乐可以给我们能量。音乐也可以帮助我们学习。一些研究表明，学习时听音乐可以提高注意力。许多学生喜欢在做作业时听音乐。但选择正确的音乐类型很重要。响亮嘈杂的音乐可能会让你分心。

questions.stem: What kind of music can help us feel better when we are sad?
questions.stemZh: 当我们悲伤时，哪种音乐可以帮助我们感觉好一些？
questions.explanation: 短文说“When we are sad, listening to soft music can help us feel better”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What can upbeat music do when we are tired?
questions.stemZh: 当我们疲倦时，欢快的音乐能做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“When we are tired, upbeat music can give us energy”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What do some studies show about music and studying?
questions.stemZh: 一些研究关于音乐和学习表明了什麼？
options: Listening to music while studying can improve concentration.
Students should never listen to music.
optionsZh: 学习时听音乐可以提高注意力。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Some studies show that listening to music while studying can improve concentration”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What kind of music may distract you?
questions.stemZh: 哪种音乐可能会让你分心？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Loud and noisy music may distract you”，因此选C。

text: In different countries, there are different table manners. In China, people use chopsticks. They usually share dishes together. In Western countries, people use knives and forks. Everyone has their own plate. When you eat in a Western restaurant, you should put your napkin on your lap. Don't make noise when you eat soup. When you finish eating, put your knife and fork together on the plate. Learning about table manners is important because it shows respect for others.
translation: 在不同的国家，有不同的餐桌礼仪。在中国，人们使用筷子。他们通常一起分享菜肴。在西方国家，人们使用刀叉。每个人有自己的盘子。当你在西餐厅吃饭时，你应该把餐巾放在腿上。喝汤时不要发出声音。吃完后，把刀叉一起放在盘子上。了解餐桌礼仪很重要，因为它表示对他人的尊重。

questions.stem: What do people use to eat in China?
questions.stemZh: 在中国人们用什么吃饭？
questions.explanation: 短文说“In China, people use chopsticks”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where should you put your napkin in a Western restaurant?
questions.stemZh: 在西餐厅你应该把餐巾放在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“you should put your napkin on your lap”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should you NOT do when eating soup in a Western restaurant?
questions.stemZh: 在西餐厅喝汤时你不应该做什么？
options: Put the napkin on your lap.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Don't make noise when you eat soup”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why is learning about table manners important?
questions.stemZh: 为什么了解餐桌礼仪很重要？
options: Because it helps you eat faster.
Because it shows respect for others.
Because it helps you cook better.
optionsZh: 因为它帮助你吃得更快。
因为它表示对他人的尊重。
因为它帮助你更好地做饭。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“it shows respect for others”，因此选B。

text: We are trying to save the Earth. There are many environmental problems today. Factories put waste into rivers and the air. Too much rubbish is not recycled. Many animals are losing their homes. What can we do? We can start with small actions. Turn off the tap when you brush your teeth. Use both sides of the paper. Take your own bag to the supermarket. Ride a bike or walk instead of taking a car. These actions may seem small, but if everyone does them, they will make a big difference.
translation: 我们正在努力拯救地球。今天有许多环境问题。工厂把废物排入河流和空气中。太多垃圾没有被回收。许多动物正在失去家园。我们能做什么？我们可以从小事做起。刷牙时关掉水龙头。用纸的两面。去超市时自带袋子。骑自行车或步行代替开车。这些行动可能看起来很小，但如果每个人都做，它们会带来很大的不同。

questions.stem: What environmental problem is mentioned in the passage?
questions.stemZh: 短文中提到了什么环境问题？
options: Factories put waste into rivers and the air.
optionsZh: 工厂把废物排入河流和空气中。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Factories put waste into rivers and the air”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should you do when you brush your teeth?
questions.stemZh: 刷牙时你应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Turn off the tap when you brush your teeth”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How can you save paper?
questions.stemZh: 你怎样节约纸张？
options: Use both sides of the paper.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Use both sides of the paper”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.stemZh: 这篇文章的主旨是什么？
options: Environmental problems are too big to solve.
Small actions can help save the Earth.
Only factories can solve environmental problems.
optionsZh: 环境问题太大，无法解决。
小的行动可以帮助拯救地球。
只有工厂能解决环境问题。
我们应该停止使用纸张。
questions.explanation: 短文列举了环境问题后，强调“These actions may seem small, but if everyone does them, they will make a big difference”，主旨是小的行动能带来改变，因此选B。

text: Life is full of the unexpected. Last Friday, I planned to go to a concert with my friend. I got up early and got dressed. But when I was about to leave, it started to rain heavily. I couldn't find my umbrella. I waited for the rain to stop, but it didn't. Finally, I decided to take a taxi. On the way, there was a traffic jam. When I arrived at the concert hall, the concert was almost over. I missed most of it. But my friend was waiting for me outside. She said, "It's OK. We can go next time." I felt much better.
translation: 生活充满了意外。上周五，我计划和朋友去听音乐会。我早早起床，穿好衣服。但当我正要出门时，天开始下大雨。我找不到我的雨伞。我等雨停，但雨一直没停。最后，我决定打车。路上堵车了。当我到达音乐厅时，音乐会几乎结束了。我错过了大部分。但我的朋友在外面等我。她说：“没关系。我们下次可以去。”我感觉好多了。

questions.stem: What did the writer plan to do last Friday?
questions.stemZh: 作者上周五计划做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I planned to go to a concert with my friend”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Why couldn't the writer leave early?
questions.stemZh: 作者为什么不能早点离开？
options: Because it rained heavily and she couldn't find her umbrella.
optionsZh: 因为雨下得很大，她找不到雨伞。
questions.explanation: 短文说“it started to rain heavily. I couldn't find my umbrella”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Why was the writer late for the concert?
questions.stemZh: 作者为什么音乐会迟到？
options: She took a taxi but there was a traffic jam.
She went to the wrong place.
questions.explanation: 短文说“I decided to take a taxi. On the way, there was a traffic jam”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How did the writer's friend make her feel better?
questions.stemZh: 作者的朋友如何让她感觉好一些？
options: By saying they could go next time.
questions.explanation: 短文说朋友告诉她“It's OK. We can go next time”，因此选B。

text: I remember meeting all of you in Grade 7. At that time, we were all shy and nervous. We didn't know each other well. But over the past three years, we have grown up together. We have studied hard, played sports and shared many happy and sad moments. Our teachers have helped us a lot. They have taught us not only knowledge but also how to be good people. Now we are leaving school. I feel sad but also excited. I will never forget my teachers and classmates. I hope we will all have a bright future.
translation: 我记得在七年级遇见你们所有人。那时，我们都很害羞和紧张。我们彼此不太了解。但在过去的三年里，我们一起成长。我们努力学习，参加体育运动，分享了许多快乐和悲伤的时刻。我们的老师帮助了我们很多。他们不仅教我们知识，还教我们如何做个好人。现在我们即将离开学校。我感到伤心但也兴奋。我永远不会忘记我的老师和同学。我希望我们都有一个光明的未来。

questions.stem: How did the students feel in Grade 7?
questions.stemZh: 学生们在七年级时感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文说“At that time, we were all shy and nervous”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What have the teachers taught the students?
questions.stemZh: 老师教了学生什么？
options: Knowledge and how to be good people.
questions.explanation: 短文说“They have taught us not only knowledge but also how to be good people”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How does the writer feel about leaving school?
questions.stemZh: 作者对离开学校感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I feel sad but also excited”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What does the writer hope for the future?
questions.stemZh: 作者对未来有什么希望？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“I hope we will all have a bright future”，因此选B。

text: Life is full of the unexpected. Sometimes things don't go as planned. For example, you may plan to go to a party, but your car breaks down. You may study hard for a test, but you still get a low score. What should you do when these things happen? First, stay calm. Don't get angry or upset. Second, think about what you can do to solve the problem. Third, learn from the experience. Ask yourself, "What can I do differently next time?" Remember, unexpected things are a part of life. They can teach us important lessons and make us stronger.
translation: 生活充满了意外。有时事情不会按计划进行。例如，你可能计划去参加聚会，但你的车坏了。你可能为考试努力学习，但仍然得了低分。当这些事情发生时你应该怎么做？首先，保持冷静。不要生气或难过。其次，想想你能做什么来解决问题。第三，从经历中学习。问自己：“下次我能做什么不同？”记住，意外是生活的一部分。它们可以教我们重要的道理，让我们更强大。

questions.stem: What should you do first when something unexpected happens?
questions.stemZh: 当意外发生时你首先应该做什么？
questions.answerText: Stay calm.
questions.explanation: 短文说“First, stay calm”，因此参考答案为“Stay calm.”。

questions.stem: What should you NOT do according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，你不应该做什么？
questions.answerText: Don't get angry or upset.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Don't get angry or upset”，因此参考答案为“Don't get angry or upset.”。

questions.stem: What question should you ask yourself after an unexpected event?
questions.stemZh: 意外事件发生后你应该问自己什么问题？
questions.answerText: What can I do differently next time?
questions.explanation: 短文说“Ask yourself, "What can I do differently next time?"”，因此参考答案为该句。

questions.stem: What can unexpected things do for us?
questions.stemZh: 意外能为我们做什么？
questions.answerText: They can teach us important lessons and make us stronger.
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“They can teach us important lessons and make us stronger”，因此参考答案为该句。

text: Hi! I'm Li Hua. I meet a new friend today. His name is Tom. He is from the UK. He says, "Hello! Nice to meet you!" I say, "Hi! Nice to meet you, too." We are in the same class. Tom likes playing basketball. I like reading books. We are different, but we are good friends now.
translation: 嗨！我是李华。今天我认识了一个新朋友。他叫汤姆。他来自英国。他说：“你好！很高兴见到你！”我说：“嗨！我也很高兴见到你。”我们在同一个班。汤姆喜欢打篮球。我喜欢读书。我们不同，但我们现在是好朋友了。

questions.stem: Where is Tom from?
questions.stemZh: 汤姆来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文中说“He is from the UK”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does Tom like doing?
questions.stemZh: 汤姆喜欢做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Tom likes playing basketball”，因此选B。

text: Keeping tidy is a good habit. A tidy desk helps you find your things quickly. Put your books on the shelf. Put your pens in the pencil box. Clean your desk after school. Don't leave rubbish on it. If you keep tidy every day, your room will look nice.
translation: 保持整洁是一个好习惯。整洁的书桌帮助你快速找到东西。把书放在书架上。把钢笔放进铅笔盒里。放学后清理书桌。不要把垃圾留在上面。如果你每天保持整洁，你的房间会看起来很棒。

questions.stem: Where should you put your books?
questions.stemZh: 你应该把书放在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Put your books on the shelf”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should you do after school?
questions.stemZh: 放学后你应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Clean your desk after school”，因此选A。

text: Welcome to our school! This is the teaching building. Your classroom is on the second floor. The library is next to it. You can read books there. The dining hall is behind the library. We have lunch there at 12:00. The playground is in front of the teaching building. You can play sports there. Enjoy your school life!
translation: 欢迎来到我们学校！这是教学楼。你的教室在二楼。图书馆在它旁边。你可以在那里看书。食堂在图书馆后面。我们十二点在那里吃午饭。操场在教学楼前面。你可以在那里运动。享受你的学校生活吧！

questions.stem: Where is the classroom?
questions.stemZh: 教室在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Your classroom is on the second floor”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where do students have lunch?
questions.stemZh: 学生们在哪里吃午饭？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The dining hall is behind the library. We have lunch there”，因此选C。

text: I'm Peter. I have a new friend. His name is David. David is from Canada. He is tall and wears glasses. He is friendly and funny. He often tells us stories. We both like playing basketball. After school, we play basketball together. David is good at maths, but I am good at English. We help each other.
translation: 我是彼得。我有一个新朋友。他叫大卫。大卫来自加拿大。他个子高，戴眼镜。他友好又风趣。他经常给我们讲故事。我们都喜欢打篮球。放学后，我们一起打篮球。大卫擅长数学，但我擅长英语。我们互相帮助。

questions.stem: Where is David from?
questions.stemZh: 大卫来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“David is from Canada”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What do Peter and David both like?
questions.stemZh: 彼得和大卫都喜欢什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We both like playing basketball”，因此选B。

text: My name is Jenny. I have a big family. There are six people in my family: my grandparents, my parents, my little brother and me. My grandfather likes reading newspapers. My grandmother is good at cooking. My father is a doctor. My mother is a teacher. My little brother is five. We often have dinner together. I love my family.
translation: 我叫珍妮。我有一个大家庭。我家有六口人：我的祖父母、我的父母、我的小弟弟和我。我的祖父喜欢看报纸。我的祖母擅长做饭。我的父亲是一名医生。我的母亲是一名老师。我的小弟弟五岁。我们经常一起吃晚饭。我爱我的家人。

questions.stem: How many people are there in Jenny's family?
questions.stemZh: 珍妮家有几口人？
questions.explanation: 短文说“There are six people in my family”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What is Jenny's father?
questions.stemZh: 珍妮的父亲是做什么的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“My father is a doctor”，因此选B。

text: My school is not big but beautiful. There are three buildings: a teaching building, a library and a dining hall. My classroom is on the second floor. There is a big playground in front of the teaching building. We do morning exercises there. The library is next to the teaching building. I often read there. The dining hall is behind the library. I like my school.
translation: 我的学校不大但很漂亮。有三栋楼：一栋教学楼、一个图书馆和一个食堂。我的教室在二楼。教学楼前面有一个大操场。我们在那里做早操。图书馆在教学楼旁边。我经常在那里看书。食堂在图书馆后面。我喜欢我的学校。

questions.stem: Where is the library?
questions.stemZh: 图书馆在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The library is next to the teaching building”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer often do in the library?
questions.stemZh: 作者经常在图书馆做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I often read there”，there指图书馆，因此选C。

text: Different students like different subjects. Amy likes English because it is interesting. She often listens to English songs. Tom likes maths best. He enjoys solving problems. Jack likes PE. He loves playing basketball. I like history. I can learn about the past. I think every subject is important.
translation: 不同的学生喜欢不同的科目。艾米喜欢英语，因为它有趣。她经常听英文歌曲。汤姆最喜欢数学。他喜欢解决问题。杰克喜欢体育。他喜欢打篮球。我喜欢历史。我可以了解过去。我认为每个科目都很重要。

questions.stem: What is Amy's favourite subject?
questions.stemZh: 艾米最喜欢的科目是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Amy likes English”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why does Tom like maths?
questions.stemZh: 汤姆为什么喜欢数学？
questions.explanation: 短文说“He enjoys solving problems”，因此选B。

text: Do you want to join a club? Here are three clubs. The Music Club meets on Monday afternoons. You can learn to sing and play the guitar. The Sports Club meets on Wednesday afternoons. You can play basketball and football. The Reading Club meets on Friday afternoons. You can share books with others. Come to Room 201 to join us!
translation: 你想加入社团吗？这里有三个社团。音乐社团在周一下午活动。你可以学习唱歌和弹吉他。体育社团在周三下午活动。你可以打篮球和踢足球。阅读社团在周五下午活动。你可以和其他人分享书籍。来201室加入我们吧！

questions.stem: When does the Music Club meet?
questions.stemZh: 音乐社团什么时候活动？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The Music Club meets on Monday afternoons”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What can you do in the Sports Club?
questions.stemZh: 你在体育社团可以做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“You can play basketball and football”，因此选C。

text: I am Mike. I usually get up at 6:30. I have breakfast at 7:00. I go to school at 7:30. Classes begin at 8:00. I have four classes in the morning and two in the afternoon. I have lunch at 12:00. After school, I play football with my friends. I go home at 5:00. In the evening, I do my homework and have dinner. I go to bed at 9:30.
translation: 我是迈克。我通常六点半起床。我七点吃早饭。我七点半去上学。八点开始上课。我上午有四节课，下午有两节课。我十二点吃午饭。放学后，我和朋友们踢足球。我五点回家。晚上，我做作业，吃晚饭。我九点半上床睡觉。

questions.stem: What time does Mike get up?
questions.stemZh: 迈克几点起床？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I usually get up at 6:30”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does Mike do after school?
questions.stemZh: 迈克放学后做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“After school, I play football with my friends”，因此选B。

text: It is October 12th. It is my birthday. My parents have a party for me. My friends come. Lily gives me a storybook. Tom gives me a basketball. Anna gives me a card. My mother makes a big cake with twelve candles. I make a wish and blow out the candles. We sing, play games and eat cake. I am very happy.
translation: 今天是10月12日。是我的生日。我的父母为我举办了一个聚会。我的朋友们来了。莉莉送给我一本故事书。汤姆送给我一个篮球。安娜送给我一张卡片。我的妈妈做了一个大蛋糕，上面有十二根蜡烛。我许愿并吹灭蜡烛。我们唱歌、玩游戏、吃蛋糕。我非常开心。

questions.stem: When is the writer's birthday?
questions.stemZh: 作者的生日是什么时候？
questions.explanation: 短文说“It is October 12th. It is my birthday”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does Lily give the writer?
questions.stemZh: 莉莉送给作者什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Lily gives me a storybook”，因此选C。

text: Animals are our friends. Dogs and cats are popular pets. Dogs are friendly and loyal. Some dogs help blind people. Cats are quiet and clean. Keeping a pet needs time and money. We must feed them and play with them. Before you get a pet, think carefully: can you take good care of it?
translation: 动物是我们的朋友。狗和猫是受欢迎的宠物。狗友好又忠诚。有些狗帮助盲人。猫安静又干净。养宠物需要时间和金钱。我们必须喂它们，和它们玩耍。在你养宠物之前，仔细想想：你能好好照顾它吗？

questions.stem: What can some dogs do?
questions.stemZh: 有些狗能做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Some dogs help blind people”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does keeping a pet need?
questions.stemZh: 养宠物需要什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Keeping a pet needs time and money”，因此选C。

text: Every school has rules. In our school, we must wear school uniforms from Monday to Friday. We must arrive before 8:00. In class, we must listen carefully. We must not eat in the classroom. After class, we must not run in the hallways. We can play on the playground. Rules help us learn and keep safe.
translation: 每所学校都有规则。在我们学校，周一到周五我们必须穿校服。我们必须在八点前到校。在课堂上，我们必须认真听讲。我们不能在教室里吃东西。下课后，我们不能在走廊里跑。我们可以在操场上玩。规则帮助我们学习和保持安全。

questions.stem: When must students arrive at school?
questions.stemZh: 学生必须什么时候到校？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We must arrive before 8:00”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What must students NOT do in the classroom?
questions.stemZh: 学生在教室里不能做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We must not eat in the classroom”，因此选B。

text: Exercise is important. Doctors say teenagers should exercise for at least one hour every day. You can run, swim or play ball games. Exercise makes your heart strong. It helps you sleep well and feel less stressed. You don't need a gym. You can exercise in a park or at home. Find an activity you enjoy and do it regularly.
translation: 运动很重要。医生说青少年每天应该至少运动一小时。你可以跑步、游泳或打球。运动使你的心脏强壮。它帮助你睡得好，感觉压力更小。你不需要健身房。你可以在公园或家里运动。找到一项你喜欢的活动，并经常去做。

questions.stem: How long should teenagers exercise every day?
questions.stemZh: 青少年每天应该运动多长时间？
questions.explanation: 短文说“teenagers should exercise for at least one hour every day”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where can you exercise according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，你可以在哪里运动？
options: In a park or at home.
questions.explanation: 短文说“You can exercise in a park or at home”，因此选C。

text: Eating well is important. We should eat a lot of fruit and vegetables. They give us vitamins. We also need rice, bread or noodles for energy. Milk, eggs and meat give us protein. We should not eat too much sugar or fast food. A good eating habit means eating three meals at regular times. Breakfast is especially important.
translation: 吃得好很重要。我们应该多吃水果和蔬菜。它们给我们维生素。我们还需要米饭、面包或面条来提供能量。牛奶、鸡蛋和肉给我们蛋白质。我们不应该吃太多糖或快餐。良好的饮食习惯意味着三餐定时。早餐尤其重要。

questions.stem: What do fruit and vegetables give us?
questions.stemZh: 水果和蔬菜给我们什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They give us vitamins”，因此选C。

questions.stem: Why is breakfast especially important?
questions.stemZh: 为什么早餐尤其重要？
options: It gives us energy for the morning.
optionsZh: 它为我们上午提供能量。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Breakfast is especially important”，结合上下文，早餐提供上午所需的能量，因此选B。

text: It is a sunny Saturday. Many people are in the park. A group of boys are playing football. Two girls are flying kites. An old man is walking his dog. A young woman is reading under a tree. Some children are running and laughing. A few people are boating on the lake. Everyone is enjoying the day.
translation: 这是一个晴朗的星期六。公园里有很多人。一群男孩正在踢足球。两个女孩正在放风筝。一位老人正在遛狗。一位年轻女子正在树下看书。一些孩子正在奔跑和大笑。几个人正在湖上划船。每个人都在享受这一天。

questions.stem: What are the boys doing?
questions.stemZh: 男孩们正在做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A group of boys are playing football”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where is the young woman reading?
questions.stemZh: 年轻女子在哪里看书？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A young woman is reading under a tree”，因此选A。

text: Last Sunday, the weather was sunny. My friends and I went to the beach. We played volleyball on the sand and swam in the sea. At noon, we had a picnic under an umbrella. In the afternoon, we collected shells and took photos. We went home at five. We were tired but happy.
translation: 上周日，天气晴朗。我和朋友们去了海滩。我们在沙滩上打排球，在海里游泳。中午，我们在伞下野餐。下午，我们收集贝壳，拍照。我们五点回家。我们很累但很开心。

questions.stem: What did they do in the morning?
questions.stemZh: 他们上午做了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We played volleyball on the sand and swam in the sea”，这些是上午和中午之前的主要活动，因此选B。

questions.stem: How did they feel at the end of the day?
questions.stemZh: 一天结束时他们感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We were tired but happy”，因此选B。

text: Last summer, I went to Beijing with my parents. We visited the Great Wall first. It was very long and great. Then we went to the Palace Museum. We saw many old things. We also ate Beijing Duck. It was delicious. We stayed in Beijing for three days. We had a wonderful time.
translation: 去年夏天，我和父母去了北京。我们先参观了长城。它非常长，非常壮观。然后我们去了故宫博物院。我们看到了许多古老的东西。我们还吃了北京烤鸭。它很美味。我们在北京待了三天。我们玩得很开心。

questions.stem: Who did the writer go to Beijing with?
questions.stemZh: 作者和谁一起去了北京？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I went to Beijing with my parents”，因此选C。

questions.stem: How long did they stay in Beijing?
questions.stemZh: 他们在北京待了多久？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We stayed in Beijing for three days”，因此选C。

text: Once upon a time, a farmer had a goose. The goose laid a golden egg every day. The farmer sold the eggs and became rich. But he was greedy. He wanted all the eggs at once. He killed the goose, but there was nothing inside. He lost the goose and could not get any more golden eggs. The story tells us not to be too greedy.
translation: 从前，一个农夫有一只鹅。这只鹅每天下一个金蛋。农夫卖掉金蛋，变得富有。但他很贪婪。他想一次得到所有的蛋。他杀死了鹅，但里面什么也没有。他失去了鹅，再也得不到金蛋了。这个故事告诉我们不要太贪婪。

questions.stem: Why did the farmer kill the goose?
questions.stemZh: 农夫为什么杀死了鹅？
options: He wanted all the golden eggs at once.
optionsZh: 他想一次得到所有金蛋。
questions.explanation: 短文说“He wanted all the eggs at once”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What lesson does the story teach us?
questions.stemZh: 这个故事教给我们什么道理？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“The story tells us not to be too greedy”，因此选B。

text: Last summer, my family and I went to Sanya. We went there by plane. The weather was hot and sunny. We stayed in a hotel near the beach. Every morning, we walked on the beach and swam in the sea. In the afternoon, we visited interesting places. We also tried different kinds of seafood. One day it rained, so we stayed in the hotel and played cards. We had a great holiday.
translation: 去年夏天，我和家人去了三亚。我们乘飞机去的。天气炎热晴朗。我们住在海滩附近的一家酒店。每天早上，我们在海滩上散步，在海里游泳。下午，我们参观有趣的地方。我们还品尝了不同种类的海鲜。有一天天下雨了，所以我们待在酒店里打牌。我们度过了一个很棒的假期。

questions.stem: How did the writer's family go to Sanya?
questions.stemZh: 作者一家怎么去三亚的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We went there by plane”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What did they do on the rainy day?
questions.stemZh: 下雨天他们做了什么？
options: Stayed in the hotel and played cards.
questions.explanation: 短文说“One day it rained, so we stayed in the hotel and played cards”，因此选B。

text: How often do you exercise? Doctors say exercise is necessary for everyone. You should exercise at least three times a week. Walking, running or riding a bike is enough. Exercise helps you keep a healthy weight. It also makes your heart strong. Find time to exercise. Get off the bus one stop earlier and walk home. Small changes can make a big difference.
translation: 你多久锻炼一次？医生说运动对每个人都是必要的。你应该每周至少锻炼三次。散步、跑步或骑自行车就足够了。运动帮助你保持健康的体重。它还使你的心脏强壮。找时间锻炼吧。提前一站下车走回家。小的改变能带来大的不同。

questions.stem: How often should you exercise according to doctors?
questions.stemZh: 根据医生，你应该多久锻炼一次？
options: At least three times a week.
questions.explanation: 短文说“You should exercise at least three times a week”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What is one small change mentioned in the passage?
questions.stemZh: 短文中提到的一个小改变是什么？
options: Getting off the bus one stop earlier.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Get off the bus one stop earlier and walk home”，因此选B。

text: My best friend is Linda. We are in the same class. Linda is taller and more outgoing than me. She likes telling jokes. I am quieter. But we have a lot in common. We both like reading and playing tennis. Linda is better at tennis, but I am better at maths. We often help each other. Differences make friendship more interesting.
translation: 我最好的朋友是琳达。我们在同一个班。琳达比我高，也比我外向。她喜欢讲笑话。我更安静。但我们有很多共同之处。我们都喜欢阅读和打网球。琳达网球更好，但我数学更好。我们经常互相帮助。差异让友谊更有趣。

questions.stem: Who is more outgoing?
questions.stemZh: 谁更外向？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Linda is taller and more outgoing than me”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What do Linda and the writer both like?
questions.stemZh: 琳达和作者都喜欢什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We both like reading and playing tennis”，因此选B。

text: Many everyday objects are made from natural materials. Glass is made from sand. Paper is made from wood. Cotton clothes are made from plants. But plastic is man-made. It is made from oil. Plastic is cheap and useful, but it is bad for the environment. It does not break down easily. That is why many people are trying to use less plastic.
translation: 许多日常物品由天然材料制成。玻璃由沙子制成。纸由木材制成。棉衣服由植物制成。但塑料是人造的。它由石油制成。塑料便宜又有用，但对环境有害。它不容易分解。这就是为什么许多人正在努力少用塑料。

questions.stem: What is glass made from?
questions.stemZh: 玻璃是由什么制成的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Glass is made from sand”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why is plastic bad for the environment?
questions.stemZh: 为什么塑料对环境有害？
options: It does not break down easily.
questions.explanation: 短文说“It does not break down easily”，因此选B。

text: Food is not just something we eat. It also carries memories and feelings. A bowl of noodles may remind you of your grandmother's kitchen. The smell of dumplings may bring back memories of the Spring Festival. Cooking is a way to show love. Family recipes connect us with our past and with the people we love.
translation: 食物不仅仅是我们吃的东西。它还承载着记忆和情感。一碗面条可能让你想起祖母的厨房。饺子的香味可能唤起春节的回忆。烹饪是表达爱的一种方式。家庭食谱把我们与过去以及我们爱的人联系起来。

questions.stem: What does food carry besides taste?
questions.stemZh: 食物除了味道还承载着什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“It also carries memories and feelings”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How does the writer describe cooking?
questions.stemZh: 作者如何描述烹饪？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Cooking is a way to show love”，因此选B。

text: Robots are becoming more common. Some robots can clean floors and cook meals. In factories, robots do dangerous jobs. Some people worry that robots will take away jobs. But scientists say robots will create new jobs too. People will need to learn new skills. In the future, robots and humans will probably work together.
translation: 机器人正变得越来越常见。有些机器人能打扫地板和做饭。在工厂里，机器人从事危险的工作。有些人担心机器人会夺走工作。但科学家说机器人也会创造新的工作。人们需要学习新技能。未来，机器人和人类可能会一起工作。

questions.stem: What can some robots do according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，有些机器人能做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Some robots can clean floors and cook meals”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What do scientists say about robots and jobs?
questions.stemZh: 科学家对机器人和工作怎么说？
options: Robots will create new jobs too.
People will not need to work.
optionsZh: 机器人会夺走所有工作。
机器人也会创造新的工作。
机器人什么工作都不做。
questions.explanation: 短文说“scientists say robots will create new jobs too”，因此选B。

text: How do you make a banana milk shake? First, peel three bananas. Next, cut up the bananas. Then, put the bananas and some ice cream into a blender. After that, pour some milk into the blender. Turn on the blender and wait for a few minutes. Finally, pour the milk shake into a glass and drink it. You can add some honey if you like.
translation: 你怎样制作香蕉奶昔？首先，剥三根香蕉。接下来，把香蕉切碎。然后，把香蕉和一些冰淇淋放进搅拌机。之后，往搅拌机里倒一些牛奶。打开搅拌机，等几分钟。最后，把奶昔倒进杯子里喝。如果你喜欢，可以加一些蜂蜜。

questions.stem: How many bananas do you need?
questions.stemZh: 你需要几根香蕉？
questions.answerText: Three.
questions.explanation: 短文说“peel three bananas”，因此参考答案为“Three.”。

questions.stem: What should you do after cutting up the bananas?
questions.stemZh: 切碎香蕉后你应该做什么？
questions.answerText: Put the bananas and some ice cream into a blender.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Then, put the bananas and some ice cream into a blender”，因此参考答案为该句。

text: If you go to a party, you should follow some rules. First, arrive on time. If you are late, say sorry to the host. Second, bring a small gift, like flowers or chocolates. Third, dress properly. Don't wear too casual clothes. Fourth, talk with other guests and be friendly. Finally, don't stay too late. Say goodbye and thank the host before you leave.
translation: 如果你去参加聚会，你应该遵循一些规则。首先，准时到达。如果你迟到了，向主人道歉。其次，带一份小礼物，比如花或巧克力。第三，穿着得体。不要穿太随便的衣服。第四，和其他客人交谈，要友好。最后，不要待得太晚。离开前道别并感谢主人。

questions.stem: What should you do if you are late for a party?
questions.stemZh: 如果你参加聚会迟到了应该怎么做？
questions.answerText: Say sorry to the host.
questions.explanation: 短文说“If you are late, say sorry to the host”，因此参考答案为“Say sorry to the host.”。

questions.stem: What should you do before you leave the party?
questions.stemZh: 离开聚会前你应该做什么？
questions.answerText: Say goodbye and thank the host.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Say goodbye and thank the host before you leave”，因此参考答案为该句。

text: Volunteering is a great way to help others. You can volunteer at a hospital, a library or an animal shelter. For example, you can read to sick children or walk dogs at an animal shelter. Volunteering is good for you too. It helps you learn new skills and meet new people. You don't need to be an adult to volunteer. Teenagers can also help. Even a few hours a week can make a difference.
translation: 志愿服务是帮助他人的好方法。你可以在医院、图书馆或动物收容所做志愿者。例如，你可以给生病的孩子读书，或在动物收容所遛狗。志愿服务对你自己也有好处。它帮助你学习新技能，结识新朋友。你不需要是成年人才能做志愿者。青少年也可以帮忙。即使每周几个小时也能带来不同。

questions.stem: Where can you volunteer according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，你可以在哪里做志愿者？
questions.answerText: At a hospital, a library or an animal shelter.
questions.explanation: 短文说“You can volunteer at a hospital, a library or an animal shelter”，因此参考答案为该句。

questions.stem: Why is volunteering good for you?
questions.stemZh: 为什么志愿服务对你有好处？
questions.answerText: It helps you learn new skills and meet new people.
questions.explanation: 短文说“It helps you learn new skills and meet new people”，因此参考答案为该句。

text: The Earth is in danger. People throw rubbish everywhere. Forests are disappearing. What can we do? First, reduce, reuse and recycle. Bring your own bag when shopping. Second, save water and electricity. Turn off the lights when you leave a room. Third, plant trees. Trees can clean the air. If everyone does a little, the world will be a better place.
translation: 地球处于危险之中。人们到处扔垃圾。森林正在消失。我们能做什么？首先，减少使用、重复使用和回收利用。购物时自带袋子。其次，节约水和电。离开房间时关灯。第三，种树。树木可以净化空气。如果每个人都做一点，世界将会变得更美好。

questions.stem: What is one problem mentioned in the passage?
questions.stemZh: 短文中提到的一个问题是什么？
questions.answerText: People throw rubbish everywhere. / Forests are disappearing.
questions.explanation: 短文提到“People throw rubbish everywhere”和“Forests are disappearing”，任选其一即可。

questions.stem: What should you do when you leave a room?
questions.stemZh: 离开房间时你应该做什么？
questions.answerText: Turn off the lights.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Turn off the lights when you leave a room”，因此参考答案为“Turn off the lights.”。

text: Good communication is important. First, listen carefully. When someone is talking, don't interrupt. Second, speak clearly and politely. Use words like "please" and "thank you". Third, look at the person when you talk. This shows you are interested. Fourth, if you disagree, say it in a friendly way. Don't shout or get angry. Good communication takes practice.
translation: 良好的沟通很重要。首先，认真倾听。当别人说话时，不要打断。其次，清楚而有礼貌地说话。使用“请”和“谢谢”这样的词。第三，说话时看着对方。这表明你感兴趣。第四，如果你不同意，用友好的方式说出来。不要大喊大叫或生气。良好的沟通需要练习。

questions.stem: What should you do when someone is talking?
questions.stemZh: 当别人说话时你应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“When someone is talking, don't interrupt”，即认真倾听，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should you do if you disagree with someone?
questions.stemZh: 如果你不同意某人，应该怎么做？
options: Say it in a friendly way.
questions.explanation: 短文说“if you disagree, say it in a friendly way”，因此选C。

text: Last week, Jack had a bad week. On Monday, he got up late and missed the school bus. He was late for school. On Tuesday, he forgot his homework. On Wednesday, he had a headache and went to the hospital. On Thursday, he felt better, but he lost his keys. He had to wait for his parents to come home. What a bad week!
translation: 上周，杰克度过了糟糕的一周。周一，他起床晚了，错过了校车。他上学迟到了。周二，他忘了作业。周三，他头疼，去了医院。周四，他感觉好多了，但他丢了钥匙。他不得不等父母回家。多糟糕的一周啊！

questions.stem: What happened to Jack on Monday?
questions.stemZh: 杰克周一发生了什么？
options: He missed the school bus and was late.
optionsZh: 他错过了校车并迟到了。
questions.explanation: 短文说“On Monday, he got up late and missed the school bus. He was late for school”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why did Jack go to the hospital on Wednesday?
questions.stemZh: 杰克周三为什么去医院？
questions.explanation: 短文说“On Wednesday, he had a headache and went to the hospital”，因此选A。

text: The Great Wall is one of the most famous places in the world. It is in the north of China. It is about 21,000 kilometres long. People started to build it more than 2,000 years ago to protect the country. Today, millions of visitors come to see it every year. The best time to visit is in spring or autumn.
translation: 长城是世界上最著名的地方之一。它位于中国北方。它大约21000公里长。人们开始在2000多年前建造它，以保护国家。今天，每年有数百万游客来参观。最好的参观时间是春天或秋天。

questions.stem: Where is the Great Wall?
questions.stemZh: 长城在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“It is in the north of China”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why did people build the Great Wall?
questions.stemZh: 人们为什么建造长城？
questions.explanation: 短文说“to protect the country”，因此选B。

text: Traditional stories are an important part of culture. In China, "Yu Gong Moves a Mountain" tells us never to give up. "Hou Yi Shoots the Suns" is about a hero who saves people. In the West, stories like "Cinderella" teach children to be kind and brave. Reading traditional stories helps us understand different cultures.
translation: 传统故事是文化的重要组成部分。在中国，“愚公移山”告诉我们要永不放弃。“后羿射日”讲的是一个拯救人民的英雄。在西方，“灰姑娘”这样的故事教孩子们善良和勇敢。阅读传统故事帮助我们理解不同的文化。

questions.stem: What does "Yu Gong Moves a Mountain" teach us?
questions.stemZh: “愚公移山”教给我们什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“"Yu Gong Moves a Mountain" tells us never to give up”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What do Western stories like "Cinderella" often teach children?
questions.stemZh: 像“灰姑娘”这样的西方故事常常教孩子们什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“stories like "Cinderella" teach children to be kind and brave”，因此选B。

text: Technology has changed our lives. Smartphones are one of the most important inventions. We can use them to call people, send messages, take photos and go online. But technology also has problems. Some people spend too much time on their phones. This is bad for their eyes and health. We should use technology wisely. Technology is a tool, not a toy.
translation: 科技改变了我们的生活。智能手机是最重要的发明之一。我们可以用它们打电话、发信息、拍照和上网。但科技也有问题。有些人花太多时间在手机上。这对他们的眼睛和健康有害。我们应该明智地使用科技。科技是工具，不是玩具。

questions.stem: What can we use smartphones to do?
questions.stemZh: 我们可以用智能手机做什么？
options: Call people, send messages, take photos and go online.
optionsZh: 打电话、发信息、拍照和上网。
questions.explanation: 短文说“We can use them to call people, send messages, take photos and go online”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer think technology is?
questions.stemZh: 作者认为科技是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“Technology is a tool, not a toy”，因此选B。

text: Different countries have different customs. In China, people usually shake hands when they meet for the first time. In Japan, people bow. In France, people often kiss on the cheek. When you visit a Chinese family, you should bring a small gift. But don't give a clock. Learning about customs helps us communicate better with people from other countries.
translation: 不同的国家有不同的习俗。在中国，人们第一次见面时通常握手。在日本，人们鞠躬。在法国，人们常常亲吻脸颊。当你拜访中国家庭时，你应该带一份小礼物。但不要送钟。了解习俗帮助我们更好地与其他国家的人交流。

questions.stem: What do people do when they meet for the first time in Japan?
questions.stemZh: 在日本，人们第一次见面时做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“In Japan, people bow”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What gift should you NOT give a Chinese family?
questions.stemZh: 你不应该送给中国家庭什么礼物？
questions.explanation: 短文说“don't give a clock”，因此选B。

text: I have had this bike for three years. It was a birthday present from my parents. I like it because it is blue. I ride it to school every day. It takes me about fifteen minutes. On weekends, I ride it to the park with my friends. I take good care of it. I clean it every week and put it in the garage when I don't use it.
translation: 这辆自行车我已经拥有三年了。它是我父母送给我的生日礼物。我喜欢它，因为它是蓝色的。我每天骑它上学。大约需要十五分钟。周末，我和朋友们骑它去公园。我好好照顾它。我每周清洁它，不用时把它放在车库里。

questions.stem: How long has the writer had the bike?
questions.stemZh: 作者拥有这辆自行车多久了？
questions.answerText: For three years.
questions.explanation: 短文说“I have had this bike for three years”，因此参考答案为“For three years.”。

questions.stem: What does the writer do with the bike every week?
questions.stemZh: 作者每周对自行车做什么？
questions.answerText: The writer cleans it every week.
questions.explanation: 短文说“I clean it every week”，因此参考答案为“The writer cleans it every week.”。

text: Wei Fen used to be afraid of learning English. She didn't understand her teacher because the teacher spoke too fast. Then one day, she watched an English movie. She loved it and wanted to understand the actors. She started to watch English movies and repeat the sentences. She also read English books. Slowly, she improved. Now she is one of the best English students in her class.
translation: 魏芬过去害怕学英语。她听不懂老师的话，因为老师说太快了。后来有一天，她看了一部英语电影。她喜欢它，想听懂演员的话。她开始看英语电影并重复句子。她还读英语书。慢慢地，她进步了。现在她是班上英语最好的学生之一。

questions.stem: Why didn't Wei Fen understand her teacher at first?
questions.stemZh: 魏芬一开始为什么听不懂老师的话？
questions.explanation: 短文说“She didn't understand her teacher because the teacher spoke too fast”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What changed Wei Fen's attitude towards English?
questions.stemZh: 什么改变了魏芬对英语的态度？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Then one day, she watched an English movie. She loved it”，这部电影促使她开始努力学习，因此选A。

text: The Mid-Autumn Festival is on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month. Families get together and eat mooncakes. Mooncakes are round, like the full moon. They symbolize reunion and happiness. There is a famous story about Chang'e, a woman who flew to the moon. People admire the moon and tell stories. The festival is a time for family and thanks.
translation: 中秋节在农历八月十五。家人团聚，吃月饼。月饼是圆的，像满月。它们象征团圆和幸福。有一个关于嫦娥的著名故事，一个飞上月亮的女子。人们赏月、讲故事。这个节日是家庭和感恩的时刻。

questions.stem: When is the Mid-Autumn Festival?
questions.stemZh: 中秋节是什么时候？
options: On the 1st day of the 1st lunar month.
On the 15th day of the 8th lunar month.
On the 5th day of the 5th lunar month.
On the 15th day of the 1st lunar month.
questions.explanation: 短文说“The Mid-Autumn Festival is on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What do mooncakes symbolize?
questions.stemZh: 月饼象征什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They symbolize reunion and happiness”，因此选B。

text: Excuse me, could you tell me where the nearest bank is? Walk along this street and turn left at the second crossing. The bank is on your right, between a bookstore and a restaurant. If you want to go to the post office, go past the bank and turn right. You will see it on your left. There is a supermarket next to the post office.
translation: 打扰一下，你能告诉我最近的银行在哪里吗？沿着这条街走，在第二个十字路口左转。银行在你的右边，在书店和餐馆之间。如果你想去邮局，经过银行后右转。你会看到它在你的左边。邮局旁边有一家超市。

questions.stem: Where is the bank?
questions.stemZh: 银行在哪里？
options: On the left of the street.
Between a bookstore and a restaurant.
questions.explanation: 短文说“It is between a bookstore and a restaurant”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where is the supermarket?
questions.stemZh: 超市在哪里？
options: Between the bank and the restaurant.
questions.explanation: 短文说“There is a supermarket next to the post office”，因此选B。

text: I used to be afraid of the dark. When I was little, I always asked my parents to leave the light on. I also used to be shy. I was afraid to speak in class. But things have changed. Now I can sleep with the light off. I have joined the school debate club and I can speak confidently in public. I think I have learned to face my fears.
translation: 我过去怕黑。小时候，我总是让父母开着灯。我也曾经很害羞。我不敢在课堂上发言。但事情已经改变了。现在我可以关灯睡觉。我加入了学校辩论社，我可以在公共场合自信地发言。我认为我学会了面对恐惧。

questions.stem: What was the writer afraid of when little?
questions.stemZh: 作者小时候害怕什么？
options: The dark and speaking in class.
questions.explanation: 短文说“I used to be afraid of the dark”和“I was afraid to speak in class”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does the writer do now that shows confidence?
questions.stemZh: 作者现在做了什么表明自信？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I have joined the school debate club and I can speak confidently in public”，因此选B。

text: What are shirts made of? They are made of cotton or silk. Cotton comes from plants, and silk comes from silkworms. Glass is made from sand. Paper is made from wood. Plastic is man-made. It is cheap but bad for the environment because it does not break down easily. We should use fewer plastic bags.
translation: 衬衫是用什么制成的？它们由棉或丝绸制成。棉来自植物，丝绸来自蚕。玻璃由沙子制成。纸由木材制成。塑料是人造的。它便宜但对环境有害，因为它不容易分解。我们应该少用塑料袋。

questions.stem: What are shirts made of according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，衬衫是用什么制成的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They are made of cotton or silk”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why is plastic bad for the environment?
questions.stemZh: 为什么塑料对环境有害？
options: It does not break down easily.
questions.explanation: 短文说“it does not break down easily”，因此选B。

text: Tea was first discovered in China. According to an old story, Emperor Shen Nong discovered tea when leaves fell into his hot water. Today, people in many countries drink tea. In China, people like green tea. In Britain, people drink tea with milk and sugar. In Japan, there is a special tea ceremony. Tea is not just a drink; it is a part of culture.
translation: 茶最早在中国被发现。根据一个古老的故事，神农皇帝在叶子掉进热水时发现了茶。今天，许多国家的人喝茶。在中国，人们喜欢绿茶。在英国，人们加牛奶和糖喝茶。在日本，有一种特殊的茶道。茶不仅仅是一种饮料；它也是文化的一部分。

questions.stem: Where was tea first discovered?
questions.stemZh: 茶最早在哪里被发现？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Tea was first discovered in China”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How do British people like to drink tea?
questions.stemZh: 英国人喜欢怎么喝茶？
questions.explanation: 短文说“In Britain, people drink tea with milk and sugar”，因此选A。

text: Teenagers should be allowed to make some decisions, but they should also follow rules. For example, teenagers should be allowed to choose their own clothes. But they should not be allowed to get their ears pierced without permission. Parents and teenagers may disagree, but talking calmly can help. The key is to find a balance between freedom and responsibility.
translation: 应该允许青少年做一些决定，但他们也应该遵守规则。例如，应该允许青少年选择自己的衣服。但不应该允许他们未经允许打耳洞。父母和青少年可能意见不同，但平静地交谈会有帮助。关键是在自由和责任之间找到平衡。

questions.stem: What should teenagers be allowed to do according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，应该允许青少年做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“teenagers should be allowed to choose their own clothes”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is the key according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，关键是什么？
options: A balance between freedom and responsibility.
optionsZh: 自由和责任之间的平衡。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“The key is to find a balance between freedom and responsibility”，因此选C。

text: One day, a poor man found a magic lamp. A genie came out and said, "I will give you three wishes." The man wished for money, a big house and a beautiful car. He got them all, but he was still unhappy. He had no friends. He realized that money cannot buy happiness. He used his last wish to ask for true friends. From then on, he lived happily.
translation: 有一天，一个穷人找到了一盏神灯。一个精灵出来了，说：“我会给你三个愿望。”这个人许愿要钱、一栋大房子和一辆漂亮的汽车。他得到了所有，但仍然不快乐。他没有朋友。他意识到金钱买不到幸福。他用最后一个愿望祈求真正的朋友。从那时起，他幸福地生活着。

questions.stem: How many wishes did the genie give the man?
questions.stemZh: 精灵给了这个人几个愿望？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I will give you three wishes”，因此选C。

questions.stem: Why was the man still unhappy after getting money, a house and a car?
questions.stemZh: 为什么这个人在得到钱、房子和车之后仍然不快乐？
questions.explanation: 短文说“He had no friends”，因此选B。

text: Music is good for us in many ways. It can make us feel happy or relaxed. When we are sad, soft music can help us feel better. When we are tired, upbeat music can give us energy. Some studies show that listening to music while studying can improve concentration. But loud and noisy music may distract you. Choose the right kind of music.
translation: 音乐在很多方面对我们有好处。它能让我们感到快乐或放松。当我们悲伤时，轻柔的音乐可以帮助我们感觉好一些。当我们疲倦时，欢快的音乐可以给我们能量。一些研究表明，学习时听音乐可以提高注意力。但响亮嘈杂的音乐可能会让你分心。选择正确的音乐类型。

questions.stem: What kind of music can help us when we are sad?
questions.stemZh: 当我们悲伤时，哪种音乐可以帮助我们？
questions.explanation: 短文说“When we are sad, soft music can help us feel better”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What kind of music may distract you?
questions.stemZh: 哪种音乐可能会让你分心？
questions.explanation: 短文说“loud and noisy music may distract you”，因此选C。

text: Different countries have different table manners. In China, people use chopsticks and share dishes. In Western countries, people use knives and forks. Everyone has their own plate. When you eat in a Western restaurant, put your napkin on your lap. Don't make noise when you eat soup. When you finish, put your knife and fork together on the plate. Table manners show respect for others.
translation: 不同的国家有不同的餐桌礼仪。在中国，人们使用筷子，分享菜肴。在西方国家，人们使用刀叉。每个人有自己的盘子。当你在西餐厅吃饭时，把餐巾放在腿上。喝汤时不要发出声音。吃完后，把刀叉一起放在盘子上。餐桌礼仪表示对他人的尊重。

questions.stem: What do people use to eat in China?
questions.stemZh: 在中国人们用什么吃饭？
questions.explanation: 短文说“In China, people use chopsticks”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where should you put your napkin in a Western restaurant?
questions.stemZh: 在西餐厅你应该把餐巾放在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“put your napkin on your lap”，因此选B。

text: We are trying to save the Earth. There are many environmental problems. Factories put waste into rivers and the air. Too much rubbish is not recycled. What can we do? Turn off the tap when you brush your teeth. Use both sides of the paper. Take your own bag to the supermarket. Ride a bike or walk instead of taking a car. Small actions can make a big difference.
translation: 我们正在努力拯救地球。有许多环境问题。工厂把废物排入河流和空气中。太多垃圾没有被回收。我们能做什么？刷牙时关掉水龙头。用纸的两面。去超市时自带袋子。骑自行车或步行代替开车。小的行动能带来大的不同。

questions.stem: What environmental problem is mentioned?
questions.stemZh: 提到了什么环境问题？
options: Factories put waste into rivers and the air.
optionsZh: 工厂把废物排入河流和空气中。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Factories put waste into rivers and the air”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How can you save paper?
questions.stemZh: 你怎样节约纸张？
options: Use both sides of the paper.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Use both sides of the paper”，因此选A。

text: Last Friday, I planned to go to a concert. But when I was about to leave, it started to rain heavily. I couldn't find my umbrella. I decided to take a taxi. On the way, there was a traffic jam. When I arrived, the concert was almost over. I missed most of it. But my friend was waiting outside. She said, "It's OK. We can go next time." I felt much better.
translation: 上周五，我计划去听音乐会。但当我正要出门时，天开始下大雨。我找不到雨伞。我决定打车。路上堵车了。当我到达时，音乐会几乎结束了。我错过了大部分。但我的朋友在外面等着。她说：“没关系。我们下次可以去。”我感觉好多了。

questions.stem: Why was the writer late for the concert?
questions.stemZh: 作者为什么音乐会迟到？
options: She took a taxi but there was a traffic jam.
She went to the wrong place.
questions.explanation: 短文说“I decided to take a taxi. On the way, there was a traffic jam”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How did the writer's friend make her feel better?
questions.stemZh: 作者的朋友如何让她感觉好一些？
options: By saying they could go next time.
questions.explanation: 短文说朋友告诉她“It's OK. We can go next time”，因此选B。

text: I remember meeting all of you in Grade 7. At that time, we were shy and nervous. But over the past three years, we have grown up together. Our teachers have helped us a lot. They have taught us knowledge and how to be good people. Now we are leaving school. I feel sad but also excited. I hope we will all have a bright future.
translation: 我记得在七年级遇见你们所有人。那时，我们害羞又紧张。但在过去的三年里，我们一起成长。我们的老师帮助了我们很多。他们教我们知识，也教我们如何做个好人。现在我们即将离开学校。我感到伤心但也兴奋。我希望我们都有一个光明的未来。

questions.stem: How did the students feel in Grade 7?
questions.stemZh: 学生们在七年级时感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文说“At that time, we were shy and nervous”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What have the teachers taught the students?
questions.stemZh: 老师教了学生什么？
options: Knowledge and how to be good people.
questions.explanation: 短文说“They have taught us knowledge and how to be good people”，因此选B。

text: Life is full of the unexpected. Sometimes things don't go as planned. You may plan to go to a party, but your car breaks down. What should you do? First, stay calm. Don't get angry or upset. Second, think about what you can do to solve the problem. Third, learn from the experience. Ask yourself, "What can I do differently next time?" Unexpected things can teach us important lessons and make us stronger.
translation: 生活充满了意外。有时事情不会按计划进行。你可能计划去参加聚会，但你的车坏了。你应该怎么做？首先，保持冷静。不要生气或难过。其次，想想你能做什么来解决问题。第三，从经历中学习。问自己：“下次我能做什么不同？”意外可以教我们重要的道理，让我们更强大。

questions.stem: What should you do first when something unexpected happens?
questions.stemZh: 当意外发生时你首先应该做什么？
questions.answerText: Stay calm.
questions.explanation: 短文说“First, stay calm”，因此参考答案为“Stay calm.”。

questions.stem: What can unexpected things do for us?
questions.stemZh: 意外能为我们做什么？
questions.answerText: They can teach us important lessons and make us stronger.
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“Unexpected things can teach us important lessons and make us stronger”，因此参考答案为该句。

text: Hello! My name is Emma. I am twelve years old. I am a new student at Green Middle School. Today is my first day here. I am a little nervous. At the school gate, I meet a girl. She smiles and says, "Hi! I'm Lucy. Nice to meet you!" I smile back and say, "Hi, Lucy. I'm Emma. Nice to meet you, too." Lucy is friendly. She shows me the way to my classroom. In the classroom, our teacher, Ms. Brown, asks us to introduce ourselves. I stand up and say, "Hello, everyone! I'm Emma. I like drawing and playing badminton. I hope we can be good friends." Everyone claps. I feel happy and relaxed now.
translation: 你好！我叫艾玛。我十二岁。我是格林中学的一名新生。今天是我在这里的第一天。我有点紧张。在校门口，我遇到一个女孩。她微笑着说道：“嗨！我是露西。很高兴见到你！”我也微笑着说：“嗨，露西。我是艾玛。我也很高兴见到你。”露西很友好。她给我指了去教室的路。在教室里，我们的老师布朗女士让我们自我介绍。我站起来说：“大家好！我是艾玛。我喜欢画画和打羽毛球。我希望我们能成为好朋友。”大家鼓掌。我现在感到开心又放松。

questions.stem: How does Emma feel before she meets Lucy?
questions.stemZh: 艾玛在遇到露西之前感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文在介绍完自己是新生后说“I am a little nervous”，随后才遇到露西，因此选A。

questions.stem: Who shows Emma the way to the classroom?
questions.stemZh: 谁给艾玛指了去教室的路？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Lucy is friendly. She shows me the way to my classroom”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does Emma like doing?
questions.stemZh: 艾玛喜欢做什么？
questions.explanation: 艾玛在自我介绍时说“I like drawing and playing badminton”，因此选C。

questions.stem: How does Emma feel at the end of the passage?
questions.stemZh: 短文结尾艾玛感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文最后一句说“I feel happy and relaxed now”，因此选B。

text: Last summer, my parents and I went to a small village in Yunnan for a volunteer holiday. We stayed there for ten days. The village was quiet and beautiful, with green hills and a clean river. We helped the local children with their English. Every morning, I read English stories to them and taught them simple songs. In the afternoon, we played games and drew pictures together. The children were shy at first, but soon they became friendly and active. I also learned something from them. They knew the names of many plants and animals that I had never heard of. On the last day, the children made a card for me. It said, "Thank you, big sister. Please come back." I felt so moved that I almost cried. This trip taught me that helping others can bring us true happiness.
translation: 去年夏天，我和父母去了云南的一个小村庄，度过了一个志愿者假期。我们在那里待了十天。村庄安静而美丽，有绿色的山丘和一条清澈的河流。我们帮助当地的孩子们学英语。每天早上，我给他们读英语故事，教他们简单的歌曲。下午，我们一起玩游戏、画画。孩子们起初很害羞，但很快就变得友好和活跃。我也从他们那里学到了一些东西。他们知道许多我从未听说过的动植物的名字。最后一天，孩子们给我做了一张卡片。上面写着：“谢谢你，大姐姐。请再回来。”我感动得几乎哭了。这次旅行教会我，帮助别人能给我们带来真正的快乐。

questions.stem: How long did the writer stay in the village?
questions.stemZh: 作者在村庄待了多久？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We stayed there for ten days”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What did the writer do every morning?
questions.stemZh: 作者每天早上做什么？
options: Read English stories and taught songs.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Every morning, I read English stories to them and taught them simple songs”，因此选C。

questions.stem: How did the children change during the trip?
questions.stemZh: 孩子们在旅行期间发生了怎样的变化？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The children were shy at first, but soon they became friendly and active”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What did the writer learn from the trip?
questions.stemZh: 作者从这次旅行中学到了什么？
options: Yunnan is a good place for holidays.
Helping others can bring true happiness.
English is difficult for village children.
optionsZh: 帮助别人能带来真正的快乐。
英语对村庄孩子来说很难。
questions.explanation: 短文最后一句说“This trip taught me that helping others can bring us true happiness”，因此选C。

text: Two years ago, I never helped with housework at home. I thought studying was my only job. After school, I threw my schoolbag on the sofa and watched TV. My mother did all the chores alone, and she always looked tired. One rainy evening, I saw my mother sweeping the floor and washing bowls after a long day's work. I felt sorry for her. I decided to change. Now I have my own family tasks every week. On weekdays, I take out the rubbish after dinner and fold my school uniform. On weekends, I help sweep the living room and water the plants. Sometimes I even cook simple eggs for my family. My parents are happy with my change. I find that doing chores does not waste my study time. It makes our home warm and teaches me to care for my family. Home is not only my parents' place, but mine too.
translation: 两年前，我在家从不帮忙做家务。我以为学习是我唯一的工作。放学后，我把书包扔在沙发上就看电视。我妈妈一个人做所有的家务，她看起来总是很累。一个下雨的晚上，我看到妈妈在工作了一整天后还在扫地洗碗。我为她感到难过。我决定改变。现在每周我都有自己的家庭任务。工作日，晚饭后我倒垃圾、叠校服。周末，我帮忙扫客厅、给植物浇水。有时我甚至给家人煮简单的鸡蛋。我的父母对我的改变很满意。我发现做家务并不浪费我的学习时间。它让我们的家变得温暖，也教会我关心家人。家不仅是父母的地方，也是我的地方。

questions.stem: What did the writer use to do after school two years ago?
questions.stemZh: 两年前作者放学后通常做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“After school, I threw my schoolbag on the sofa and watched TV”，并且“I never helped with housework”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why did the writer decide to change?
questions.stemZh: 作者为什么决定改变？
options: He saw his mother working hard and felt sorry.
He wanted to get money from his parents.
His teacher told him to do so.
optionsZh: 他看到妈妈辛苦工作，感到难过。
他想从父母那里得到钱。
questions.explanation: 短文说“I saw my mother sweeping the floor and washing bowls after a long day's work. I felt sorry for her. I decided to change”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer do on weekdays now?
questions.stemZh: 作者现在工作日做什么？
options: Takes out the rubbish and folds his uniform.
questions.explanation: 短文说“On weekdays, I take out the rubbish after dinner and fold my school uniform”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What does the writer think of doing chores now?
questions.stemZh: 作者现在怎么看待做家务？
options: It makes his home warm and teaches him to care for family.
It is too tiring for students.
optionsZh: 让家变得温暖，并教会他关心家人。
questions.explanation: 短文说“It makes our home warm and teaches me to care for my family”，因此选B。

text: Different people have different ideas about friends. Some people like to have friends who are similar to them. Others prefer friends who are different. Susan is an outgoing girl. Her best friend Linda is also outgoing and hard-working. They both like travelling. Susan says, "We understand each other easily because we are so alike." But Matt has a different opinion. His best friend Stephen is very different from him. Matt is quiet and careful, while Stephen is loud and funny. Matt says, "Stephen helps me see things in new ways. Without him, my life would be boring." In fact, both similar and different friends are important. Similar friends make us feel understood, and different friends help us grow. The most important thing is not whether friends are the same or different, but whether they truly care about each other.
translation: 不同的人对朋友有不同的看法。有些人喜欢和自己相似的朋友。另一些人则更喜欢不同的朋友。苏珊是一个外向的女孩。她最好的朋友琳达也外向又勤奋。她们都喜欢旅行。苏珊说：“因为我们太像了，所以我们很容易理解彼此。”但马特有不同的看法。他最好的朋友斯蒂芬和他很不一样。马特安静又细心，而斯蒂芬大声又风趣。马特说：“斯蒂芬帮助我用新的方式看事情。没有他，我的生活会很无聊。”事实上，相似的朋友和不同的朋友都很重要。相似的朋友让我们感到被理解，不同的朋友帮助我们成长。最重要的不是朋友是相同还是不同，而是他们是否真正在乎彼此。

questions.stem: What kind of friend does Susan like to have?
questions.stemZh: 苏珊喜欢有什么样的朋友？
options: Friends who are different from her.
Friends who are similar to her.
Friends who are older than her.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Susan is an outgoing girl. Her best friend Linda is also outgoing and hard-working. They both like travelling. Susan says, 'We understand each other easily because we are so alike'”，说明苏珊喜欢和自己相似的朋友，因此选B。

questions.stem: How is Stephen different from Matt?
questions.stemZh: 斯蒂芬和马特有什么不同？
options: Stephen is quiet and careful, but Matt is loud and funny.
Stephen is loud and funny, but Matt is quiet and careful.
Stephen likes travelling, but Matt doesn't.
Stephen is outgoing, but Matt is shy.
optionsZh: 斯蒂芬安静细心，但马特大声风趣。
斯蒂芬大声风趣，但马特安静细心。
斯蒂芬喜欢旅行，但马特不喜欢。
斯蒂芬外向，但马特害羞。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Matt is quiet and careful, while Stephen is loud and funny”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does Matt think of his friend Stephen?
questions.stemZh: 马特怎么看待他的朋友斯蒂芬？
options: Stephen helps him see things in new ways.
Stephen is too noisy to be a good friend.
optionsZh: 斯蒂芬让他的生活变得无聊。
斯蒂芬帮助他用新的方式看事情。
斯蒂芬太吵了，不适合做朋友。
questions.explanation: 短文引用马特的话“Stephen helps me see things in new ways”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is the most important thing in friendship according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，友谊中最重要的是什么？
options: Friends truly care about each other.
questions.explanation: 短文最后一句说“The most important thing is not whether friends are the same or different, but whether they truly care about each other”，因此选C。

text: My hometown has changed a lot over the past twenty years. When I was a child, the roads were narrow and dirty. Most families lived in small, old houses. There was only one small shop in the village, and we had to walk a long way to buy things. Few people had cars. Now everything is different. The roads are wide and clean. Many families have moved into new apartments. There is a big supermarket near the village, and almost every family has a car. The river, which used to be dirty, is clean again.
