There are trees and flowers along the river. My grandfather says, "I never imagined our village could be so beautiful." However, some things have not changed. The people are still friendly and warm. Neighbours still help each other. I think this is the most important thing. A place can change, but the spirit of the people can stay the same.
translation: 在过去二十年里，我的家乡发生了很大变化。当我还是个孩子时，道路又窄又脏。大多数家庭住在又小又旧的房子里。村里只有一家小商店，我们得走很远的路去买东西。很少有人有汽车。现在一切都不一样了。道路又宽又干净。许多家庭搬进了新公寓。村庄附近有一个大超市，几乎每个家庭都有汽车。那条过去很脏的河流又变干净了。河边有树和花。我的祖父说：“我从没想过我们的村庄能变得这么美。”然而，有些东西没有变。人们仍然友好热情。邻居们仍然互相帮助。我认为这是最重要的。一个地方可以改变，但人们的精神可以保持不变。

questions.stem: What were the roads like when the writer was a child?
questions.stemZh: 作者小时候道路是什么样的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“When I was a child, the roads were narrow and dirty”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer's grandfather say about the village?
questions.stemZh: 作者的祖父对村庄说了什么？
options: He never imagined it could be so beautiful.
He thinks it was better in the past.
He doesn't like the new supermarket.
optionsZh: 他从没想过它能这么美。
questions.explanation: 短文引用祖父的话“I never imagined our village could be so beautiful”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What has NOT changed according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，什么没有改变？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The people are still friendly and warm. Neighbours still help each other”，这是没有改变的部分，因此选C。

questions.stem: What does the writer think is the most important thing?
questions.stemZh: 作者认为最重要的是什么？
options: The spirit of the people staying the same.
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“I think this is the most important thing. A place can change, but the spirit of the people can stay the same”，因此选C。

text: Zhang Guiying is a 76-year-old woman from Yunnan. She has spent the past eight years making more than 1,000 hand-made "worry dolls" and sending them for free to sick children across China. Zhang first got the idea in 2018 after she visited a children's hospital. She saw many sick children staying in bed all day, feeling lonely and scared. She remembered that when she was young, her mother made small cloth dolls for her to cheer her up. "A small doll can't cure illness, but it can give kids a little warmth," Zhang said. Every morning, Zhang sits by her window to cut cloth, sew and paint dolls. Each doll is about 10 cm tall, with a big smile and bright clothes. She also writes a small encouraging note and puts it in each box. Over the years, Zhang has received many letters and drawings from the children. One child wrote, "When I hold the doll, I feel like someone is holding my hand." Zhang says she will keep making dolls as long as her hands can move.
translation: 张桂英是一位来自云南的76岁老人。在过去的八年里，她制作了1000多个手工“烦恼娃娃”，并免费寄给全国各地的生病儿童。张桂英最初是在2018年参观一家儿童医院后有了这个想法。她看到许多生病的孩子整天躺在床上，感到孤独和害怕。她想起自己年轻时，母亲为她做小布娃娃来让她开心。张桂英说：“一个小娃娃不能治病，但它能给孩子一点温暖。”每天早上，张桂英坐在窗边剪布、缝制和画娃娃。每个娃娃大约10厘米高，有大大的笑容和鲜艳的衣服。她还会写一张小小的鼓励纸条，放在每个盒子里。多年来，张桂英收到了许多来自孩子们的信和画。一个孩子写道：“当我抱着娃娃时，感觉就像有人在握着我的手。”张桂英说，只要她的手还能动，她就会继续做娃娃。

questions.stem: What does Zhang Guiying make for sick children?
questions.stemZh: 张桂英为生病的孩子们制作什么？
questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“She has spent the past eight years making more than 1,000 hand-made 'worry dolls'”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why did Zhang start making dolls?
questions.stemZh: 张桂英为什么开始做娃娃？
options: She saw sick children feeling lonely and scared.
A hospital paid her to do it.
optionsZh: 她看到生病的孩子感到孤独和害怕。
一家医院付钱让她做的。
questions.explanation: 短文说“She saw many sick children staying in bed all day, feeling lonely and scared”，这促使她开始制作娃娃，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does Zhang put in each box besides the doll?
questions.stemZh: 除了娃娃，张桂英还在每个盒子里放什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“She also writes a small encouraging note and puts it in each box”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What can we learn from Zhang Guiying's story?
questions.stemZh: 从张桂英的故事中我们可以学到什么？
options: Old people should stay at home.
Small acts of kindness can bring warmth to others.
Making dolls is a good way to make money.
optionsZh: 小小的善举能给他人带来温暖。
做娃娃是赚钱的好方法。
生病的孩子无法得到帮助。
questions.explanation: 张桂英通过制作娃娃给生病的孩子送去温暖，短文引用她的话“it can give kids a little warmth”，这体现了小小的善举能带来温暖，因此选B。

text: Hello, boys and girls! Welcome to Sunshine Middle School. My name is Ms. Li. I am your English teacher. In my class, you will learn to say hello, introduce yourself and talk about your favourite things. You will also sing English songs and play games. Please bring your English book, a notebook and a pen to every class. I hope we will have a good time together. If you have any questions, you can ask me after class.
translation: 同学们好！欢迎来到阳光中学。我叫李老师。我是你们的英语老师。在我的课上，你们将学习打招呼、介绍自己以及谈论你们最喜欢的事物。你们还会唱英文歌、玩游戏。请每节课都带上英语书、一个笔记本和一支笔。我希望我们能一起度过愉快的时光。如果有任何问题，你们可以在课后问我。

questions.stem: Who is Ms. Li?
questions.stemZh: 李老师是谁？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I am your English teacher”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should students bring to every class?
questions.stemZh: 学生每节课应该带什么？
options: An English book, a notebook and a pen.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Please bring your English book, a notebook and a pen to every class”，因此选B。

text: A tidy room is important. It helps you find your things quickly and makes you feel good. How can you keep your room tidy? First, put your clothes in the wardrobe. Second, put your books on the shelf. Third, put your toys in the box. Fourth, clean your desk every evening. Don't leave rubbish on it. If you do these things every day, your room will always look nice.
translation: 整洁的房间很重要。它帮助你快速找到东西，让你感觉良好。你怎样保持房间整洁？首先，把衣服放进衣柜。其次，把书放在书架上。第三，把玩具放进盒子里。第四，每天晚上清理书桌。不要把垃圾留在上面。如果你每天做这些事情，你的房间就会一直看起来很棒。

questions.stem: Where should you put your books?
questions.stemZh: 你应该把书放在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“put your books on the shelf”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should you do every evening?
questions.stemZh: 你每天晚上应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“clean your desk every evening”，因此选A。

text: This is my uncle's farm. It is not very big, but it is beautiful. On the farm, you can see many animals. There are twelve pigs, twenty chickens and eight cows. The pigs are pink and fat. The chickens are small and white. The cows are black and white. My uncle also has a dog. Its name is Lucky. Lucky is friendly. It runs around the farm all day. I like the farm very much. I often go there on weekends.
translation: 这是我叔叔的农场。它不太大，但很美。在农场里，你可以看到许多动物。有十二头猪、二十只鸡和八头奶牛。猪是粉色的，很胖。鸡是白色的小个子。奶牛是黑白相间的。我叔叔还有一只狗。它的名字叫幸运。幸运很友好。它整天在农场里跑来跑去。我非常喜欢这个农场。我经常在周末去那里。

questions.stem: How many pigs are there on the farm?
questions.stemZh: 农场里有多少头猪？
questions.explanation: 短文说“There are twelve pigs”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is the dog's name?
questions.stemZh: 狗的名字是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Its name is Lucky”，因此选A。

text: My name is Jack. I am twelve. I have a new friend at school. His name is Eric. Eric is from Australia. He is tall and has short blonde hair. He is good at sports. He can play basketball and football very well. I am not good at sports, but I am good at maths. Eric often helps me with my basketball, and I help him with his maths homework. We are different, but we are good friends. After school, we often play together in the playground. I am happy to have Eric as my friend.
translation: 我叫杰克。我十二岁。我在学校有一个新朋友。他叫埃里克。埃里克来自澳大利亚。他个子高，留着金色短发。他擅长运动。他篮球和足球都打得很好。我不擅长运动，但我擅长数学。埃里克经常帮我练篮球，我帮他做数学作业。我们不同，但我们是好朋友。放学后，我们经常一起在操场上玩。我很高兴有埃里克这个朋友。

questions.stem: Where is Eric from?
questions.stemZh: 埃里克来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Eric is from Australia”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is Jack good at?
questions.stemZh: 杰克擅长什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I am good at maths”，因此选C。

questions.stem: How do Jack and Eric help each other?
questions.stemZh: 杰克和埃里克如何互相帮助？
options: Eric helps Jack with maths, and Jack helps Eric with basketball.
Eric helps Jack with basketball, and Jack helps Eric with maths.
They help each other with English.
optionsZh: 埃里克帮杰克学数学，杰克帮埃里克练篮球。
埃里克帮杰克练篮球，杰克帮埃里克学数学。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Eric often helps me with my basketball, and I help him with his maths homework”，因此选B。

text: My name is Lucy. I have a big and happy family. There are seven people in my family: my grandparents, my parents, my aunt, my cousin and me. My grandfather is seventy years old. He likes walking in the park every morning. My grandmother is good at cooking. She often makes dumplings for us. My father is a doctor, and my mother is a nurse. They work in the same hospital. My aunt is a teacher. She teaches music at a primary school. My cousin is only four years old. He is cute and funny. We all love him very much. On Sundays, we often have a big dinner together.
translation: 我叫露西。我有一个幸福的大家庭。我家有七口人：我的祖父母、我的父母、我的姑姑、我的表弟和我。我的祖父七十岁了。他喜欢每天早上在公园散步。我的祖母擅长做饭。她经常给我们包饺子。我的父亲是一名医生，我的母亲是一名护士。他们在同一家医院工作。我的姑姑是一名老师。她在一所小学教音乐。我的表弟只有四岁。他可爱又风趣。我们都很爱他。星期天，我们经常一起吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。

questions.stem: How many people are there in Lucy's family?
questions.stemZh: 露西家有几口人？
questions.explanation: 短文说“There are seven people in my family”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What is Lucy's mother?
questions.stemZh: 露西的母亲是做什么的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“my mother is a nurse”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What does Lucy's grandmother often make?
questions.stemZh: 露西的祖母经常做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“She often makes dumplings for us”，因此选B。

text: My school is big and beautiful. There are five buildings in it: three teaching buildings, a library and a dining hall. My classroom is in the second teaching building. It is on the third floor. There is a big playground behind the teaching buildings. We do morning exercises there every day. The library is between the first and second teaching buildings. It has thousands of books. I often borrow storybooks there. The dining hall is next to the library. We have lunch there at twelve o'clock. I love my school because it is clean and my teachers are friendly.
translation: 我的学校又大又漂亮。里面有五栋楼：三栋教学楼、一个图书馆和一个食堂。我的教室在第二栋教学楼里。它在三楼。教学楼后面有一个大操场。我们每天在那里做早操。图书馆在第一栋和第二栋教学楼之间。它有成千上万本书。我经常在那里借故事书。食堂在图书馆旁边。我们十二点在那里吃午饭。我爱我的学校，因为它很干净，我的老师们也很友好。

questions.stem: Where is the library?
questions.stemZh: 图书馆在哪里？
options: Between the first and second teaching buildings.
optionsZh: 在第一栋和第二栋教学楼之间。
questions.explanation: 短文说“The library is between the first and second teaching buildings”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer often do in the library?
questions.stemZh: 作者经常在图书馆做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I often borrow storybooks there”，因此选C。

questions.stem: Why does the writer love the school?
questions.stemZh: 作者为什么爱这所学校？
options: It is clean and teachers are friendly.
It is near the writer's home.
It has a big dining hall.
optionsZh: 它很干净，老师也很友好。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“I love my school because it is clean and my teachers are friendly”，因此选B。

text: Different students have different favourite subjects. Amy's favourite subject is English. She thinks it is interesting and useful. She often listens to English songs and watches English cartoons. Tom likes maths best. He says maths is like a game. He enjoys solving difficult problems. Jack's favourite subject is PE. He loves playing basketball and running. He thinks PE classes are relaxing. As for me, I like history. I can learn about the past and many great people. I think all subjects are important, and we should work hard at every subject.
translation: 不同的学生有不同最喜欢的科目。艾米最喜欢的科目是英语。她认为它有趣又有用。她经常听英文歌曲和看英语动画片。汤姆最喜欢数学。他说数学就像游戏。他喜欢解决难题。杰克最喜欢的科目是体育。他喜欢打篮球和跑步。他认为体育课令人放松。至于我，我喜欢历史。我可以了解过去和许多伟大的人物。我认为所有科目都很重要，我们应该努力学好每一门科目。

questions.stem: What is Amy's favourite subject?
questions.stemZh: 艾米最喜欢的科目是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Amy's favourite subject is English”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why does Jack like PE?
questions.stemZh: 杰克为什么喜欢体育？
questions.explanation: 短文说“He thinks PE classes are relaxing”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What does the writer like?
questions.stemZh: 作者喜欢什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“As for me, I like history”，因此选D。

text:
School Clubs Welcome You!
The Music Club: Do you like singing? Come to the Music Club! We meet on Monday afternoons in Room 102. You can learn to sing and play the guitar.
The Sports Club: Do you like ball games? The Sports Club is for you! We meet on Wednesday afternoons on the playground. You can play basketball and football.
The Reading Club: Do you love books? Join the Reading Club! We meet on Friday afternoons in the library. You can share your favourite books with others.
Come and join us!
translation:
学校社团欢迎你！
音乐社团：你喜欢唱歌吗？来音乐社团吧！我们每周一下午在102室活动。你可以学习唱歌和弹吉他。
体育社团：你喜欢球类运动吗？体育社团适合你！我们每周三下午在操场活动。你可以打篮球和踢足球。
阅读社团：你热爱书籍吗？加入阅读社团吧！我们每周五下午在图书馆活动。你可以和其他人分享你最喜欢的书。
来加入我们吧！

questions.stem: When does the Music Club meet?
questions.stemZh: 音乐社团什么时候活动？
questions.explanation: 广告说“We meet on Monday afternoons”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Where does the Sports Club meet?
questions.stemZh: 体育社团在哪里活动？
questions.explanation: 广告说“We meet on Wednesday afternoons on the playground”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What can you do in the Reading Club?
questions.stemZh: 你在阅读社团可以做什么？
questions.explanation: 广告说“You can share your favourite books with others”，因此选C。

text: I am Tina. I am a student at No. 5 Middle School. I usually get up at six forty. I wash my face and brush my teeth. Then I have breakfast at seven o'clock. I usually have an egg, some bread and a glass of milk. I go to school at seven twenty. Classes begin at eight. I have four classes in the morning. At twelve, I have lunch at school. In the afternoon, I have two classes. After school, I often play volleyball with my classmates. I go home at five thirty. In the evening, I do my homework and have dinner with my family. I go to bed at nine forty. This is my day.
translation: 我叫蒂娜。我是第五中学的一名学生。我通常六点四十起床。我洗脸刷牙。然后我七点吃早饭。我通常吃一个鸡蛋、一些面包和一杯牛奶。我七点二十去上学。八点开始上课。我上午有四节课。十二点我在学校吃午饭。下午我有两节课。放学后，我经常和同学们打排球。我五点半回家。晚上，我做作业，和家人一起吃晚饭。我九点四十上床睡觉。这就是我的一天。

questions.stem: What time does Tina get up?
questions.stemZh: 蒂娜几点起床？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I usually get up at six forty”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does Tina often do after school?
questions.stemZh: 蒂娜放学后经常做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“After school, I often play volleyball with my classmates”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How many classes does Tina have in a day?
questions.stemZh: 蒂娜一天有几节课？
questions.explanation: 上午四节，下午两节，共六节，因此选C。

text: It is December 3rd. It is Helen's birthday. Helen is fifteen years old today. Her parents have a birthday party for her at home. Her friends Fu Xing, Teng Fei and Ella come to the party. Fu Xing gives Helen a nice notebook. Teng Fei gives her a birthday card. Ella gives her a red scarf. Helen's mother makes a big birthday cake. There are fifteen candles on the cake. Helen makes a wish and blows out the candles. Everyone sings the birthday song. Then they eat cake and play games. Helen is very happy. She says, "Thank you all for coming. This is a great birthday!"
translation: 今天是12月3日。是海伦的生日。海伦今天十五岁了。她的父母在家为她举办了一个生日聚会。她的朋友福星、腾飞和艾拉来参加聚会。福星送给海伦一个漂亮的笔记本。腾飞送给她一张生日贺卡。艾拉送给她一条红色的围巾。海伦的妈妈做了一个大生日蛋糕。蛋糕上有十五根蜡烛。海伦许愿并吹灭蜡烛。大家唱生日歌。然后他们吃蛋糕、玩游戏。海伦非常开心。她说：“谢谢你们所有人来。这是一个很棒的生日！”

questions.stem: How old is Helen?
questions.stemZh: 海伦多大了？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Helen is fifteen years old today”，因此选D。

questions.stem: What does Ella give Helen?
questions.stemZh: 艾拉送给海伦什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Ella gives her a red scarf”，因此选C。

questions.stem: How many candles are there on the cake?
questions.stemZh: 蛋糕上有多少根蜡烛？
questions.explanation: 短文说“There are fifteen candles on the cake”，因此选D。

text: Every school has rules. Rules are important because they help us learn and keep safe. In our school, we must wear school uniforms from Monday to Friday. We must arrive at school before eight o'clock. In class, we must listen to the teacher carefully. We must not eat or drink in the classroom. After class, we must not run in the hallways. We can play on the playground. We must not fight with others. If we break the rules, we will have a talk with our teacher. Rules are not meant to limit us. They help us become better people.
translation: 每所学校都有规则。规则很重要，因为它们帮助我们学习和保持安全。在我们学校，周一到周五我们必须穿校服。我们必须在八点前到校。在课堂上，我们必须认真听老师讲课。我们不能在教室里吃东西或喝饮料。下课后，我们不能在走廊里跑。我们可以在操场上玩。我们不能和别人打架。如果我们违反规则，就要和老师谈话。规则不是为了限制我们。它们帮助我们成为更好的人。

questions.stem: When must students arrive at school?
questions.stemZh: 学生必须什么时候到校？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We must arrive at school before eight o'clock”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What must students NOT do in the classroom?
questions.stemZh: 学生在教室里不能做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We must not eat or drink in the classroom”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What happens if students break the rules?
questions.stemZh: 如果学生违反规则会怎样？
options: They will have a talk with the teacher.
questions.explanation: 短文说“If we break the rules, we will have a talk with our teacher”，因此选B。

text: Keeping fit is important for everyone. How can we keep fit? First, exercise regularly. You can run, swim, play ball games or ride a bike. Try to exercise for at least thirty minutes a day. Second, eat healthy food. Eat plenty of fruit and vegetables. Drink enough water. Don't eat too much junk food or sugar. Third, get enough sleep. Teenagers need about nine hours of sleep every night. Fourth, keep a good mood. When you feel stressed, talk to your friends or parents. A healthy body and a healthy mind go together.
translation: 保持健康对每个人都很重要。我们怎样保持健康？首先，定期锻炼。你可以跑步、游泳、打球或骑自行车。尽量每天至少锻炼三十分钟。其次，吃健康的食物。多吃水果和蔬菜。喝足够的水。不要吃太多垃圾食品或糖。第三，获得充足的睡眠。青少年每晚需要大约九小时的睡眠。第四，保持良好的心情。当你感到压力时，和朋友或父母谈谈。健康的身体和健康的心灵是相辅相成的。

questions.stem: How long should you exercise a day according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，你每天应该锻炼多长时间？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Try to exercise for at least thirty minutes a day”，因此选C。

questions.stem: How many hours of sleep do teenagers need?
questions.stemZh: 青少年需要几个小时的睡眠？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Teenagers need about nine hours of sleep every night”，因此选D。

questions.stem: What should you do when you feel stressed?
questions.stemZh: 当你感到压力时应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“When you feel stressed, talk to your friends or parents”，因此选C。

text: Eating well is very important for our health. We need different kinds of food every day. We should eat a lot of fruit and vegetables because they give us vitamins. We also need some rice, bread or noodles for energy. Milk, eggs, fish and meat give us protein. Protein helps our bodies grow and stay strong. But we should not eat too much sugar or fast food. They are bad for our teeth and our health. A good eating habit means eating three meals at regular times every day. Breakfast is especially important because it gives us energy for the whole morning. Never skip breakfast.
translation: 吃得好对我们的健康非常重要。我们每天需要不同种类的食物。我们应该多吃水果和蔬菜，因为它们给我们维生素。我们还需要一些米饭、面包或面条来提供能量。牛奶、鸡蛋、鱼和肉给我们蛋白质。蛋白质帮助我们的身体生长和保持强壮。但是我们不应该吃太多糖或快餐。它们对我们的牙齿和健康有害。良好的饮食习惯意味着每天三餐定时吃。早餐尤其重要，因为它为我们整个上午提供能量。千万不要不吃早餐。

questions.stem: What do fruit and vegetables give us?
questions.stemZh: 水果和蔬菜给我们什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“they give us vitamins”，因此选C。

questions.stem: Which food gives us protein according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，哪种食物给我们蛋白质？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Milk, eggs, fish and meat give us protein”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why is breakfast especially important?
questions.stemZh: 为什么早餐尤其重要？
options: It gives us energy for the whole morning.
optionsZh: 它为我们整个上午提供能量。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Breakfast is especially important because it gives us energy for the whole morning”，因此选B。

text: It is a sunny Sunday morning. There are many people in the City Park. Look! A group of boys are playing football on the grass. Two girls are flying kites near the lake. An old man is walking his dog along the path. A young woman is sitting under a big tree. She is reading a book. Some children are running and laughing. A few people are boating on the lake. Everyone is enjoying the beautiful day. The park is full of life and happiness.
translation: 这是一个晴朗的星期天上午。城市公园里有很多人。看！一群男孩正在草地上踢足球。两个女孩正在湖边放风筝。一位老人正沿着小路遛狗。一位年轻女子正坐在一棵大树下。她正在看书。一些孩子正在奔跑和大笑。几个人正在湖上划船。每个人都在享受这美好的一天。公园里充满了生机和欢乐。

questions.stem: What are the boys doing?
questions.stemZh: 男孩们正在做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A group of boys are playing football on the grass”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where is the young woman reading?
questions.stemZh: 年轻女子在哪里看书？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A young woman is sitting under a big tree. She is reading a book”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is the old man doing?
questions.stemZh: 老人正在做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“An old man is walking his dog along the path”，因此选A。

text: Last Saturday, the weather was sunny and warm. My friends and I went to the beach. We left home at eight in the morning and arrived at nine. The beach was beautiful. The sky was blue and the water was clean. In the morning, we played volleyball on the sand and swam in the sea. At noon, we had a picnic under a big umbrella. We ate sandwiches, fruit and ice cream. In the afternoon, we collected shells and took many photos. We went home at five. We were tired but very happy. It was a wonderful day.
translation: 上周六，天气晴朗温暖。我和朋友们去了海滩。我们早上八点离开家，九点到达。海滩很美。天空湛蓝，海水清澈。上午，我们在沙滩上打排球，在海里游泳。中午，我们在一把大伞下野餐。我们吃了三明治、水果和冰淇淋。下午，我们收集贝壳，拍了很多照片。我们五点回家。我们很累但非常开心。这是美好的一天。

questions.stem: When did they arrive at the beach?
questions.stemZh: 他们什么时候到达海滩？
questions.explanation: 短文说“arrived at nine”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What did they do in the morning?
questions.stemZh: 他们上午做了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“In the morning, we played volleyball on the sand and swam in the sea”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How did they feel at the end of the day?
questions.stemZh: 一天结束时他们感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We were tired but very happy”，因此选B。

text: Last summer holiday, my family and I went to Xi'an. We went there by train. It took us about five hours. We visited many interesting places. First, we went to the Terracotta Army. It was amazing. There were thousands of clay soldiers. Then we visited the City Wall. We rode bikes on the wall. It was fun. We also went to the Muslim Quarter. We ate lots of delicious food there. We stayed in Xi'an for three days. We had a great time. I hope I can visit Xi'an again one day.
translation: 去年暑假，我和家人去了西安。我们乘火车去的。路上花了大约五个小时。我们参观了许多有趣的地方。首先，我们去了兵马俑。它令人惊叹。有成千上万的陶制士兵。然后我们参观了城墙。我们在城墙上骑自行车。很有趣。我们还去了回民街。我们在那里吃了很多美味的食物。我们在西安待了三天。我们玩得很开心。我希望有一天能再去西安。

questions.stem: How did the writer go to Xi'an?
questions.stemZh: 作者怎么去西安的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We went there by train”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What did they do on the City Wall?
questions.stemZh: 他们在城墙上做了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We rode bikes on the wall”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How long did they stay in Xi'an?
questions.stemZh: 他们在西安待了多久？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We stayed in Xi'an for three days”，因此选C。

text: Once upon a time, there was a poor farmer. He had a goose. The goose laid a golden egg every day. The farmer sold the eggs and soon became rich. But the farmer was greedy. He wanted to get all the golden eggs at once. He thought, "If I cut open the goose, I can get all the eggs inside." So he killed the goose. But there was nothing inside. He lost the goose and could not get any more golden eggs. The story tells us: do not be too greedy.
translation: 从前，有一个贫穷的农夫。他有一只鹅。这只鹅每天下一个金蛋。农夫卖掉金蛋，很快就变得富有了。但农夫很贪婪。他想一次得到所有的金蛋。他想：“如果我剖开这只鹅，我就能得到里面所有的蛋。”于是他杀死了鹅。但里面什么也没有。他失去了鹅，再也得不到金蛋了。这个故事告诉我们：不要太贪婪。

questions.stem: What did the goose lay every day?
questions.stemZh: 鹅每天下什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The goose laid a golden egg every day”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why did the farmer kill the goose?
questions.stemZh: 农夫为什么杀死了鹅？
options: He wanted all the golden eggs at once.
optionsZh: 他想一次得到所有金蛋。
questions.explanation: 短文说“He wanted to get all the golden eggs at once”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What lesson does the story teach us?
questions.stemZh: 这个故事教给我们什么道理？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“do not be too greedy”，因此选B。

text: Last summer, my parents and I went to a small village in Guizhou for a volunteer holiday. We stayed there for ten days. The village was quiet and beautiful, with green hills and a clean river. We helped the local children with their English. Every morning, I read English stories to them and taught them simple songs. In the afternoon, we played games and drew pictures together. The children were shy at first, but soon they became friendly and active. I also learned something from them. They knew the names of many plants and animals that I had never heard of. On the last day, the children made a card for me. It said, "Thank you, big sister. Please come back." I felt so moved that I almost cried. This trip taught me that helping others can bring us true happiness.
translation: 去年夏天，我和父母去了贵州的一个小村庄，度过了一个志愿者假期。我们在那里待了十天。村庄安静而美丽，有绿色的山丘和一条清澈的河流。我们帮助当地的孩子们学英语。每天早上，我给他们读英语故事，教他们简单的歌曲。下午，我们一起玩游戏、画画。孩子们起初很害羞，但很快就变得友好和活跃。我也从他们那里学到了一些东西。他们知道许多我从未听说过的动植物的名字。最后一天，孩子们给我做了一张卡片。上面写着：“谢谢你，大姐姐。请再回来。”我感动得几乎哭了。这次旅行教会我，帮助别人能给我们带来真正的快乐。

questions.stem: How long did the writer stay in the village?
questions.stemZh: 作者在村庄待了多久？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We stayed there for ten days”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What did the writer do every morning?
questions.stemZh: 作者每天早上做什么？
options: Read English stories and taught songs.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Every morning, I read English stories to them and taught them simple songs”，因此选C。

questions.stem: How did the children change during the trip?
questions.stemZh: 孩子们在旅行期间发生了怎样的变化？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The children were shy at first, but soon they became friendly and active”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What did the writer learn from the trip?
questions.stemZh: 作者从这次旅行中学到了什么？
options: Guizhou is a good place for holidays.
Helping others can bring true happiness.
optionsZh: 帮助别人能带来真正的快乐。
questions.explanation: 短文最后一句说“This trip taught me that helping others can bring us true happiness”，因此选C。

text: Plants and animals are amazing. They have many special ways to live and grow. Some plants, like cactuses, can live in dry places for a long time. They store water in their thick stems. Some animals, like bears, sleep through the cold winter. This is called hibernation. Other animals, like birds, fly to warm places in winter. This is called migration. Plants and animals depend on each other. Plants give animals food and oxygen. Animals help plants spread their seeds. Nature is full of wonders, and we should protect it.
translation: 植物和动物令人惊叹。它们有许多特殊的生存和生长方式。有些植物，比如仙人掌，能在干燥的地方生存很长时间。它们把水储存在粗壮的茎里。有些动物，比如熊，会睡过寒冷的冬天。这叫做冬眠。其他动物，比如鸟，会在冬天飞到温暖的地方。这叫做迁徙。植物和动物互相依赖。植物给动物提供食物和氧气。动物帮助植物传播种子。大自然充满了奇迹，我们应该保护它。

questions.stem: How do cactuses survive in dry places?
questions.stemZh: 仙人掌如何在干燥的地方生存？
options: They store water in their stems.
questions.explanation: 短文说“They store water in their thick stems”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is hibernation?
questions.stemZh: 什么是冬眠？
options: Animals sleeping through the cold winter.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Some animals, like bears, sleep through the cold winter. This is called hibernation”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How do plants and animals help each other?
questions.stemZh: 植物和动物如何互相帮助？
options: Plants give animals food and oxygen; animals help spread seeds.
Plants give animals water; animals give plants food.
optionsZh: 植物给动物食物和氧气；动物帮助传播种子。
植物给动物水；动物给植物食物。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Plants give animals food and oxygen. Animals help plants spread their seeds”，因此选A。

text: Food is not just something we eat. It also carries memories and feelings. Many people have a special dish that reminds them of home or family. For example, a bowl of noodles may remind you of your grandmother's kitchen. The smell of dumplings may bring back memories of the Spring Festival. Cooking is a way to show love. When parents cook for their children, they put their care into the food. Family recipes are often passed down from generation to generation. They connect us with our past and with the people we love. A delicious meal can make us feel warm and happy.
translation: 食物不仅仅是我们吃的东西。它还承载着记忆和情感。许多人有一道特别的菜，能让他们想起家或家人。例如，一碗面条可能让你想起祖母的厨房。饺子的香味可能唤起春节的回忆。烹饪是表达爱的一种方式。当父母为孩子做饭时，他们把关怀放进食物里。家庭食谱常常代代相传。它们把我们与过去以及我们爱的人联系起来。一顿美味的饭菜能让我们感到温暖和幸福。

questions.stem: What does food carry besides taste according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，食物除了味道还承载着什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“It also carries memories and feelings”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What may the smell of dumplings remind people of?
questions.stemZh: 饺子的香味可能让人们想起什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The smell of dumplings may bring back memories of the Spring Festival”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How does the writer describe cooking?
questions.stemZh: 作者如何描述烹饪？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Cooking is a way to show love”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.stemZh: 这篇文章的主旨是什么？
options: Food connects us with memories, feelings and loved ones.
optionsZh: 食物把我们与记忆、情感和爱的人联系起来。
questions.explanation: 短文围绕食物承载记忆、表达爱和连接家人展开，因此选C。

text: Planning for the future is important for teenagers. A good plan can help you reach your goals. How can you make a good plan? First, know what you want. Think about your dreams and interests. Do you want to be a doctor, a teacher or an artist? Second, set small goals. A big goal can be scary, but small goals are easier to reach. For example, if you want to improve your English, you can plan to read one English story every week. Third, write down your plan. Put it somewhere you can see it every day. Fourth, take action. A plan without action is just a dream. Finally, don't be afraid of failure. If something doesn't work, change your plan and try again. With a good plan and hard work, you can make your dreams come true.
translation: 为未来做计划对青少年很重要。好的计划能帮助你实现目标。你怎样制定一个好的计划？首先，知道自己想要什么。想想你的梦想和兴趣。你想成为医生、老师还是艺术家？其次，设定小目标。大目标可能令人害怕，但小目标更容易实现。例如，如果你想提高英语，你可以计划每周读一个英语故事。第三，写下你的计划。把它放在你每天都能看到的地方。第四，采取行动。没有行动的计划只是一个梦想。最后，不要害怕失败。如果某事行不通，就改变计划再试一次。有了好的计划和努力，你就能让梦想成真。

questions.stem: Why are small goals easier according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，为什么小目标更容易？
options: A big goal can be scary, but small goals are easier to reach.
optionsZh: 大目标可能令人害怕，但小目标更容易实现。
questions.explanation: 短文说“A big goal can be scary, but small goals are easier to reach”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should you do after writing down your plan?
questions.stemZh: 写下计划后你应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Fourth, take action”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should you do if something doesn't work?
questions.stemZh: 如果某事行不通，你应该做什么？
options: Change the plan and try again.
questions.explanation: 短文说“If something doesn't work, change your plan and try again”，因此选C。

text: What will life be like in the future? Nobody knows for sure, but we can make some predictions. Some scientists believe that in the future, people will live longer. New medicines will cure many diseases. Robots will do more housework, so people will have more free time. Cars will drive themselves, and traffic accidents will become fewer. Some people think we will live on other planets. Others believe we will communicate with animals using special machines. Of course, the future may bring problems too. For example, if robots do most jobs, what will people do? We need to think about these questions carefully. The future is full of possibilities, and we can shape it with our choices today.
translation: 未来的生活会是什么样子？没有人确切知道，但我们可以做一些预测。一些科学家相信，未来人们会活得更长。新药将治愈许多疾病。机器人将做更多家务，所以人们会有更多空闲时间。汽车将自动驾驶，交通事故将减少。有些人认为我们将在其他星球上生活。另一些人相信我们将使用特殊的机器与动物交流。当然，未来也可能带来问题。例如，如果机器人做大部分工作，人们做什么？我们需要仔细思考这些问题。未来充满可能性，我们可以用今天的选择来塑造它。

questions.stem: What do some scientists believe about people in the future?
questions.stemZh: 一些科学家对未来的人们有什么看法？
options: They will live on the moon.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Some scientists believe that in the future, people will live longer”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What problem does the passage mention about the future?
questions.stemZh: 短文提到了未来的什么问题？
options: There will be too many people.
Robots may do most jobs, leaving people with a question.
People will not have free time.
optionsZh: 机器人可能做大部分工作，让人们面临一个问题。
questions.explanation: 短文说“if robots do most jobs, what will people do?”，这是一个问题，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is the writer's attitude towards the future?
questions.stemZh: 作者对未来的态度是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The future is full of possibilities, and we can shape it with our choices today”，表明作者对未来抱有希望并鼓励思考，因此选B。

text: Good communication is the key to good relationships. Whether at home, at school or at work, we need to communicate with others. How can we communicate better? First, listen carefully. When someone is talking, don't interrupt. Try to understand their point of view. Second, speak clearly and politely. Use words like "please" and "thank you." Third, pay attention to body language. Look at the person when you talk. A smile can make people feel comfortable. Fourth, if you disagree, say it in a friendly way. Don't shout or get angry. Good communication takes practice, but it is worth the effort. When we communicate well, we build stronger friendships and a happier life.
translation: 良好的沟通是良好关系的关键。无论是在家里、在学校还是在工作中，我们都需要与他人沟通。我们怎样更好地沟通？首先，认真倾听。当别人说话时，不要打断。试着理解他们的观点。其次，清楚而有礼貌地说话。使用“请”和“谢谢”这样的词。第三，注意肢体语言。说话时看着对方。微笑能让人感到舒服。第四，如果你不同意，用友好的方式说出来。不要大喊大叫或生气。良好的沟通需要练习，但它值得努力。当我们沟通良好时，我们建立更牢固的友谊和更幸福的生活。

questions.stem: What should you do when someone is talking?
questions.stemZh: 当别人说话时你应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“When someone is talking, don't interrupt”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why should you look at the person when talking?
questions.stemZh: 为什么说话时要看着对方？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Look at the person when you talk”，这属于肢体语言的一部分，能表达关注，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should you do if you disagree with someone?
questions.stemZh: 如果你不同意某人，应该怎么做？
options: Say it in a friendly way.
questions.explanation: 短文说“if you disagree, say it in a friendly way”，因此选C。

text: Everyone needs time to relax. But many students today are too busy to relax. They have classes, homework and after-school activities. They often feel tired and stressed. How can students relax? Here are some ways. First, find a hobby. Listen to music, draw a picture or play a sport. Doing something you enjoy helps you forget your worries. Second, spend time with friends. Talking and laughing with friends can make you feel better. Third, go outside. A walk in the park or a bike ride can clear your mind. Fourth, get enough sleep. Sleep is the best way to rest your body and brain. Remember, relaxing is not wasting time. It is necessary for a healthy life.
translation: 每个人都需要时间放松。但如今许多学生太忙了，没时间放松。他们有课程、作业和课外活动。他们经常感到疲惫和压力大。学生怎样放松？这里有一些方法。首先，找一个爱好。听音乐、画画或做运动。做你喜欢的事情帮助你忘记烦恼。其次，和朋友共度时光。和朋友聊天大笑能让你感觉好一些。第三，到户外去。在公园散步或骑自行车可以让你头脑清醒。第四，获得充足的睡眠。睡眠是休息身体和大脑的最好方式。记住，放松不是浪费时间。它对健康的生活是必要的。

questions.stem: Why do many students feel tired and stressed?
questions.stemZh: 为什么许多学生感到疲惫和压力大？
options: They have too many classes, homework and activities.
optionsZh: 他们有太多课程、作业和活动。
questions.explanation: 短文说“They have classes, homework and after-school activities. They often feel tired and stressed”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is the best way to rest your body and brain according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，休息身体和大脑的最好方式是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Sleep is the best way to rest your body and brain”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer think of relaxing?
questions.stemZh: 作者怎么看待放松？
options: It is a waste of time.
It is necessary for a healthy life.
It is only for lazy people.
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“relaxing is not wasting time. It is necessary for a healthy life”，因此选B。

text: Staying healthy is important for teenagers. But what does it mean to be healthy? Being healthy is not just about not being sick. It is about taking care of your body and your mind. Here are some tips. First, eat a balanced diet. Eat fruit, vegetables, whole grains and protein. Don't eat too much sugar or junk food. Second, exercise regularly. Try to be active for at least one hour every day. You can run, swim, play basketball or dance. Third, get enough sleep. Most teenagers need eight to ten hours of sleep each night. Fourth, manage stress. Talk to someone you trust when you feel worried. Do something you enjoy to relax. Finally, stay connected. Spend time with family and friends. Good relationships are good for your health too.
translation: 保持健康对青少年很重要。但健康意味着什么？健康不仅仅是不生病。它是照顾你的身体和心灵。这里有一些建议。首先，均衡饮食。吃水果、蔬菜、全谷物和蛋白质。不要吃太多糖或垃圾食品。其次，定期锻炼。尽量每天至少活跃一小时。你可以跑步、游泳、打篮球或跳舞。第三，获得充足睡眠。大多数青少年每晚需要八到十小时的睡眠。第四，管理压力。当你感到担心时，和你信任的人谈谈。做你喜欢的事情来放松。最后，保持联系。花时间和家人朋友在一起。良好的人际关系对你的健康也有好处。

questions.stem: What does being healthy mean according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，健康意味着什么？
options: Taking care of your body and mind.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Being healthy is not just about not being sick. It is about taking care of your body and your mind”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How long should teenagers be active every day?
questions.stemZh: 青少年每天应该活跃多长时间？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Try to be active for at least one hour every day”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should you do when you feel worried?
questions.stemZh: 当你感到担心时应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Talk to someone you trust when you feel worried”，因此选B。

text: Growing up is a journey full of changes. When you grow up, your body changes. You become taller and stronger. Your mind changes too. You learn to think for yourself and make your own decisions. Growing up also means taking on more responsibilities. You may need to help with housework, manage your time and care for others. Sometimes growing up can be difficult. You may face problems at school or with friends. But these challenges can make you stronger. Remember that everyone grows up at their own pace. Don't compare yourself with others. Be patient with yourself. Enjoy the journey, and celebrate your progress.
translation: 成长是一段充满变化的旅程。当你长大时，你的身体会变化。你变得更高更壮。你的思想也会变化。你学会独立思考和做自己的决定。成长也意味着承担更多责任。你可能需要帮忙做家务、管理时间、关心他人。有时成长可能很困难。你可能会在学校或朋友方面遇到问题。但这些挑战能让你更强大。记住每个人都有自己的成长节奏。不要和别人比较。对自己有耐心。享受这段旅程，庆祝你的进步。

questions.stem: What changes when you grow up according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，长大后会发生什么变化？
options: Both your body and your mind change.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Your body changes”和“Your mind changes too”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What does growing up mean besides physical changes?
questions.stemZh: 除了身体变化，成长还意味着什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Growing up also means taking on more responsibilities”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should you do when growing up is difficult?
questions.stemZh: 当成长困难时你应该做什么？
options: Be patient and celebrate your progress.
optionsZh: 对自己有耐心，庆祝进步。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Be patient with yourself. Enjoy the journey, and celebrate your progress”，因此选B。

text: Nature is full of wonders. From the tallest mountains to the deepest oceans, there are amazing things to discover. Did you know that some trees can live for thousands of years? The oldest tree in the world is more than 4,800 years old. Did you know that some animals can see in the dark? Owls have very large eyes that help them hunt at night. Did you know that the ocean covers more than 70 percent of the Earth's surface? Yet we have explored only a small part of it. Nature gives us clean air, fresh water and food. It also gives us beauty and peace. We should protect nature not only because we need it, but because it is wonderful.
translation: 大自然充满了奇迹。从最高的山峰到最深的海洋，有许多令人惊叹的事物等待发现。你知道有些树能活几千年吗？世界上最古老的树已经超过4800年了。你知道有些动物能在黑暗中看见东西吗？猫头鹰有非常大的眼睛，帮助它们在夜间捕猎。你知道海洋覆盖了地球表面70%以上的面积吗？然而我们只探索了它的一小部分。大自然给我们干净的空气、淡水和食物。它也给我们美和宁静。我们应该保护大自然，不仅因为我们需它，还因为它很奇妙。

questions.stem: How old is the oldest tree in the world?
questions.stemZh: 世界上最古老的树有多老？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The oldest tree in the world is more than 4,800 years old”，因此选C。

questions.stem: How do owls hunt at night?
questions.stemZh: 猫头鹰如何在夜间捕猎？
options: They have a good sense of smell.
They have very large eyes that see in the dark.
optionsZh: 它们有非常大的眼睛，能在黑暗中看见东西。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Owls have very large eyes that help them hunt at night”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why should we protect nature according to the writer?
questions.stemZh: 根据作者，我们为什么应该保护大自然？
options: Because we need it and it is wonderful.
optionsZh: 因为我们需它，而且它很奇妙。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“We should protect nature not only because we need it, but because it is wonderful”，因此选C。

text: Weather is all around us, and it changes every day. Sometimes the sun shines, and sometimes it rains. Sometimes it is hot, and sometimes it is cold. Weather affects our lives in many ways. It affects what we wear and what we do. On a sunny day, we can go for a picnic. On a rainy day, we may stay at home and read a book. Extreme weather, like storms and floods, can be dangerous. It can damage homes and hurt people. Scientists use special tools to study the weather. They use satellites, radar and computers to predict what the weather will be like. Weather forecasts help us plan our days and stay safe. Although we cannot control the weather, we can learn to live with it.
translation: 天气在我们周围，每天都在变化。有时阳光明媚，有时下雨。有时热，有时冷。天气在很多方面影响我们的生活。它影响我们穿什么、做什么。晴天，我们可以去野餐。雨天，我们可能待在家里看书。极端天气，如风暴和洪水，可能很危险。它会破坏房屋，伤害人们。科学家使用特殊工具研究天气。他们使用卫星、雷达和计算机来预测天气会是什么样。天气预报帮助我们计划日子并保持安全。虽然我们无法控制天气，但我们可以学会与它共处。

questions.stem: What can scientists use to predict the weather?
questions.stemZh: 科学家可以用什么来预测天气？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They use satellites, radar and computers to predict what the weather will be like”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What can extreme weather do?
questions.stemZh: 极端天气能做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“It can damage homes and hurt people”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer think we can do about the weather?
questions.stemZh: 作者认为我们能对天气做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“we can learn to live with it”，因此选C。

text: Culture is the way of life of a group of people. It includes their language, food, music, art, customs and beliefs. Different countries have different cultures. When we meet people from other cultures, we can learn new things and broaden our minds. However, cultural differences can also cause misunderstandings. For example, in some cultures, it is polite to look someone in the eye when talking. In other cultures, looking away shows respect. To communicate well across cultures, we should be open-minded and respectful. We should try to understand others instead of judging them. Learning about other cultures does not mean forgetting our own. It means becoming a better global citizen.
translation: 文化是一群人的生活方式。它包括他们的语言、食物、音乐、艺术、习俗和信仰。不同的国家有不同的文化。当我们遇到来自其他文化的人时，我们可以学到新东西，开阔思想。然而，文化差异也可能引起误解。例如，在一些文化中，说话时看着对方的眼睛是礼貌的。在另一些文化中，看向别处表示尊重。为了跨文化良好沟通，我们应该思想开放、尊重他人。我们应该试着理解他人，而不是评判他们。了解其他文化并不意味着忘记自己的文化。它意味着成为更好的全球公民。

questions.stem: What does culture include according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，文化包括什么？
options: Language, food, music, art, customs and beliefs.
optionsZh: 语言、食物、音乐、艺术、习俗和信仰。
questions.explanation: 短文说“It includes their language, food, music, art, customs and beliefs”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What can cultural differences cause?
questions.stemZh: 文化差异可能引起什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“cultural differences can also cause misunderstandings”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should we do to communicate well across cultures?
questions.stemZh: 为了跨文化良好沟通，我们应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“we should be open-minded and respectful”，因此选B。

text: Reading is a wonderful habit. It opens doors to new worlds and new ideas. When you read a book, you can travel to faraway places, meet interesting people and learn about different cultures. Reading also improves your language skills. It helps you learn new words and understand how sentences are built. The more you read, the better you become at reading and writing. Reading can also reduce stress. When you are lost in a good story, you forget your worries for a while. Some people prefer paper books, while others like e-books. Both are fine. The important thing is to read regularly. Try to read for at least twenty minutes every day. You will be amazed at how much you can learn and how much fun you can have.
translation: 阅读是一个美妙的习惯。它打开通往新世界和新思想的大门。当你读一本书时，你可以旅行到遥远的地方，遇见有趣的人，了解不同的文化。阅读也提高你的语言技能。它帮助你学习新单词，理解句子是如何构成的。你读得越多，就越擅长阅读和写作。阅读还能减轻压力。当你沉浸在一个好故事中时，你会暂时忘记烦恼。有些人喜欢纸质书，有些人喜欢电子书。两者都好。重要的是定期阅读。尽量每天至少读二十分钟。你会惊讶于自己能学到多少东西，能获得多少乐趣。

questions.stem: What can reading help you do according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，阅读能帮助你做什么？
options: Travel to faraway places for real.
Learn new words and understand sentences.
questions.explanation: 短文说“It helps you learn new words and understand how sentences are built”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How can reading reduce stress?
questions.stemZh: 阅读如何减轻压力？
options: It helps you forget worries for a while.
optionsZh: 它帮助你暂时忘记烦恼。
questions.explanation: 短文说“When you are lost in a good story, you forget your worries for a while”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How long should you read every day according to the writer?
questions.stemZh: 根据作者，你每天应该读多长时间？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Try to read for at least twenty minutes every day”，因此选C。

text: Making a difference means doing something that helps others or improves the world. You don't need to be rich or famous to make a difference. Small actions can have a big impact. For example, you can volunteer at a local charity. You can help clean up a park or a beach. You can donate old clothes or books to people in need. You can also be kind to someone who is having a bad day. A smile or a kind word can make a difference to someone's life. If everyone does a little, the world will become a better place. What can you do to make a difference today?
translation: 产生影响意味着做帮助他人或改善世界的事情。你不需要富有或出名才能产生影响。小小的行动可以产生巨大的影响。例如，你可以在当地慈善机构做志愿者。你可以帮助清理公园或海滩。你可以把旧衣服或书捐给有需要的人。你也可以对某个心情不好的人友善。一个微笑或一句善意的话能改变某个人的生活。如果每个人都做一点，世界将变得更美好。你今天能做什么来产生影响？

questions.stem: What does making a difference mean?
questions.stemZh: 产生影响意味着什么？
questions.answerText: Doing something that helps others or improves the world.
questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“Making a difference means doing something that helps others or improves the world”，因此参考答案为该句。

questions.stem: What can you donate to people in need?
questions.stemZh: 你可以向有需要的人捐赠什么？
questions.answerText: Old clothes or books.
questions.explanation: 短文说“You can donate old clothes or books to people in need”，因此参考答案为“Old clothes or books.”。

questions.stem: Why can a smile or a kind word matter?
questions.stemZh: 为什么一个微笑或一句善意的话很重要？
questions.answerText: It can make a difference to someone's life.
questions.explanation: 短文说“A smile or a kind word can make a difference to someone's life”，因此参考答案为该句。

text: The Mid-Autumn Festival is one of the most important traditional festivals in China. It falls on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month, when the moon is brightest and roundest. On this night, family members get together, eat mooncakes and admire the moon. Mooncakes are round, just like the full moon. They are a symbol of reunion and happiness. There are many stories about this festival. The most famous one is about Chang'e, a beautiful woman who flew to the moon and has lived there ever since. People tell this story to children year after year. The festival is not only about food and stories; it is about being with the people we love.
translation: 中秋节是中国最重要的传统节日之一。它在农历八月十五，那时月亮最亮最圆。这天晚上，家人聚在一起，吃月饼，赏月。月饼是圆的，就像满月。它们是团圆和幸福的象征。关于这个节日有很多故事。最著名的是关于嫦娥的，一个飞上月亮并一直住在那里女子。人们年复一年地给孩子们讲这个故事。这个节日不仅仅是关于食物和故事；它是关于和我们爱的人在一起。

questions.stem: When is the Mid-Autumn Festival?
questions.stemZh: 中秋节是什么时候？
options: On the 1st day of the 1st lunar month.
On the 15th day of the 8th lunar month.
On the 5th day of the 5th lunar month.
On the 15th day of the 1st lunar month.
questions.explanation: 短文说“It falls on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What do mooncakes symbolize?
questions.stemZh: 月饼象征什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They are a symbol of reunion and happiness”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Who is Chang'e?
questions.stemZh: 嫦娥是谁？
options: A woman who flew to the moon.
A man who shot the suns.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Chang'e, a beautiful woman who flew to the moon”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is the festival really about according to the writer?
questions.stemZh: 根据作者，这个节日真正是关于什么的？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“it is about being with the people we love”，因此选C。

text: Tea is one of the most popular drinks in the world. It was first discovered in China. According to an old story, Emperor Shen Nong discovered tea when some leaves fell into his hot water. Tea was later brought to other countries. Today, people in many countries drink tea. In China, people like green tea and black tea. In Britain, people like to drink tea with milk and sugar. In Japan, there is a special tea ceremony. Tea is not just a drink; it is also a part of culture. The word "tea" in English comes from the Chinese word "cha."
translation: 茶是世界上最受欢迎的饮料之一。它最早在中国被发现。根据一个古老的故事，神农皇帝在一些叶子掉进热水时发现了茶。茶后来被带到其他国家。今天，许多国家的人喝茶。在中国，人们喜欢绿茶和红茶。在英国，人们喜欢加牛奶和糖喝茶。在日本，有一种特殊的茶道。茶不仅仅是一种饮料；它也是文化的一部分。英语中的“tea”一词来自中文的“cha”。

questions.stem: Who discovered tea according to the old story?
questions.stemZh: 根据古老的故事，谁发现了茶？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Emperor Shen Nong discovered tea”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How do British people like to drink tea?
questions.stemZh: 英国人喜欢怎么喝茶？
questions.explanation: 短文说“In Britain, people like to drink tea with milk and sugar”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Where does the English word "tea" come from?
questions.stemZh: 英语单词“tea”来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The word 'tea' in English comes from the Chinese word 'cha.'”，因此选B。

text: Music is good for us in many ways. It can make us feel happy or relaxed. When we are sad, listening to soft music can help us feel better. When we are tired, upbeat music can give us energy. Music can also help us learn. Some studies show that listening to music while studying can improve concentration. Many students like to listen to music when they do homework. But it is important to choose the right kind of music. Loud and noisy music may distract you. Music can even help people with pain. Doctors say that listening to music can reduce pain and help patients relax. Music is a powerful tool for our mind and body.
translation: 音乐在很多方面对我们有好处。它能让我们感到快乐或放松。当我们悲伤时，听轻柔的音乐可以帮助我们感觉好一些。当我们疲倦时，欢快的音乐可以给我们能量。音乐也可以帮助我们学习。一些研究表明，学习时听音乐可以提高注意力。许多学生喜欢在做作业时听音乐。但选择正确的音乐类型很重要。响亮嘈杂的音乐可能会让你分心。音乐甚至可以帮助人们缓解疼痛。医生说听音乐可以减轻疼痛，帮助病人放松。音乐对我们的身心是一种强大的工具。

questions.stem: What kind of music can help us feel better when we are sad?
questions.stemZh: 当我们悲伤时，哪种音乐可以帮助我们感觉好一些？
questions.explanation: 短文说“When we are sad, listening to soft music can help us feel better”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What can upbeat music do when we are tired?
questions.stemZh: 当我们疲倦时，欢快的音乐能做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“When we are tired, upbeat music can give us energy”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What kind of music may distract you?
questions.stemZh: 哪种音乐可能会让你分心？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Loud and noisy music may distract you”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What can music do for patients according to doctors?
questions.stemZh: 根据医生，音乐能为病人做什么？
options: Reduce pain and help them relax.
optionsZh: 减轻疼痛，帮助他们放松。
questions.explanation: 短文说“listening to music can reduce pain and help patients relax”，因此选B。

text: Customs are the traditional ways of doing things in a society. Every country has its own customs. For example, in some countries, it is polite to arrive on time for a meeting. In other countries, people may arrive a little late. In some cultures, people greet each other with a handshake. In others, they bow or kiss on the cheek. Customs can also be about food, clothing and celebrations. When we visit a new country, it is important to learn about its customs. This shows respect and helps us avoid misunderstandings. However, customs are not fixed. They can change over time. What is polite today may be different tomorrow.
translation: 习俗是一个社会中传统的做事方式。每个国家都有自己的习俗。例如，在一些国家，准时到会是有礼貌的。在另一些国家，人们可能会稍微迟到一点。在一些文化中，人们握手问候。在另一些文化中，他们鞠躬或亲吻脸颊。习俗也可以关于食物、服装和庆祝活动。当我们访问一个新国家时，了解它的习俗很重要。这表示尊重，帮助我们避免误解。然而，习俗不是固定不变的。它们可以随时间改变。今天有礼貌的事情明天可能不同。

questions.stem: What are customs?
questions.stemZh: 什么是习俗？
options: Traditional ways of doing things in a society.
optionsZh: 一个社会中传统的做事方式。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Customs are the traditional ways of doing things in a society”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why should we learn about customs when visiting a new country?
questions.stemZh: 为什么访问新国家时应该了解习俗？
options: To show respect and avoid misunderstandings.
questions.explanation: 短文说“This shows respect and helps us avoid misunderstandings”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does the writer say about customs?
questions.stemZh: 作者关于习俗说了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“customs are not fixed. They can change over time”，因此选B。

text: Life is full of the unexpected. Sometimes things don't go as planned. You may plan to go to a party, but your car breaks down. You may study hard for a test, but you still get a low score. What should you do when these things happen? First, stay calm. Don't get angry or upset. Second, think about what you can do to solve the problem. Third, learn from the experience. Ask yourself, "What can I do differently next time?" Remember, unexpected things are a part of life. They can teach us important lessons and make us stronger. People who handle unexpected events well are often more successful in life.
translation: 生活充满了意外。有时事情不会按计划进行。你可能计划去参加聚会，但你的车坏了。你可能为考试努力学习，但仍然得了低分。当这些事情发生时你应该怎么做？首先，保持冷静。不要生气或难过。其次，想想你能做什么来解决问题。第三，从经历中学习。问自己：“下次我能做什么不同？”记住，意外是生活的一部分。它们可以教我们重要的道理，让我们更强大。善于处理意外事件的人在生活中往往更成功。

questions.stem: What should you do first when something unexpected happens?
questions.stemZh: 当意外发生时你首先应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“First, stay calm”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should you NOT do according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，你不应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Don't get angry or upset”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What question should you ask yourself after an unexpected event?
questions.stemZh: 意外事件发生后你应该问自己什么问题？
options: What can I do differently next time?
Why did this happen to me?
optionsZh: 为什么这发生在我身上？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Ask yourself, 'What can I do differently next time?'”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What can unexpected things do for us?
questions.stemZh: 意外能为我们做什么？
options: They can teach us lessons and make us stronger.
They can stop us from succeeding.
optionsZh: 它们能教我们道理，让我们更强大。
questions.explanation: 短文说“They can teach us important lessons and make us stronger”，因此选A。

text: Good morning, class! I am Ms. Chen, your English teacher. Welcome to Class 3, Grade 7. In this class, we will learn English together. You will learn how to greet people, introduce yourself and talk about your friends. We will also sing English songs and play word games. Please bring your English book and a notebook to every lesson. If you need help, you can ask me after class. I am always happy to help you.
translation: 同学们，早上好！我是陈老师，你们的英语老师。欢迎来到七年级三班。在这个班上，我们将一起学英语。你们将学习如何问候他人、介绍自己以及谈论朋友。我们还会唱英文歌、玩单词游戏。请每节课带上英语书和笔记本。如果你需要帮助，可以在课后问我。我总是乐意帮助你们。

questions.stem: Who is Ms. Chen?
questions.stemZh: 陈老师是谁？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I am Ms. Chen, your English teacher”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should students bring to every lesson?
questions.stemZh: 学生每节课应该带什么？
options: An English book and a notebook.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Please bring your English book and a notebook to every lesson”，因此选B。

text: This is my cousin's room. It is small but very tidy. There is a bed, a desk and a bookshelf in it. The bed is next to the window. A blue schoolbag is on the bed. The desk is beside the bed. There is a computer and some books on the desk. The bookshelf is on the wall. Many storybooks and a picture of his family are on it. My cousin likes his room very much. He cleans it every weekend.
translation: 这是我表弟的房间。它很小但非常整洁。里面有一张床、一张书桌和一个书架。床在窗户旁边。床上有一个蓝色的书包。书桌在床边。书桌上有一台电脑和一些书。书架在墙上。上面有许多故事书和一张他的家庭照片。我表弟非常喜欢他的房间。他每个周末都打扫它。

questions.stem: Where is the schoolbag?
questions.stemZh: 书包在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A blue schoolbag is on the bed”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is on the bookshelf?
questions.stemZh: 书架上有什么？
optionsZh: 故事书和一张家庭照片。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Many storybooks and a picture of his family are on it”，因此选C。

text: There is a new library in our school. It is big and bright. There are thousands of books in it. You can find storybooks, science books and history books. The library is open from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. on weekdays. On Saturdays, it is open from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00. You can borrow three books at a time and keep them for two weeks. Please keep quiet in the library and don't eat or drink there. Come and enjoy reading!
translation: 我们学校有一个新图书馆。它又大又明亮。里面有成千上万本书。你可以找到故事书、科学书和历史书。图书馆工作日从上午9点开放到下午5点。星期六从上午9点开放到12点。你一次可以借三本书，借期两周。请在图书馆保持安静，不要在那里吃东西或喝饮料。来享受阅读吧！

questions.stem: How many books can you borrow at a time?
questions.stemZh: 你一次可以借几本书？
questions.explanation: 短文说“You can borrow three books at a time”，因此选C。

questions.stem: When is the library open on Saturdays?
questions.stemZh: 图书馆星期六什么时候开放？
questions.explanation: 短文说“On Saturdays, it is open from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00”，因此选B。

text: My name is Leo. I am a student at No. 8 Middle School. I have a good friend. His name is Ben. Ben is from the UK. He is tall and has short brown hair. He wears glasses. Ben is very funny. He often tells jokes and makes us laugh. We are in the same class. We both like playing football. After school, we often play football on the playground. Ben is good at English, and I am good at maths. We help each other. I am lucky to have a friend like Ben.
translation: 我叫利奥。我是第八中学的一名学生。我有一个好朋友。他叫本。本来自英国。他个子高，留着棕色短发。他戴眼镜。本非常风趣。他经常讲笑话，逗我们笑。我们在同一个班。我们都喜欢踢足球。放学后，我们经常在操场上踢足球。本擅长英语，我擅长数学。我们互相帮助。我很幸运有本这样的朋友。

questions.stem: Where is Ben from?
questions.stemZh: 本来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Ben is from the UK”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What do Leo and Ben both like doing?
questions.stemZh: 利奥和本都喜欢做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We both like playing football”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is Ben good at?
questions.stemZh: 本擅长什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Ben is good at English”，因此选B。

text: My name is Nina. I have a big and happy family. There are six people in my family: my grandparents, my parents, my little brother and me. My grandfather is sixty-eight. He likes playing chess with his friends. My grandmother is good at cooking. She often makes noodles for us. My father is a policeman. He works hard. My mother is a nurse. She works in a hospital near our home. My little brother is six. He likes drawing. On Sundays, we often visit my grandparents and have dinner together. I love my family.
translation: 我叫妮娜。我有一个幸福的大家庭。我家有六口人：我的祖父母、我的父母、我的小弟弟和我。我的祖父六十八岁。他喜欢和朋友下棋。我的祖母擅长做饭。她经常给我们做面条。我的父亲是一名警察。他工作努力。我的母亲是一名护士。她在我家附近的一家医院工作。我的小弟弟六岁。他喜欢画画。星期天，我们经常去看望祖父母，一起吃晚饭。我爱我的家人。

questions.stem: How many people are there in Nina's family?
questions.stemZh: 妮娜家有几口人？
questions.explanation: 短文说“There are six people in my family”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What is Nina's mother?
questions.stemZh: 妮娜的母亲是做什么的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“My mother is a nurse”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does Nina's grandmother often make?
questions.stemZh: 妮娜的祖母经常做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“She often makes noodles for us”，因此选C。

text: My school is not very big, but it is very beautiful. There are four buildings in my school: two teaching buildings, a library and a dining hall. My classroom is in the first teaching building. It is on the second floor. There is a big playground behind the teaching buildings. We do morning exercises and play sports there. The library is between the two teaching buildings. It has many interesting books. I often borrow books there. The dining hall is next to the library. We have lunch there at 12:00. I like my school because it is clean and my teachers are friendly.
translation: 我的学校不是很大，但非常漂亮。我的学校有四栋楼：两栋教学楼、一个图书馆和一个食堂。我的教室在第一栋教学楼里。它在二楼。教学楼后面有一个大操场。我们在那里做早操和运动。图书馆在两栋教学楼之间。它有许多有趣的书。我经常在那里借书。食堂在图书馆旁边。我们十二点在那里吃午饭。我喜欢我的学校，因为它很干净，我的老师也很友好。

questions.stem: Where is the library?
questions.stemZh: 图书馆在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The library is between the two teaching buildings”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer often do in the library?
questions.stemZh: 作者经常在图书馆做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I often borrow books there”，因此选C。

questions.stem: Why does the writer like the school?
questions.stemZh: 作者为什么喜欢这所学校？
options: It is clean and teachers are friendly.
It is near the writer's home.
It has a big dining hall.
optionsZh: 它很干净，老师也很友好。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“I like my school because it is clean and my teachers are friendly”，因此选B。

text: Welcome to the English Corner! It is in Room 203 every Tuesday afternoon. You can practise English with new friends here. We will play word games and sing English songs. Please bring a notebook and a pen. Come and join us!

questions.stem: Where is the English Corner?
questions.stemZh: 英语角在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“It is in Room 203”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should students bring?
questions.stemZh: 学生应该带什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Please bring a notebook and a pen”，因此选A。

text:
Lost and Found
I lost my blue schoolbag in the school library this morning. There is a dictionary, a pencil box and a red cap in it. Please call me at 138-5566. Thank you!
— Mike

questions.stem: Where did Mike lose his schoolbag?
questions.stemZh: 迈克在哪里丢了书包？
questions.explanation: 短文说“in the school library this morning”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What colour is the cap?
questions.stemZh: 帽子是什么颜色的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“a red cap”，因此选B。

text: Welcome to the City Zoo. You can see pandas, monkeys and tigers here. Please do not feed the animals. Do not take photos with a flash. Keep the zoo clean and quiet. The zoo is open from 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Have a good time!

questions.stem: What animals can visitors see in the zoo?
questions.stemZh: 游客在动物园能看到什么动物？
questions.explanation: 短文说“You can see pandas, monkeys and tigers”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should visitors NOT do?
questions.stemZh: 游客不应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Please do not feed the animals”，因此选A。

text: My new classmate is Wang Lin. He comes from Sichuan. He is short but very active. He likes playing ping-pong and telling funny stories. On his first day, he introduced himself to the class. Everyone liked him. Now he is my good friend.

questions.stem: Where does Wang Lin come from?
questions.stemZh: 王林来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“He comes from Sichuan”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does Wang Lin like doing?
questions.stemZh: 王林喜欢做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“He likes playing ping-pong and telling funny stories”，因此选A。

text: This is a photo of my family. The tall man in a white shirt is my father. He is a bus driver. The woman with glasses is my mother. She is a nurse. The little girl in a yellow dress is my sister. She is only five. I love my family.

questions.stem: What is the writer's father?
questions.stemZh: 作者的父亲是做什么的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“He is a bus driver”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How old is the writer's sister?
questions.stemZh: 作者的妹妹多大了？
questions.explanation: 短文说“She is only five”，因此选A。

text: Here is a map of our school. The science building is in the middle. The gym is on its left. The art room is on the second floor of the science building. The dining hall is behind the gym. Students can play basketball in the gym after school.

questions.stem: Where is the dining hall?
questions.stemZh: 食堂在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The dining hall is behind the gym”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Where is the art room?
questions.stemZh: 美术室在哪里？
options: On the second floor of the science building.
questions.explanation: 短文说“The art room is on the second floor of the science building”，因此选A。

text: Science is my favourite subject. We do fun experiments in class. Last week, we made a small volcano with baking soda and vinegar. It was exciting. Our teacher says science helps us understand the world. I want to be a scientist one day.

questions.stem: What is the writer's favourite subject?
questions.stemZh: 作者最喜欢的科目是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Science is my favourite subject”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What did they make last week?
questions.stemZh: 他们上周做了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“we made a small volcano”，因此选A。

text:
Photography Club
Do you like taking photos? Join our Photography Club! We meet on Thursday afternoons. We will learn how to take good photos and share them. Please bring your camera or phone. Call Lucy at 662-889 for more information.

questions.stem: When does the Photography Club meet?
questions.stemZh: 摄影社团什么时候活动？
questions.explanation: 广告说“We meet on Thursday afternoons”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should members bring?
questions.stemZh: 成员应该带什么？
questions.explanation: 广告说“Please bring your camera or phone”，因此选A。

text: On weekends, I usually get up at eight. After breakfast, I help my mother walk the dog. In the afternoon, I go to the library with my sister. We read books for two hours. In the evening, I watch a film with my family. I always feel relaxed on weekends.

questions.stem: What does the writer do after breakfast?
questions.stemZh: 作者早饭后做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I help my mother walk the dog”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How long does the writer read in the library?
questions.stemZh: 作者在图书馆读多长时间？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We read books for two hours”，因此选A。

text:
Dear friends, please come to my birthday party! It is on Saturday, May 6th, at 3:00 p.m. at my home. We will eat cake, play games and watch a film. Please bring a small gift. Call me at 335-778 if you can come.
— Anna

questions.stem: When is Anna's birthday party?
questions.stemZh: 安娜的生日聚会是什么时候？
questions.explanation: 邀请函说“on Saturday, May 6th”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should friends bring?
questions.stemZh: 朋友们应该带什么？
questions.explanation: 邀请函说“Please bring a small gift”，因此选A。

text: Guide dogs are special dogs. They help blind people walk safely. Guide dogs are trained for many months. They learn to stop at red lights and avoid dangers. People should not touch a guide dog when it is working. These dogs are helpful friends.

questions.stem: Who do guide dogs help?
questions.stemZh: 导盲犬帮助谁？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They help blind people walk safely”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should people NOT do when a guide dog is working?
questions.stemZh: 导盲犬工作时人们不应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“People should not touch a guide dog when it is working”，因此选A。

text:
Library Rules
1. Keep quiet in the reading room.
2. Do not eat or drink.
3. Return books on time.
4. Put the books back on the shelf after reading.
5. Use your library card when you borrow books.

questions.stem: What must students do in the reading room?
questions.stemZh: 学生在阅览室必须做什么？
questions.explanation: 规则第一条说“Keep quiet”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should students use when borrowing books?
questions.stemZh: 学生借书时应该用什么？
questions.explanation: 规则第五条说“Use your library card”，因此选A。

text: Skipping rope is a good exercise. It is easy and fun. You only need a rope and a little space. Skipping for ten minutes can make your heart strong. It also helps you keep a healthy weight. Many students skip rope during breaks. It is a great way to stay fit.

questions.stem: What do you need for skipping rope?
questions.stemZh: 跳绳需要什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“You only need a rope and a little space”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How long can skipping make your heart strong?
questions.stemZh: 跳多长时间能使心脏强壮？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Skipping for ten minutes can make your heart strong”，因此选A。

text: A healthy breakfast is important. You can have an egg, some bread and a glass of milk. Fruit is also a good choice. A good breakfast gives you energy for the morning. It helps you study better. Don't skip breakfast before school.

questions.stem: What can give you energy for the morning?
questions.stemZh: 什么能为你上午提供能量？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A good breakfast gives you energy for the morning”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should you NOT do before school?
questions.stemZh: 上学前你不应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Don't skip breakfast”，因此选A。

text: It is Sunday morning. Many people are in the park. A boy is riding a bike. Two girls are playing badminton. An old couple are sitting on a bench and talking. Some children are running after a dog. Everyone is having a good time.

questions.stem: What is the boy doing?
questions.stemZh: 男孩正在做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A boy is riding a bike”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Who are sitting on a bench?
questions.stemZh: 谁坐在长椅上？
questions.explanation: 短文说“An old couple are sitting on a bench”，因此选A。

text:
Weather Report
Tomorrow will be sunny in Hefei. The temperature will be 18°C to 26°C. It will be a good day for outdoor activities. On Sunday, there will be rain. Please take an umbrella. Next Monday will be cloudy and cool.

questions.stem: What will the weather be like in Hefei tomorrow?
questions.stemZh: 合肥明天天气怎么样？
questions.explanation: 天气预报说“Tomorrow will be sunny in Hefei”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should people take on Sunday?
questions.stemZh: 星期天人们应该带什么？
questions.explanation: 预报说“On Sunday, there will be rain. Please take an umbrella”，因此选A。

text: Last Friday, our class went on a school trip to a tea garden. We learned how to pick tea leaves. A farmer told us about tea culture. We also tasted green tea. It was a little bitter but fresh. We took many photos. It was an unforgettable day.

questions.stem: Where did the class go last Friday?
questions.stemZh: 上周五全班去了哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“went on a school trip to a tea garden”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How did the green tea taste?
questions.stemZh: 绿茶尝起来怎么样？
questions.explanation: 短文说“It was a little bitter but fresh”，因此选A。

text: A fox sees some grapes on a tall tree. He wants to eat them. He jumps and jumps, but he cannot reach them. At last, he says, "The grapes are sour." He walks away. The story tells us it is wrong to say bad things about what we cannot get.

questions.stem: What does the fox want to eat?
questions.stemZh: 狐狸想吃什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A fox sees some grapes”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What lesson does the story teach us?
questions.stemZh: 这个故事教给我们什么道理？
options: It is wrong to say bad things about what we cannot get.
optionsZh: 说得不到的东西不好是不对的。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“it is wrong to say bad things about what we cannot get”，因此选A。

text: Last October, my family visited Mount Huangshan. We started climbing early in the morning. The paths were steep, but the views were amazing. We saw sea of clouds and strange rocks. We stayed on the mountain for two days. The sunrise was the most beautiful thing I have ever seen. I hope to go there again.

questions.stem: When did the writer's family visit Mount Huangshan?
questions.stemZh: 作者一家什么时候游览黄山？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Last October”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What was the most beautiful thing for the writer?
questions.stemZh: 对作者来说最美的是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The sunrise was the most beautiful thing”，因此选A。

text: My neighbourhood is friendly and convenient. There is a small market near my home. We can buy fresh vegetables there. A community library is next to the market. Children often read and do homework there. On weekends, neighbours clean the park together. I like living here.

questions.stem: What is next to the market?
questions.stemZh: 市场旁边是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A community library is next to the market”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What do neighbours do on weekends?
questions.stemZh: 邻居们周末做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“neighbours clean the park together”，因此选A。

text: Twin sisters Lily and Lucy look the same, but they are different. Lily is quiet and careful. She likes reading and drawing. Lucy is outgoing and active. She enjoys sports and making friends. Lily is good at maths, while Lucy is good at PE. They respect each other and learn from each other.

questions.stem: What is Lily like?
questions.stemZh: 莉莉是什么样的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Lily is quiet and careful”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is Lucy good at?
questions.stemZh: 露西擅长什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Lucy is good at PE”，因此选A。

text: Bamboo is a special plant. It grows very fast. Some kinds of bamboo can grow one metre in a day. Bamboo is strong and light. People use it to make houses, baskets and paper. Pandas love to eat bamboo. Bamboo is useful and amazing.

questions.stem: How fast can some bamboo grow?
questions.stemZh: 有些竹子能长多快？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Some kinds of bamboo can grow one metre in a day”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What do people use bamboo to make?
questions.stemZh: 人们用竹子制作什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“People use it to make houses, baskets and paper”，因此选A。

text: My hometown is famous for its noodles. They are thin and delicious. People make them by hand. The noodles are usually served with beef and vegetables. During festivals, families often eat them together. Food like this connects people with their hometown.

questions.stem: What is the writer's hometown famous for?
questions.stemZh: 作者的家乡以什么闻名？
questions.explanation: 短文说“My hometown is famous for its noodles”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What are the noodles usually served with?
questions.stemZh: 面条通常和什么一起供应？
questions.explanation: 短文说“served with beef and vegetables”，因此选A。

text: Earth Hour is a special event. Every year in March, people turn off their lights for one hour. It started in Sydney in 2007. The event reminds people to save energy and protect the Earth. Many cities join it now. We can also do small things every day, like turning off the tap.

questions.stem: What do people do during Earth Hour?
questions.stemZh: 人们在“地球一小时”期间做什么？
options: Turn off their lights for one hour.
questions.explanation: 短文说“people turn off their lights for one hour”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Where did Earth Hour start?
questions.stemZh: “地球一小时”始于哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“It started in Sydney in 2007”，因此选A。

text: What will schools be like in 2050? Some experts think students will use tablets instead of paper books. Teachers may give lessons online. Robots may help check homework. But schools will still be important places for students to make friends and learn teamwork.

questions.stem: What may students use instead of paper books?
questions.stemZh: 学生可能用什么代替纸质书？
questions.explanation: 短文说“students will use tablets instead of paper books”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Why will schools still be important?
questions.stemZh: 为什么学校仍然重要？
options: Students make friends and learn teamwork there.
optionsZh: 学生在那里交朋友、学团队合作。
questions.explanation: 短文说“schools will still be important places for students to make friends and learn teamwork”，因此选A。

text:
Dear Peter,
I am glad to hear that you are coming to Hefei. You can take the high-speed train. It is fast and comfortable. When you arrive, we can visit the Science Museum together. Please tell me your arrival time. I will meet you at the station.
Yours,
Li Ming

questions.stem: How does Li Ming advise Peter to come to Hefei?
questions.stemZh: 李明建议彼得怎么来合肥？
questions.explanation: 信中说“You can take the high-speed train”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What will they visit together?
questions.stemZh: 他们将一起参观什么？
questions.explanation: 信中说“we can visit the Science Museum together”，因此选A。

text: Stress is common among students. Too much stress is bad for health. How can we relax? First, take a deep breath. Second, do some exercise, like walking or running. Third, talk with someone you trust. Finally, get enough sleep. Remember, it is OK to ask for help.

questions.stem: What is the first way to relax according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，第一种放松方法是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“First, take a deep breath”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does the writer say about asking for help?
questions.stemZh: 作者关于求助说了什么？
options: It is OK to ask for help.
Only weak people ask for help.
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“it is OK to ask for help”，因此选A。

text: First aid is important. If someone cuts his finger, wash the cut and put a bandage on it. If someone has a nosebleed, ask him to sit down and lean forward. If someone is badly hurt, call 120 at once. Do not move him. Learning first aid can save lives.

questions.stem: What should you do if someone cuts his finger?
questions.stemZh: 如果有人割伤手指，你应该做什么？
options: Wash the cut and put a bandage on it.
optionsZh: 清洗伤口并贴上创可贴。
questions.explanation: 短文说“wash the cut and put a bandage on it”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should you do if someone is badly hurt?
questions.stemZh: 如果有人严重受伤，你应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“call 120 at once. Do not move him”，因此选A。

text: Growing up means taking responsibility. You should do your own homework and keep your room clean. You can also help your parents with housework. When you make a mistake, say sorry and correct it. Responsibility helps you become independent and reliable.

questions.stem: What should you do when you make a mistake?
questions.stemZh: 当你犯错时应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“say sorry and correct it”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does responsibility help you become?
questions.stemZh: 责任帮助你成为什么样的人？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Responsibility helps you become independent and reliable”，因此选A。

text: Wetlands are important for nature. They are home to many birds, fish and plants. Wetlands can clean water and control floods. However, some wetlands are disappearing because of pollution and building. We should protect wetlands and the wildlife there.

questions.stem: What can wetlands do?
questions.stemZh: 湿地能做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Wetlands can clean water and control floods”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Why are some wetlands disappearing?
questions.stemZh: 为什么一些湿地在消失？
questions.explanation: 短文说“because of pollution and building”，因此选A。

text:
Weather Report for Anhui
Today: sunny, 20°C–28°C.
Tomorrow: cloudy, 18°C–25°C.
Sunday: heavy rain, 16°C–22°C. Please stay indoors and avoid travelling in the mountains.
Monday: sunny and cool.

questions.stem: What will the weather be like on Sunday?
questions.stemZh: 星期天天气怎么样？
questions.explanation: 天气预报说“Sunday: heavy rain”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should people avoid doing on Sunday?
questions.stemZh: 星期天人们应该避免做什么？
questions.explanation: 预报说“avoid travelling in the mountains”，因此选A。

text: In northern China, dumplings are a traditional food. Families often make dumplings together during the Spring Festival. People put meat and vegetables inside the dumpling skin. Dumplings look like old Chinese gold pieces. They stand for good luck and family reunion.

questions.stem: When do families often make dumplings together?
questions.stemZh: 家人经常什么时候一起包饺子？
questions.explanation: 短文说“during the Spring Festival”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What do dumplings stand for?
questions.stemZh: 饺子代表什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They stand for good luck and family reunion”，因此选A。

text: Our school library has a reading programme. Students can borrow two books a week. After reading, they write a short book review. The best reviews are put on the wall. The programme helps students read more and think more. It also improves their writing skills.

questions.stem: How many books can students borrow a week?
questions.stemZh: 学生一周可以借几本书？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Students can borrow two books a week”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What do students write after reading?
questions.stemZh: 学生阅读后写什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“they write a short book review”，因此选A。

text: Our community needs volunteers. This Saturday, we will clean the riverside park. Volunteers should wear old clothes and bring gloves. We will start at 8:00 a.m. and finish at 11:00 a.m. After the work, we will have a simple lunch together. If you want to join us, call Mr. Zhao at 226-778 by Friday.

questions.stem: What will volunteers do this Saturday?
questions.stemZh: 志愿者本周六将做什么？
questions.answerText: They will clean the riverside park.
questions.explanation: 短文说“we will clean the riverside park”，因此参考答案为该句。

questions.stem: What should volunteers wear and bring?
questions.stemZh: 志愿者应该穿什么、带什么？
questions.answerText: They should wear old clothes and bring gloves.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Volunteers should wear old clothes and bring gloves”，因此参考答案为该句。

questions.stem: Who should you call to join?
questions.stemZh: 想加入应该给谁打电话？
questions.answerText: Mr. Zhao.
questions.explanation: 短文说“call Mr. Zhao at 226-778”，因此参考答案为“Mr. Zhao.”。
