text: Our school has an English Corner every Friday. Students can talk about films, sports and school life in English. At first, I was afraid to speak. But my classmates encouraged me. Now I go there every week. My spoken English is much better. I have also made new friends.

questions.stem: How often does the English Corner take place?
questions.stemZh: 英语角多久举办一次？
questions.explanation: 短文说“every Friday”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What helped the writer improve spoken English?
questions.stemZh: 什么帮助作者提高了英语口语？
options: Going to the English Corner and speaking.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Now I go there every week. My spoken English is much better”，因此选A。

text: The Dragon Boat Festival is on the 5th day of the 5th lunar month. People eat zongzi and watch dragon boat races. The festival remembers Qu Yuan, a great poet. People also put herbs on their doors to keep away illness. It is a festival of memory and health.

questions.stem: When is the Dragon Boat Festival?
questions.stemZh: 端午节是什么时候？
options: On the 5th day of the 5th lunar month.
On the 15th day of the 8th lunar month.
On the 1st day of the 1st lunar month.
On the 9th day of the 9th lunar month.
questions.explanation: 短文说“on the 5th day of the 5th lunar month”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Who does the festival remember?
questions.stemZh: 这个节日纪念谁？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The festival remembers Qu Yuan”，因此选A。

text: Excuse me, how can I get to the City Museum? Go along Renmin Road and turn right at the second traffic light. Walk past a bank and you will see the museum on your left. It is opposite a big park. It takes about ten minutes on foot.

questions.stem: Where should you turn right?
questions.stemZh: 你应该在哪里右转？
questions.explanation: 对话说“turn right at the second traffic light”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Where is the museum?
questions.stemZh: 博物馆在哪里？
questions.explanation: 对话说“It is opposite a big park”，因此选A。

text: I used to be impatient. I often got angry when things were slow. My teacher advised me to read before speaking. I tried it. Now I take a breath and think first. I am calmer and have fewer arguments with friends. I learned that patience makes life easier.

questions.stem: What did the writer use to be like?
questions.stemZh: 作者过去是什么样的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I used to be impatient”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What did the teacher advise the writer to do?
questions.stemZh: 老师建议作者做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“My teacher advised me to read before speaking”，因此选A。

text: Recycling paper is good for the environment. Used paper can be made into new paper. This saves trees and water. In our school, we collect waste paper every week. We put it in a green box. Then a company takes it away and recycles it. Small actions can protect our planet.

questions.stem: What can used paper be made into?
questions.stemZh: 废纸可以被制成什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Used paper can be made into new paper”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Where do students put waste paper?
questions.stemZh: 学生把废纸放在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We put it in a green box”，因此选A。

text: Silk is a famous Chinese product. Long ago, Chinese people learned to make silk from silkworms. Silk was soft and beautiful. It was sold to other countries along the Silk Road. Today, silk is still popular around the world. It is a symbol of Chinese culture.

questions.stem: What did Chinese people make silk from?
questions.stemZh: 中国人用什么制作丝绸？
questions.explanation: 短文说“make silk from silkworms”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How was silk sold to other countries?
questions.stemZh: 丝绸是如何卖到其他国家的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“along the Silk Road”，因此选A。

text: Our school has a new rule about mobile phones. Students must keep their phones off during lessons. They can use them after school. The rule helps students focus in class. At first, some students were unhappy. But now most students think it is helpful. They talk more with classmates and spend less time on screens.

questions.stem: What must students do with their phones during lessons?
questions.stemZh: 学生在课堂上必须怎么处理手机？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Students must keep their phones off during lessons”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How do most students feel about the rule now?
questions.stemZh: 现在大多数学生怎么看待这条规则？
questions.explanation: 短文说“most students think it is helpful”，因此选A。

text: Loud noise can hurt our hearing. If you listen to music too loudly for a long time, your ears may be damaged. Doctors advise us to keep the volume below 60 percent. We should also take breaks when using earphones. Protect your ears before it is too late.

questions.stem: What can loud noise hurt?
questions.stemZh: 大声噪音会伤害什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Loud noise can hurt our hearing”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What volume do doctors advise?
questions.stemZh: 医生建议音量多大？
questions.explanation: 短文说“keep the volume below 60 percent”，因此选A。

text: Greetings are different around the world. In China, people often nod or shake hands. In Japan, people bow. In France, friends may kiss on the cheek. When we meet foreign guests, a smile is always welcome. Learning greetings helps us show respect.

questions.stem: What do people often do in Japan when greeting?
questions.stemZh: 在日本人们问候时经常做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“In Japan, people bow”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is always welcome when meeting foreign guests?
questions.stemZh: 见到外国客人时什么总是受欢迎的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“a smile is always welcome”，因此选A。

text: Two friends were walking in a forest. A bear suddenly appeared. One friend climbed a tree quickly. The other fell down and pretended to be dead. The bear smelled him and walked away. The friend in the tree came down. The other said, "A true friend does not leave you in danger."

questions.stem: What did one friend do when the bear appeared?
questions.stemZh: 熊出现时一个朋友做了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“One friend climbed a tree quickly”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What lesson does the story teach us?
questions.stemZh: 这个故事教给我们什么道理？
options: A true friend does not leave you in danger.
optionsZh: 真正的朋友不会在危险中离开你。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“A true friend does not leave you in danger”，因此选A。

text: In China, people usually give gifts with both hands. They may refuse a gift once or twice before accepting it. It is polite to say thank you. But some gifts have special meanings. For example, a clock is not a good gift for older people. Learning gift customs helps us avoid mistakes.

questions.stem: How do Chinese people usually give gifts?
questions.stemZh: 中国人通常怎样送礼物？
questions.explanation: 短文说“people usually give gifts with both hands”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What gift is not good for older people?
questions.stemZh: 什么礼物不适合送给老人？
questions.explanation: 短文说“a clock is not a good gift for older people”，因此选A。

text: Last Monday, I missed the bus and was late for school. I felt worried. My teacher asked me what happened. I told the truth. She said, "Thank you for being honest. Try to leave home earlier next time." I learned that honesty and planning are important.

questions.stem: Why was the writer late for school?
questions.stemZh: 作者为什么上学迟到？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I missed the bus and was late for school”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What did the teacher thank the writer for?
questions.stemZh: 老师因为什么感谢作者？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Thank you for being honest”，因此选A。

text: Waste sorting is important. We should put paper, plastic and glass into different bins. Food waste goes into the kitchen bin. Batteries are dangerous waste and must be put in a special box. If we sort waste well, more things can be recycled. Let's start from our classroom.

questions.stem: Where should food waste go?
questions.stemZh: 食物垃圾应该放在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Food waste goes into the kitchen bin”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should be put in a special box?
questions.stemZh: 什么应该放在特殊盒子里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Batteries are dangerous waste and must be put in a special box”，因此选A。

text: Good morning, everyone. Today we leave our school. I want to thank our teachers for their help. I also want to thank my classmates for the happy days we shared. In the future, we will meet new challenges. Please remember to be kind, brave and hard-working. I wish you all a bright future.

questions.stem: Who does the speaker thank for their help?
questions.stemZh: 演讲者感谢谁的帮助？
questions.answerText: The teachers.
questions.explanation: 短文说“I want to thank our teachers for their help”，因此参考答案为“The teachers.”。

questions.stem: What should the students remember to be?
questions.stemZh: 学生们应该记住要成为什么样的人？
questions.answerText: Kind, brave and hard-working.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Please remember to be kind, brave and hard-working”，因此参考答案为该短语。

text:
Dear classmates,
I am going to have a welcome party for our new exchange student, Emma. It will be at my home this Saturday, from 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. We will play games, sing songs and have pizza. Please bring a small snack to share. If you can come, please tell me by Thursday. My address is 25 Green Street. I hope to see you there!
Yours,
Lucy
translation:
亲爱的同学们：
我要为我们的新交换生艾玛举办一个欢迎聚会。聚会将于本周六晚上6点到8点在我家举行。我们将玩游戏、唱歌、吃披萨。请带一份小零食来分享。如果你能来，请在周四前告诉我。我的地址是绿街25号。我希望在那里见到你！
你的，
露西

questions.stem: When will the welcome party be?
questions.stemZh: 欢迎聚会将在什么时候举行？
questions.explanation: 邀请信说“this Saturday, from 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Where will the party be?
questions.stemZh: 聚会将在哪里举行？
questions.explanation: 邀请信说“It will be at my home”，写信人是Lucy，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should classmates bring?
questions.stemZh: 同学们应该带什么？
questions.explanation: 邀请信说“Please bring a small snack to share”，因此选A。

questions.stem: By when should classmates tell Lucy if they can come?
questions.stemZh: 同学们最晚应该在什么时候告诉露西能否参加？
questions.explanation: 邀请信说“please tell me by Thursday”，因此选A。

text: If you want to join the school volunteer club, here are some things you should know. If you join, you will help at the school library on Saturday mornings. You will read to younger children and help them choose books. If you are good at English, you can also help with the English Corner on Friday afternoons. Before you join, talk with your parents and make sure you have time. If you cannot come every week, don't worry. You can come twice a month. The most important thing is to be kind and patient.
translation: 如果你想加入学校志愿者社团，这里有一些你应该知道的事情。如果你加入，你将在周六上午在学校图书馆帮忙。你将给年幼的孩子读书，帮助他们选书。如果你擅长英语，你还可以在周五下午帮助英语角。加入之前，和你的父母谈谈，确保你有时间。如果你不能每周都来，别担心。你可以一个月来两次。最重要的是善良和有耐心。

questions.stem: Where will volunteers help on Saturday mornings?
questions.stemZh: 志愿者周六上午将在哪里帮忙？
questions.explanation: 短文说“you will help at the school library on Saturday mornings”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What can volunteers do if they are good at English?
questions.stemZh: 如果志愿者擅长英语，他们可以做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“you can also help with the English Corner”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should students do before joining the club?
questions.stemZh: 学生在加入社团前应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Before you join, talk with your parents”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is the most important thing for volunteers?
questions.stemZh: 对志愿者来说最重要的是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“The most important thing is to be kind and patient”，因此选A。

text: Last month, I visited the Anhui Museum with my cousin. We took the subway there. The museum was free, but we had to book tickets online first. Inside, we saw ancient bronzes, ink paintings and beautiful porcelain. My favourite part was a VR experience. We put on special glasses and "walked into" an old Huizhou village. It felt so real that I almost forgot I was in a museum. We also learned how people in the past lived and worked. I bought a small postcard as a souvenir. I have been to many places, but the Anhui Museum is one of the most interesting places I have ever visited.
translation: 上个月，我和表姐参观了安徽博物院。我们乘地铁去那里。博物馆是免费的，但我们必须先在网上订票。在里面，我们看到了古代青铜器、水墨画和精美的瓷器。我最喜欢的部分是一次VR体验。我们戴上特殊的眼镜，“走进”了一个古老的徽州村落。它感觉太真实了，我几乎忘记自己在博物馆里。我们还了解了过去人们如何生活和工作。我买了一张小明信片作为纪念品。我去过很多地方，但安徽博物院是我参观过的最有趣的地方之一。

questions.stem: How did the writer go to the museum?
questions.stemZh: 作者怎么去博物馆的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We took the subway there”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What did they have to do before visiting the museum?
questions.stemZh: 参观博物馆前他们必须做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“we had to book tickets online first”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What was the writer's favourite part?
questions.stemZh: 作者最喜欢的部分是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“My favourite part was a VR experience”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does the writer think of the Anhui Museum?
questions.stemZh: 作者怎么看待安徽博物院？
options: It is one of the most interesting places he has visited.
optionsZh: 是他参观过的最有趣的地方之一。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“the Anhui Museum is one of the most interesting places I have ever visited”，因此选A。

text: I have had my teddy bear for six years. My grandmother gave it to me on my seventh birthday. It is brown and soft, but one of its ears is slightly torn. I keep it on my bed. When I was little, I could not sleep without it. Now I do not need it to fall asleep, but I still like to keep it near me. It reminds me of my grandmother and my happy childhood. I plan to keep it for many more years.
translation: 我的泰迪熊已经陪伴我六年了。它是我七岁生日时奶奶送给我的。它是棕色的，很柔软，但一只耳朵有点破了。我把它放在床上。小时候，没有它我就睡不着。现在我不需要它也能入睡，但我仍然喜欢把它放在身边。它让我想起奶奶和快乐的童年。我打算再保留它很多年。

questions.stem: How long has the writer had the teddy bear?
questions.stemZh: 作者拥有这只泰迪熊多久了？
questions.answerText: For six years.
questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“I have had my teddy bear for six years”，因此参考答案为“For six years.”。

questions.stem: Who gave the teddy bear to the writer?
questions.stemZh: 谁送给作者这只泰迪熊？
questions.answerText: The writer's grandmother.
questions.explanation: 短文说“My grandmother gave it to me”，因此参考答案为“The writer's grandmother.”。

questions.stem: Why does the writer still keep the teddy bear?
questions.stemZh: 作者为什么仍然保留这只泰迪熊？
questions.answerText: Because it reminds the writer of his/her grandmother and happy childhood.
questions.explanation: 短文说“It reminds me of my grandmother and my happy childhood”，因此参考答案可整合为该句。

text: Visiting customs are different around the world. In China, when you visit a friend's home, it is polite to bring a small gift, such as fruit or flowers. But you should not give a clock, because it is believed to bring bad luck. In Japan, people usually bow when they meet, and they take off their shoes before entering a house. In the UK, people usually arrive on time. If you are invited for dinner, you can bring some wine or chocolates. Learning these customs shows respect and helps us avoid misunderstandings.
translation: 拜访习俗在世界各地不同。在中国，当你拜访朋友家时，带一份小礼物，比如水果或花，是有礼貌的。但你不应该送钟，因为人们认为它会带来坏运气。在日本，人们见面时通常鞠躬，进房子前脱鞋。在英国，人们通常准时到达。如果你被邀请吃晚饭，你可以带一些葡萄酒或巧克力。了解这些习俗表示尊重，帮助我们避免误解。

questions.stem: What gift should you NOT give in China?
questions.stemZh: 在中国你不应该送什么礼物？
questions.explanation: 短文说“you should not give a clock”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What do people in Japan do before entering a house?
questions.stemZh: 在日本，人们进房子前做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“they take off their shoes before entering a house”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What can you bring if you are invited for dinner in the UK?
questions.stemZh: 如果你在英国被邀请吃晚饭，你可以带什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“you can bring some wine or chocolates”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Why should we learn visiting customs?
questions.stemZh: 我们为什么要了解拜访习俗？
options: To show respect and avoid misunderstandings.
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“Learning these customs shows respect and helps us avoid misunderstandings”，因此选A。

text: Movies and music can change how we feel. Sad movies may make us cry, but they can also help us release bad feelings. Comedies make us laugh and reduce stress. Music works in a similar way. Slow music can calm us down, while fast music can make us feel excited. Scientists say that choosing the right movies and music can improve our mood. However, if we watch or listen to too much sad content, we may stay in negative feelings for a long time. So, it is wise to choose what we watch and listen to carefully.
translation: 电影和音乐能改变我们的感受。悲伤的电影可能让我们哭，但它们也能帮助我们释放不良情绪。喜剧让我们大笑并减轻压力。音乐也有类似的作用。慢音乐能让我们平静下来，而快音乐能让我们感到兴奋。科学家说，选择正确的电影和音乐可以改善我们的情绪。然而，如果我们看或听太多悲伤的内容，我们可能会长时间停留在负面情绪中。因此，明智地选择我们看什么、听什么。

questions.stem: What can sad movies help us do?
questions.stemZh: 悲伤的电影能帮助我们做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“they can also help us release bad feelings”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What kind of music can calm us down?
questions.stemZh: 哪种音乐能让我们平静下来？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Slow music can calm us down”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What can choosing the right movies and music do?
questions.stemZh: 选择正确的电影和音乐能做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“choosing the right movies and music can improve our mood”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What may happen if we watch or listen to too much sad content?
questions.stemZh: 如果我们看或听太多悲伤内容，可能会发生什么？

text: Last Friday, our class went on a school trip to the Hefei Science Museum. We left school at eight in the morning and arrived at nine. First, we watched a 3D film about space. It was amazing. Then we tried a VR game and learned how rockets work. I also bought a small model rocket in the gift shop. We had lunch in the museum park. We went back to school at three. We were tired but excited.

text: Chinese paper-cutting has a long history. People use red paper and scissors to cut beautiful patterns. Common patterns include animals, flowers and Chinese characters. During festivals, people put paper-cuttings on windows and doors. They symbolize good luck and happiness. Today, many young people learn paper-cutting at school or in workshops. This traditional art is still alive and popular.
translation: 中国剪纸有着悠久的历史。人们用红纸和剪刀剪出美丽的图案。常见的图案包括动物、花卉和汉字。节日期间，人们把剪纸贴在窗户和门上。它们象征好运和幸福。今天，许多年轻人在学校或工作坊学习剪纸。这项传统艺术仍然有活力且受欢迎。

text: Our school has started an old clothes recycling programme. Students can bring old clothes to Room 105 every Wednesday. The clothes are sorted into two groups. Some are given to charity, and others are recycled into bags or other things. Last month, we collected 1,200 pieces of clothing. The programme not only helps people in need but also protects the environment. Let's take action and make our school greener.

text: Mother Tiger had a child. She needed to dress him, wash his face and feet and feed him. So she felt quite tired after she finished a day-long work. Mother Bear had two children, but she looks more relaxed than Mother Tiger. "Mother Bear," Mother Tiger said, "Do you feel more tired to take care of two children?" "No," Mother Bear said, "It's all right. I only need to catch food for them." "Then what about their washing, dressing and feeding?" Mother Tiger asked. "I've taught them already," Mother Bear said, "My two babies can do these things by themselves." Mother Tiger stood there and couldn't say a word. She understood one truth: teaching children independence is more important than doing everything for them.
translation: 虎妈妈有一个孩子。她需要给他穿衣服、洗脸洗脚、喂他吃饭。所以结束一天漫长的工作后，她感到相当疲惫。熊妈妈有两个孩子，但她看起来比虎妈妈轻松得多。“熊妈妈，”虎妈妈说，“照顾两个孩子你觉得更累吗？”“不，”熊妈妈说，“还好。我只需要给它们抓食物。”“那它们的洗漱、穿衣和喂饭呢？”虎妈妈问。“我已经教过它们了，”熊妈妈说，“我的两个宝宝能自己完成这些事情。”虎妈妈站在那里，一句话也说不出来。她明白了一个道理：教会孩子独立，比替他们做一切更重要。

questions.stemZh: 虎妈妈结束一天漫长的工作后感觉如何？
questions.answerText: She felt quite tired.
questions.explanation: 短文第二句说“So she felt quite tired after she finished a day-long work”，因此参考答案为“She felt quite tired.”。

questions.stem: What did Mother Tiger understand in the end?

questions.explanation: 短文最后一句点明“She understood one truth: teaching children independence is more important than doing everything for them”，因此参考答案为该句。

text: Last summer vacation, my family and I went on a trip to Huangshan Mountain in Anhui Province. We started our journey early in the morning by high-speed train, which took about three hours. When we arrived at the foot of the mountain, the sky was clear and the air smelled fresh. We decided to climb to the top instead of taking the cable car because we wanted to enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way. During the climb, we saw the famous Guest-Greeting Pine and strange rocks in different shapes. The paths were steep in some places, but we encouraged each other and kept going. When we finally reached the top, the sea of clouds took our breath away. It was one of the most unforgettable trips I have ever taken.
translation: 去年暑假，我和家人去安徽黄山旅行。我们一大早就乘高铁出发，大约花了三个小时。当我们到达山脚时，天空晴朗，空气闻起来很清新。我们决定爬上山，而不是坐缆车，因为我们想欣赏沿途的美景。在攀登过程中，我们看到了著名的迎客松和形状各异的奇石。有些地方的小路很陡，但我们互相鼓励，继续前进。当我们终于到达山顶时，云海让我们惊叹不已。这是我经历过的最难忘的旅行之一。

questions.explanation: 短文说“We started our journey early in the morning by high-speed train”，因此选C。

questions.explanation: 短文说“we saw the famous Guest-Greeting Pine and strange rocks in different shapes”，因此选B。

optionsZh: 对陡峭的小路感到生气。
questions.explanation: 短文说“the sea of clouds took our breath away”，说明作者被云海震撼，因此选B。

text: Once, there lived a hen who had five chicks. She also had three friends: a duck, a cat and a dog. They all lived happily together. One day, the hen found a wheat seed. "Hey, who wants to help me plant this seed?" she asked. "Not me," the duck said. "Nor can I," the cat said. "I'm afraid not," the dog said. "All right. I will do it by myself," the hen said. She planted the seed and watered it. It grew quickly and yielded lots of wheat. "Who wants to help me harvest the wheat?" the hen asked. Again, all three friends refused. The hen worked all day long by herself. By evening, she had two big bags full of wheat. "Who wants to help me grind this wheat?" she asked. Once again, her friends said no. The hen made flour and baked delicious bread. "Who would like to eat some bread with me?" she asked. "I want to!" the duck said. "Me too!" the cat said. "I'd like some as well," the dog said. "None of you can have a bite! I worked hard in the field and you were at home," the hen replied.
translation: 从前，有一只母鸡，她有五只小鸡。她还有三个朋友：一只鸭子、一只猫和一只狗。他们幸福地生活在一起。一天，母鸡发现了一粒小麦种子。“嘿，谁想帮我种这粒种子？”她问。“我不，”鸭子说。“我也不能，”猫说。“恐怕不行，”狗说。“好吧。我自己来做，”母鸡说。她种下种子并浇水。它长得很快，结出了很多小麦。“谁想帮我收割小麦？”母鸡问。三个朋友又一次拒绝了。母鸡独自工作了一整天。到了晚上，她有了满满两大袋小麦。“谁想帮我磨这些小麦？”她问。朋友们又一次说不。母鸡做了面粉，烤了美味的面包。“谁想和我一起吃些面包？”她问。“我想！”鸭子说。“我也是！”猫说。“我也想要一些，”狗说。“你们谁都不能吃一口！我在田里辛勤劳动，你们却待在家里，”母鸡回答说。

questions.stem: What did the hen ask her friends to help with three times?
questions.stemZh: 母鸡三次请朋友们帮忙做什么？
questions.answerText: To plant the seed, harvest the wheat and grind the wheat.
questions.explanation: 短文依次提到母鸡请求帮助“plant this seed”“harvest the wheat”和“grind this wheat”，因此参考答案为这三件事。

questions.explanation: 母鸡说“I worked hard in the field and you were at home”，因此参考答案可整合为该句。

text:
INSIDE THE MAGAZINE — June 2025
Science: Springtime activities. Here is a good chance to experience what it's like to work in a lab as a scientist.
Space: Zebrafish sent to space. The team of Shenzhou-20 took zebrafish to Tiangong for experiments.
Technology: High-speed trains. China has built the longest train system in the world.
Environment: Green cities. Man-made trees that tower over the city help to keep the city cool.
Also inside: Secrets of butterflies — the ability to change shape will sound like magic, but what's the secret behind it?
A flying car — a new car has been seen in a test that could change the future of travel.
GET IN TOUCH: Email us at science@magazine.com.

技术：高速列车。中国建成了世界上最长的列车系统。

本期还有：蝴蝶的秘密——改变形状的能力听起来像魔法，但背后的秘密是什么？

text: Deep in the woods lived a little squirrel called Nico. One day, Nico saw some orange leaves falling off the trees. "Fall is here!" he said happily. But then he remembered something important: winter was coming, and he had not stored any food yet. Nico decided to join a "find-nuts contest" in the forest. The winner would get a huge pile of nuts. Nico practiced running, climbing and jumping every day. On the day of the contest, he raced through the trees, climbed the highest branches and jumped over fallen logs. In the end, Nico did not win first prize, but he collected enough nuts to last the whole winter. More importantly, he learned that preparing early and working hard always pay off.
translation: 森林深处住着一只名叫尼科的小松鼠。一天，尼科看到一些橙色的叶子从树上落下。“秋天来了！”他高兴地说。但他想起了一件重要的事：冬天就要来了，他还没有储存任何食物。尼科决定参加森林里的“找坚果大赛”。获胜者将得到一大堆坚果。尼科每天练习跑步、爬树和跳跃。比赛那天，他穿过树林，爬上最高的树枝，跳过倒下的木头。最后，尼科没有获得第一名，但他收集了足够度过整个冬天的坚果。更重要的是，他明白了：早早准备并努力工作总会有回报。

questions.answerText: Because winter was coming and he had not stored any food.
questions.explanation: 短文说“winter was coming, and he had not stored any food yet. Nico decided to join a 'find-nuts contest'”，因此参考答案可整合为该句。

questions.stem: What does Ben do after school?
questions.stemZh: 本放学后做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“After school, I do my homework first”，因此选A。

text:
Birthday Sale
Come to Sunshine Shop on May 12th! All birthday cards are half price. Small gifts are 20% off. We also have nice birthday cakes. Buy a cake and get a free card. The shop is open from 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Don't miss it!

questions.stem: When is the birthday sale?
questions.stemZh: 生日促销是什么时候？
questions.explanation: 广告说“Come to Sunshine Shop on May 12th”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What can you get if you buy a cake?
questions.stemZh: 如果你买一个蛋糕，能得到什么？
questions.explanation: 广告说“Buy a cake and get a free card”，因此选A。

text: Pandas are lovely animals. They live in the mountains of Sichuan, Shaanxi and Gansu. They eat bamboo. A panda can eat a lot of bamboo every day. Pandas are in danger because their homes are getting smaller. We should protect them and their homes. Everyone can help by learning about pandas.

questions.stem: What do pandas eat?
questions.stemZh: 熊猫吃什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They eat bamboo”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Why are pandas in danger?
questions.stemZh: 熊猫为什么处于危险中？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Pandas are in danger because their homes are getting smaller”，因此选A。

text:
Class Rules
1. Arrive on time.
2. Listen carefully in class.
3. Do not eat or drink in the classroom.
4. Keep the classroom clean.
5. Be kind to classmates.
Rules help us learn better and keep everyone safe. Please follow them every day.

questions.stem: What should students NOT do in the classroom?
questions.stemZh: 学生在教室里不应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 规则第3条说“Do not eat or drink in the classroom”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Why should students follow the rules?
questions.stemZh: 学生为什么应该遵守规则？
options: To learn better and keep safe.
optionsZh: 为了更好地学习并保持安全。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Rules help us learn better and keep everyone safe”，因此选A。

text: Swimming is a good sport. It exercises the whole body. It is also good for the heart. But swimming can be dangerous if you are not careful. Always swim with an adult. Do not swim in deep water if you are not a good swimmer. Warm up before you swim. Follow these rules and enjoy swimming safely.

questions.stem: Why is swimming a good sport?
questions.stemZh: 为什么游泳是一项好运动？
questions.explanation: 短文说“It exercises the whole body”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should you do before you swim?
questions.stemZh: 游泳前你应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Warm up before you swim”，因此选A。

text: Many students like sweet drinks, but water is the best drink. Water helps us stay healthy. We should drink about eight glasses of water every day. We can also get water from fruit and vegetables. Sweet drinks have too much sugar. They are bad for our teeth. Choose water first.

questions.stem: What is the best drink according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，最好的饮料是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“water is the best drink”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Why are sweet drinks bad?
questions.stemZh: 为什么甜饮料不好？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Sweet drinks have too much sugar”，因此选A。

text: It is Saturday afternoon. Many people are in the park. A little boy is playing with a ball. Two girls are drawing pictures under a tree. An old man is reading a newspaper on a bench. A woman is walking her dog. Everyone is relaxed and happy.

questions.stem: What is the little boy doing?
questions.stemZh: 小男孩正在做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A little boy is playing with a ball”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Where is the old man reading?
questions.stemZh: 老人正在哪里看报纸？
questions.explanation: 短文说“An old man is reading a newspaper on a bench”，因此选A。

text:
Weather Report for Hefei
Today: sunny, 22°C–30°C. Good for outdoor sports.
Tomorrow: cloudy, 20°C–27°C. A good day for a picnic.
Sunday: rainy, 18°C–23°C. Take an umbrella.
Monday: windy and cool. Wear a jacket.

questions.stem: What is the weather like today in Hefei?
questions.stemZh: 今天合肥天气怎么样？
questions.explanation: 天气预报说“Today: sunny”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should people take on Sunday?
questions.stemZh: 星期天人们应该带什么？
questions.explanation: 预报说“Sunday: rainy... Take an umbrella”，因此选A。

text: Last Saturday, my class visited a farm. We went there by bus. We saw cows, sheep and chickens. We helped the farmer pick tomatoes. We also rode horses. At noon, we had a picnic by the river. We went home at four. It was a tiring but fun day.

questions.stem: How did the class go to the farm?
questions.stemZh: 全班怎么去农场？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We went there by bus”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What did they help the farmer do?
questions.stemZh: 他们帮农民做了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We helped the farmer pick tomatoes”，因此选A。

text: A crow was very thirsty. He looked for water everywhere. At last, he found a bottle with a little water in it. But his beak could not reach the water. The crow thought and thought. Then he put small stones into the bottle one by one. The water rose. The crow drank the water and flew away happily.

questions.stem: What did the crow find?
questions.stemZh: 乌鸦找到了什么？
options: A bottle with a little water.
optionsZh: 一个装有一点水的瓶子。
questions.explanation: 短文说“he found a bottle with a little water in it”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How did the crow get the water?
questions.stemZh: 乌鸦怎样喝到水？
options: By putting stones into the bottle.
questions.explanation: 短文说“he put small stones into the bottle one by one. The water rose”，因此选A。

text: Last summer, my family took a trip to a small town in Anhui. We stayed there for three days. We visited an old street with stone houses. We also went boating on a clean river. The food there was delicious. We took many photos. The trip was short but unforgettable.

questions.stem: How long did the writer's family stay in the town?
questions.stemZh: 作者一家在镇上待了多久？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We stayed there for three days”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What did they do on the river?
questions.stemZh: 他们在河上做了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We also went boating on a clean river”，因此选A。

text: In my family, everyone shares housework. My father washes dishes and takes out the rubbish. My mother cooks and cleans the kitchen. I sweep the floor and feed the fish. My little sister puts away her toys. We do housework together on weekends. It makes our home clean and warm.

questions.stem: Who washes dishes in the writer's family?
questions.stemZh: 在作者家谁洗碗？
questions.explanation: 短文说“My father washes dishes”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does the writer do?
questions.stemZh: 作者做什么？
options: Sweeps the floor and feeds the fish.
questions.explanation: 短文说“I sweep the floor and feed the fish”，因此选A。

text: My friend Daniel and I are different. Daniel is tall and outgoing. He likes sports and makes friends easily. I am short and quiet. I like reading and drawing. But we both enjoy music. We often listen to music together. I think differences make friendship interesting.

questions.stem: What is Daniel like?
questions.stemZh: 丹尼尔是什么样的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Daniel is tall and outgoing”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What do they both enjoy?
questions.stemZh: 他们都喜欢什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“we both enjoy music”，因此选A。

text: Bees are important to nature. They help flowers and fruit trees make seeds. Without bees, many plants cannot grow well. Bees live in groups. They work hard every day. But bees are in danger because of pollution and fewer flowers. We can help by planting more flowers and not using too many chemicals.

questions.stem: Why are bees important?
questions.stemZh: 蜜蜂为什么重要？
optionsZh: 它们帮助植物制造种子。
questions.explanation: 短文说“They help flowers and fruit trees make seeds”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How can we help bees?
questions.stemZh: 我们怎样帮助蜜蜂？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We can help by planting more flowers”，因此选A。

text: In Anhui, people like to eat rice and noodles. A famous local food is Huizhou noodles. They are often served with vegetables and meat. During festivals, families make special dishes together. Food is not only for eating. It brings family members together and carries happy memories.

questions.stem: What is a famous local food in Anhui?
questions.stemZh: 安徽著名的当地食物是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A famous local food is Huizhou noodles”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does food bring according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，食物带来什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“It brings family members together and carries happy memories”，因此选A。

text: My dream is to be a doctor. I want to help sick people. To make my dream come true, I plan to study hard at school. I will read more books about medicine. I will also exercise every day to keep healthy. I know it takes time, but I will never give up.

questions.stem: What is the writer's dream?
questions.stemZh: 作者的梦想是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“My dream is to be a doctor”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What will the writer do to make the dream come true?
questions.stemZh: 作者将做什么来实现梦想？
options: Study hard and read more books.
questions.explanation: 短文说“I plan to study hard at school. I will read more books about medicine”，因此选A。

text: What will our city be like in 2040? Maybe there will be more electric cars and fewer traffic jams. Parks will be greener. People may work from home more often. But we will still need schools and hospitals. I hope the future city will be clean and friendly.

questions.stem: What may be fewer in the future city?
questions.stemZh: 未来城市什么可能更少？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Maybe there will be more electric cars and fewer traffic jams”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does the writer hope the future city will be like?
questions.stemZh: 作者希望未来城市什么样？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“I hope the future city will be clean and friendly”，因此选A。

text: Good communication starts with listening. When your friend is talking, look at him and do not interrupt. After he finishes, ask a question to show you care. If you disagree, say it kindly. Good communication helps us understand each other and build strong friendships.

questions.stem: What should you do when your friend is talking?
questions.stemZh: 朋友说话时你应该做什么？
options: Look at him and do not interrupt.
questions.explanation: 短文说“look at him and do not interrupt”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What does good communication help us do?
questions.stemZh: 良好沟通帮助我们做什么？
options: Understand each other and build friendships.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Good communication helps us understand each other and build strong friendships”，因此选A。

text:
Dear classmates,
Our class will have a farewell party for Mr. Green on Friday, June 20th, at 4:00 p.m. in the school hall. We will sing songs, play games and share photos. Please bring a small card for Mr. Green. If you can come, tell Lisa by Wednesday.
Thank you!
Class Monitor

questions.stem: When is the farewell party?
questions.stemZh: 告别聚会是什么时候？
questions.explanation: 通知说“on Friday, June 20th”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should classmates bring?
questions.stemZh: 同学们应该带什么？
questions.explanation: 通知说“Please bring a small card for Mr. Green”，因此选A。

text: The Lantern Festival is on the 15th day of the first lunar month. People eat sweet rice balls and watch lanterns. Children carry small lanterns and guess lantern riddles. The festival marks the end of the Spring Festival. It is a time for family and joy.

questions.stem: When is the Lantern Festival?
questions.stemZh: 元宵节是什么时候？
options: On the 15th day of the first lunar month.
On the 15th day of the eighth lunar month.
On the 5th day of the fifth lunar month.
On the 1st day of the first lunar month.
questions.explanation: 短文说“The Lantern Festival is on the 15th day of the first lunar month”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What do children do at the festival?
questions.stemZh: 孩子们在节日里做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Children carry small lanterns and guess lantern riddles”，因此选A。

text: Volunteering is a good way to help others. Students can volunteer at a library, a park or a community centre. They can read to children, clean the park or help old people. Volunteering also helps students learn new skills and make friends. Even two hours a week can make a difference.

questions.stem: Where can students volunteer according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，学生可以在哪里做志愿者？
options: At a library, a park or a community centre.
optionsZh: 在图书馆、公园或社区中心。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Students can volunteer at a library, a park or a community centre”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What can volunteering help students do?
questions.stemZh: 志愿服务能帮助学生做什么？
options: Learn new skills and make friends.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Volunteering also helps students learn new skills and make friends”，因此选A。

text: Healthy habits are important for teenagers. First, eat three meals a day. Do not skip breakfast. Second, exercise for at least one hour every day. Third, go to bed before ten and get enough sleep. Fourth, limit screen time. Too much phone time is bad for your eyes. Small habits make a big difference.

questions.stem: How long should teenagers exercise every day?
questions.stemZh: 青少年每天应该锻炼多长时间？
questions.explanation: 短文说“exercise for at least one hour every day”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Why should teenagers limit screen time?
questions.stemZh: 青少年为什么应该限制屏幕时间？
options: Too much phone time is bad for eyes.
optionsZh: 看手机太多对眼睛有害。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Too much phone time is bad for your eyes”，因此选A。

text: Growing up is not always easy. You may face problems at school or at home. When you feel worried, talk to your parents or teachers. They can give you advice. Also, learn to make your own decisions. Making mistakes is part of growing up. Be patient and keep trying.

questions.stem: What should you do when you feel worried?
questions.stemZh: 当你感到担心时应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“When you feel worried, talk to your parents or teachers”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is part of growing up according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，什么是成长的一部分？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Making mistakes is part of growing up”，因此选A。

text: Mount Huangshan is famous for its four wonders: strange rocks, sea of clouds, hot springs and Guest-Greeting Pine. Every year, millions of visitors come to enjoy its beauty. The best time to visit is spring or autumn. When you climb, please take your rubbish with you and protect the environment.

questions.stem: What is Mount Huangshan famous for?
questions.stemZh: 黄山以什么闻名？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Mount Huangshan is famous for its four wonders”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should visitors do when climbing?
questions.stemZh: 游客爬山时应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“please take your rubbish with you”，因此选A。

text: Weather can change quickly. On a sunny day, you may still need a light jacket in the mountains. If you hear thunder, stay away from tall trees and open areas. If it rains heavily, do not walk through deep water. Check the weather report before you go out. Safety comes first.

questions.stem: What should you do if you hear thunder?
questions.stemZh: 如果听到雷声，你应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“If you hear thunder, stay away from tall trees and open areas”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should you do before going out?
questions.stemZh: 出门前你应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Check the weather report before you go out”，因此选A。

text: People from different countries have different ways of greeting. In China, people often shake hands. In Japan, people bow. In France, friends may kiss on the cheek. A smile is welcome everywhere. Learning about these differences helps us show respect and avoid misunderstandings.

questions.stem: What do people often do in Japan when greeting?
questions.stemZh: 在日本人们问候时经常做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“In Japan, people bow”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Why should we learn about greeting differences?
questions.stemZh: 我们为什么要了解问候差异？
options: To show respect and avoid misunderstandings.
questions.explanation: 短文说“helps us show respect and avoid misunderstandings”，因此选A。

text: Reading is a good habit. It helps us learn new words and understand the world. We can read paper books or e-books. Try to read for twenty minutes every day. After reading, talk about the book with a friend. This can make reading more fun and improve your speaking.

questions.stem: How long should we read every day according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，我们每天应该读多长时间？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Try to read for twenty minutes every day”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What can talking about a book with a friend do?
questions.stemZh: 和朋友谈论一本书能做什么？
options: Make reading more fun and improve speaking.
optionsZh: 让阅读更有趣并提高口语。
questions.explanation: 短文说“This can make reading more fun and improve your speaking”，因此选A。

text: Our school is going green. We sort waste into different bins. We turn off lights when we leave the classroom. We use both sides of paper. We also plant trees in spring. These small actions help save energy and protect the environment. Let's start today.

questions.stem: What do students do when they leave the classroom?
questions.stemZh: 学生离开教室时做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We turn off lights when we leave the classroom”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What do these small actions help do?
questions.stemZh: 这些小行动帮助做什么？
options: Save energy and protect the environment.
questions.explanation: 短文说“These small actions help save energy and protect the environment”，因此选A。

text: Last Sunday, I visited the Anhui Museum with my uncle. We saw old bronze objects and beautiful ink paintings. My favourite part was a VR show about an old Huizhou village. It felt very real. I also bought a postcard. The museum is free, but you need to book a ticket online first.

questions.stem: What did the writer buy at the museum?
questions.stemZh: 作者在博物馆买了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I also bought a postcard”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What do visitors need to do before visiting the museum?
questions.stemZh: 参观博物馆前游客需要做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“you need to book a ticket online first”，因此选A。

text: I have had my old watch for five years. My father gave it to me when I started middle school. It is black and simple, but it still works well. I wear it every day. It helps me manage my time. More importantly, it reminds me of my father's love and my first days at middle school. I will keep it for many years.

questions.stem: How long has the writer had the watch?
questions.stemZh: 作者拥有这块手表多久了？
questions.answerText: For five years.
questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“I have had my old watch for five years”，因此参考答案为“For five years.”。

questions.stem: Why does the writer keep the watch?
questions.stemZh: 作者为什么保留这块手表？
questions.answerText: Because it reminds the writer of his/her father's love and first days at middle school.
questions.explanation: 短文说“it reminds me of my father's love and my first days at middle school”，因此参考答案可整合为该句。

text: When I started Grade 9, I was weak in English. I often forgot new words. My teacher advised me to read English stories every day and keep a word notebook. I also listened to English songs. At first, it was hard. But after three months, I could understand more and speak more confidently. I learned that good ways and daily practice are the keys to learning English.

questions.stem: What did the teacher advise the writer to do?
questions.stemZh: 老师建议作者做什么？
options: Read English stories and keep a word notebook.
optionsZh: 读英语故事并记单词本。
questions.explanation: 短文说“My teacher advised me to read English stories every day and keep a word notebook”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What are the keys to learning English according to the writer?
questions.stemZh: 根据作者，学英语的关键是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“good ways and daily practice are the keys to learning English”，因此选A。

text: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the City Library? Go along Wenhua Road and turn left at the second crossing. Walk past a bank and a post office. The library is on your right, opposite a small park. It takes about ten minutes on foot. The library is open from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. except Monday.

questions.stem: Where should the person turn left?
questions.stemZh: 这个人应该在哪里左转？
questions.explanation: 短文说“turn left at the second crossing”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Where is the library?
questions.stemZh: 图书馆在哪里？
options: On the right, opposite a small park.
On the left, next to a bank.
optionsZh: 在右边，一个小公园对面。
questions.explanation: 短文说“The library is on your right, opposite a small park”，因此选A。

text: I used to be afraid of speaking in public. My face turned red and my hands shook. Last term, I joined the school speech club. I practised every week with my club members. They encouraged me and gave me advice. Now I can speak in front of the whole school. I learned that courage comes from practice, not from waiting.

questions.stem: What was the writer afraid of?
questions.stemZh: 作者害怕什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I used to be afraid of speaking in public”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What did the writer learn?
questions.stemZh: 作者学到了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“courage comes from practice, not from waiting”，因此选A。

text: Many things around us are made of different materials. Glass is made from sand. Paper is made from wood. Cotton clothes are made from plants. Plastic is made from oil. Plastic is useful, but it is bad for the environment because it does not break down easily. We should use fewer plastic bags and more cloth bags.

questions.stem: What is paper made from?
questions.stemZh: 纸是由什么制成的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Paper is made from wood”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Why is plastic bad for the environment?
questions.stemZh: 为什么塑料对环境有害？
options: It does not break down easily.
questions.explanation: 短文说“it does not break down easily”，因此选A。

text: Tea was first discovered in China. According to an old story, Emperor Shen Nong found tea when leaves fell into hot water. Later, tea was brought to other countries. In China, people like green tea. In Britain, people drink tea with milk and sugar. In Japan, there is a tea ceremony. Tea is not only a drink but also a part of culture.

questions.stem: Who discovered tea according to the old story?
questions.stemZh: 根据古老的故事，谁发现了茶？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Emperor Shen Nong found tea”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How do British people like to drink tea?
questions.stemZh: 英国人喜欢怎么喝茶？
questions.explanation: 短文说“In Britain, people drink tea with milk and sugar”，因此选A。

text: Teenagers need rules, but they also need freedom. For example, teenagers should be allowed to choose their own clothes. However, they should not be allowed to stay out late without telling parents. Parents and teenagers should talk calmly. The key is to find a balance between freedom and responsibility.

questions.stem: What should teenagers be allowed to do?
questions.stemZh: 应该允许青少年做什么？
options: Stay out late without telling parents.
optionsZh: 不告诉父母就在外待到很晚。
questions.explanation: 短文说“teenagers should be allowed to choose their own clothes”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What is the key according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，关键是什么？
options: A balance between freedom and responsibility.
optionsZh: 自由与责任之间的平衡。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“The key is to find a balance between freedom and responsibility”，因此选A。

text: Music can change our feelings. Soft music can help us relax when we are tired. Exciting music can give us energy when we exercise. But loud music for a long time can hurt our ears. Doctors advise us to keep the volume below 60 percent. Choose the right music and protect your hearing.

questions.stem: What can soft music do when we are tired?
questions.stemZh: 当我们疲倦时，轻柔的音乐能做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Soft music can help us relax when we are tired”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What volume do doctors advise?
questions.stemZh: 医生建议音量多大？
questions.explanation: 短文说“keep the volume below 60 percent”，因此选A。

text: Table manners are different around the world. In China, people use chopsticks and share dishes. In Western countries, people use knives and forks and have their own plates. In a Western restaurant, put your napkin on your lap and do not make noise when eating soup. Good manners show respect for others.

questions.stem: What do people use in China when eating?
questions.stemZh: 在中国人们吃饭时用什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“In China, people use chopsticks”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Where should you put your napkin in a Western restaurant?
questions.stemZh: 在西餐厅你应该把餐巾放在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“put your napkin on your lap”，因此选A。

text: Visiting customs differ around the world. In China, bring a small gift when you visit a friend. Do not give a clock because it is believed to bring bad luck. In Japan, take off your shoes before entering a house. In the UK, arrive on time. Learning these customs helps us show respect and avoid misunderstandings.

questions.stem: What gift should you NOT give in China?
questions.stemZh: 在中国你不应该送什么礼物？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Do not give a clock”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What should you do before entering a house in Japan?
questions.stemZh: 在日本进房子前你应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“take off your shoes before entering a house”，因此选A。

text: Movies can affect our feelings. Sad movies may make us cry, but they can also help us release bad feelings. Comedies make us laugh and reduce stress. However, watching too many sad movies may keep us in negative feelings. Choose movies that help you feel better and talk with friends after watching.

questions.stem: What can sad movies help us do?
questions.stemZh: 悲伤的电影能帮助我们做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“they can also help us release bad feelings”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What may happen if we watch too many sad movies?
questions.stemZh: 如果我们看太多悲伤电影，可能会发生什么？
options: We may stay in negative feelings.
optionsZh: 我们可能停留在负面情绪中。
questions.explanation: 短文说“watching too many sad movies may keep us in negative feelings”，因此选A。

text: Last Monday, I planned to take a bus to school. But I missed it and had to wait for the next one. On the way, the bus was stuck in a traffic jam. I arrived late. My teacher asked why. I told the truth. She said, "Thank you for being honest. Try to leave earlier next time." I learned that honesty and planning are important.

questions.stem: Why was the writer late for school?
questions.stemZh: 作者为什么上学迟到？
options: He missed the bus and the next one was stuck in traffic.
optionsZh: 他错过了公交车，下一辆又堵车。
questions.explanation: 短文说“I missed it and had to wait for the next one... the bus was stuck in a traffic jam”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What did the teacher thank the writer for?
questions.stemZh: 老师因为什么感谢作者？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Thank you for being honest”，因此选A。

text: Our school has an old clothes recycling programme. Students bring old clothes to Room 105 every Wednesday. Some clothes are given to charity, and others are recycled into bags. Last month, we collected 1,200 pieces of clothing. The programme helps people in need and protects the environment. Let's take action.

questions.stem: When can students bring old clothes?
questions.stemZh: 学生什么时候可以带旧衣服？
questions.explanation: 短文说“every Wednesday”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What happens to the old clothes?
questions.stemZh: 旧衣服会怎样处理？
options: Some are given to charity and others are recycled.
optionsZh: 一些捐给慈善机构，另一些被回收。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Some clothes are given to charity, and others are recycled into bags”，因此选A。

text: As we leave school, I look back on the past three years. I remember the first day of Grade 7. We were nervous and did not know each other. Now we are like a family. I remember the sports meeting. Our class won the relay race. I remember the teachers who helped me with maths. I also remember laughing and sharing snacks. These memories will stay with me forever.

questions.stem: How did the students feel on the first day of Grade 7?
questions.stemZh: 七年级第一天学生们感觉如何？
questions.answerText: They felt nervous and did not know each other.
questions.explanation: 短文说“We were nervous and did not know each other”，因此参考答案为该句。

questions.stem: What did the writer's class win at the sports meeting?
questions.stemZh: 作者的班级在运动会上赢得了什么？
questions.answerText: The relay race.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Our class won the relay race”，因此参考答案为“The relay race.”。

questions.stem: What will stay with the writer forever?
questions.stemZh: 什么将永远伴随作者？
questions.answerText: These memories.
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“These memories will stay with me forever”，因此参考答案为“These memories.”。

text: Good morning, boys and girls! I am Ms. Chen. I am your English teacher. In my class, we will learn to say hello, introduce ourselves and talk about our friends. Please bring your English book and a notebook. If you need help, ask me after class. I am happy to help you.
translation: 同学们，早上好！我是陈老师，你们的英语老师。在我的课上，我们将学习打招呼、介绍自己以及谈论朋友。请带上英语书和笔记本。如果你需要帮助，课后问我。我很乐意帮助你们。

questions.stem: Who is Ms. Chen?
questions.stemZh: 陈老师是谁？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I am your English teacher”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should students bring?
questions.stemZh: 学生应该带什么？
options: An English book and a notebook.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Please bring your English book and a notebook”，因此选B。

text: This is my room. It is small but tidy. A bed is next to the window. A desk is beside the bed. On the desk, there is a computer and some books. A blue schoolbag is on the chair. My favourite photo is on the wall. I clean my room every Saturday.
translation: 这是我的房间。它很小但整洁。床在窗户旁边。书桌在床边。书桌上有一台电脑和一些书。椅子上有一个蓝色书包。我最喜欢的照片在墙上。我每周六打扫房间。

questions.stem: Where is the schoolbag?
questions.stemZh: 书包在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A blue schoolbag is on the chair”，因此选C。

questions.stem: When does the writer clean the room?
questions.stemZh: 作者什么时候打扫房间？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I clean my room every Saturday”，因此选B。

text: This is a photo of my family. The man in a black jacket is my father. He is a bus driver. The woman in a yellow dress is my mother. She is a nurse. The girl with long hair is my sister. She is ten. The boy in a blue T-shirt is me. We are a happy family.
translation: 这是我的全家福。穿黑色夹克的男人是我父亲。他是一名公交车司机。穿黄色连衣裙的女人是我母亲。她是一名护士。长头发的女孩是我姐姐。她十岁。穿蓝色T恤的男孩是我。我们是一个幸福的家庭。

questions.stem: What is the writer's father?
questions.stemZh: 作者的父亲是做什么的？
questions.explanation: 短文说“He is a bus driver”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How old is the writer's sister?
questions.stemZh: 作者的姐姐多大了？
questions.explanation: 短文说“She is ten”，因此选C。

text: My name is Li Wen. I have a new friend. His name is Jack. He is from the UK. He is tall and wears glasses. He is good at English. I am good at maths. We often help each other. After school, we play basketball together. I am happy to have a friend like Jack.
translation: 我叫李文。我有一个新朋友。他叫杰克。他来自英国。他个子高，戴眼镜。他擅长英语。我擅长数学。我们经常互相帮助。放学后，我们一起打篮球。我很高兴有杰克这样的朋友。

questions.stem: Where is Jack from?
questions.stemZh: 杰克来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“He is from the UK”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What do Li Wen and Jack do after school?
questions.stemZh: 李文和杰克放学后做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“After school, we play basketball together”，因此选B。

text: On Sundays, my family often go to the park. My father likes fishing by the lake. My mother likes walking along the path. My sister and I like flying kites. At noon, we have a picnic under a tree. We eat sandwiches and fruit. We talk and laugh. It is a happy family day.
translation: 星期天，我的家人经常去公园。我父亲喜欢在湖边钓鱼。我母亲喜欢沿着小路散步。我和姐姐喜欢放风筝。中午，我们在一棵树下野餐。我们吃三明治和水果。我们聊天大笑。这是一个幸福的家庭日。

questions.stem: What does the father like doing in the park?
questions.stemZh: 父亲喜欢在公园做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“My father likes fishing by the lake”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where do they have a picnic?
questions.stemZh: 他们在哪里野餐？
questions.explanation: 短文说“we have a picnic under a tree”，因此选B。

text:
Birthday Sale
Come to Sunshine Shop on May 12th! All birthday cards are half price. Small gifts are 20% off. Buy a cake and get a free card. The shop is open from 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Don't miss it!
translation:
生日促销
5月12日来阳光商店！所有生日贺卡半价。小礼物八折。买蛋糕送贺卡。商店上午9点到晚上8点营业。不要错过！

questions.stem: When is the birthday sale?
questions.stemZh: 生日促销是什么时候？
questions.explanation: 广告说“Come to Sunshine Shop on May 12th”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What can you get if you buy a cake?
questions.stemZh: 如果你买一个蛋糕，能得到什么？
questions.explanation: 广告说“Buy a cake and get a free card”，因此选B。

text: Pandas are lovely animals. They live in the mountains of Sichuan, Shaanxi and Gansu. They eat bamboo. A panda can eat a lot of bamboo every day. Pandas are in danger because their homes are getting smaller. We should protect them and their homes. Everyone can help by learning about pandas and telling others to protect them.
translation: 熊猫是可爱的动物。它们生活在四川、陕西和甘肃的山区。它们吃竹子。一只熊猫每天能吃很多竹子。熊猫处于危险中，因为它们的家园正在变小。我们应该保护它们和它们的家园。每个人都可以通过了解熊猫并告诉他人保护它们来提供帮助。

questions.stem: What do pandas eat?
questions.stemZh: 熊猫吃什么？
questions.answerText: Bamboo.
questions.explanation: 短文说“They eat bamboo”，因此参考答案为“Bamboo.”。

questions.stem: Why are pandas in danger?
questions.stemZh: 熊猫为什么处于危险中？
questions.answerText: Because their homes are getting smaller.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Pandas are in danger because their homes are getting smaller”，因此参考答案为该句。

questions.stem: How can everyone help protect pandas?
questions.stemZh: 每个人怎样才能帮助保护熊猫？
questions.answerText: By learning about pandas and telling others to protect them.
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“Everyone can help by learning about pandas and telling others to protect them”，因此参考答案为该句。

text: Skipping rope is a good exercise. You only need a rope and a little space. Skipping for ten minutes can make your heart strong. It also helps you keep a healthy weight. Many students skip rope during breaks. It is easy, fun and good for you.
translation: 跳绳是一项好运动。你只需要一根绳和一点空间。跳绳十分钟能使你的心脏强壮。它还帮助你保持健康的体重。许多学生在课间跳绳。它简单、有趣，对你有好处。

questions.stem: What do you need for skipping rope?
questions.stemZh: 跳绳需要什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“You only need a rope and a little space”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How long can skipping make your heart strong?
questions.stemZh: 跳多长时间能使心脏强壮？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Skipping for ten minutes can make your heart strong”，因此选B。

text: My name is Amy. I am 13. I have a busy but happy school day. I get up at 6:30 and have breakfast at 7:00. I go to school by bike. Classes begin at 8:00. My favourite subject is English because it is fun. At lunch time, I eat with my friends in the dining hall. After school, I play volleyball for an hour. I go home at 5:30 and do my homework. I go to bed at 9:30.
translation: 我叫艾米。我13岁。我忙碌但快乐的学校生活。我6:30起床，7:00吃早餐。我骑自行车上学。8:00开始上课。我最喜欢的科目是英语，因为它有趣。午餐时间，我和朋友在食堂吃饭。放学后，我打一小时排球。我5:30回家做作业。我9:30睡觉。

questions.stem: How does Amy go to school?
questions.stemZh: 艾米怎么上学？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I go to school by bike”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why does Amy like English?
questions.stemZh: 艾米为什么喜欢英语？
questions.explanation: 短文说“My favourite subject is English because it is fun”，因此选B。

text: My family has a new rule. We cannot use phones at the dinner table. At first, I did not like it. I wanted to watch videos while eating. But after a week, I found that we talked more. My father told funny stories. My mother shared her day. Now I enjoy dinner time. The rule makes our family closer.
translation: 我家有一条新规则。我们不能在餐桌上用手机。起初，我不喜欢。我想边吃边看视频。但一周后，我发现我们聊天更多了。爸爸讲有趣的故事。妈妈分享她的一天。现在我喜欢晚餐时间。这条规则让我们的家庭更亲密。

questions.stem: What is the new family rule?
questions.stemZh: 新的家庭规则是什么？
options: No phones at the dinner table.
questions.explanation: 短文说“We cannot use phones at the dinner table”，因此选B。

questions.stem: How does the writer feel about the rule now?
questions.stemZh: 作者现在对这条规则感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Now I enjoy dinner time”，因此选B。

text: Keeping fit is not hard. You do not need a gym. You can walk to school, ride a bike or play ball games. Try to move for at least 30 minutes every day. Eat fruit and vegetables. Drink water instead of sweet drinks. Sleep for about nine hours. These small habits keep you healthy and strong.
translation: 保持健康并不难。你不需要健身房。你可以步行上学、骑自行车或打球。尽量每天运动至少30分钟。吃水果和蔬菜。喝水而不是甜饮料。睡大约九小时。这些小习惯让你健康强壮。

questions.stem: How long should you move every day?
questions.stemZh: 你每天应该运动多长时间？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Try to move for at least 30 minutes every day”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.stemZh: 短文的主旨是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文列举步行、饮食、睡眠等小习惯，最后说“These small habits keep you healthy and strong”，因此选B。

text: Many students feel hungry after school. They buy snacks like chips and candy. But these snacks have too much sugar and salt. They are not good for your body. A better choice is fruit, yogurt or nuts. They give you energy and keep you healthy. Think before you eat.
translation: 许多学生放学后感到饿。他们买薯片和糖果等零食。但这些零食糖和盐太多。它们对身体不好。更好的选择是水果、酸奶或坚果。它们给你能量，保持健康。吃之前想一想。

questions.stem: Why are chips and candy not good?
questions.stemZh: 为什么薯片和糖果不好？
options: They have too much sugar and salt.
questions.explanation: 短文说“these snacks have too much sugar and salt”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is a better snack choice?
questions.stemZh: 更好的零食选择是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A better choice is fruit, yogurt or nuts”，因此选C。

text: Last Sunday, I went to the beach with my cousin. We played volleyball on the sand. Then we swam in the sea. At noon, we had a picnic under an umbrella. In the afternoon, we collected shells. I found a beautiful pink shell. We went home at five. It was a wonderful day.
translation: 上周日，我和表哥去了海滩。我们在沙滩上打排球。然后我们在海里游泳。中午，我们在伞下野餐。下午，我们收集贝壳。我找到了一只漂亮的粉色贝壳。我们五点回家。这是美好的一天。

questions.stem: What did they do in the morning?
questions.stemZh: 他们上午做了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We played volleyball on the sand. Then we swam in the sea”，这些是中午前的活动，因此选B。

questions.stem: What did the writer find?
questions.stemZh: 作者找到了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I found a beautiful pink shell”，因此选A。

text:
Weather Report for Anhui
Today: sunny and warm, 20°C–28°C.
Tomorrow: cloudy with light rain, 18°C–24°C. Take an umbrella.
Sunday: windy and cool, 15°C–21°C. Wear a jacket.
Monday: sunny again, 17°C–25°C. Good for outdoor activities.
translation:
安徽天气预报
今天：晴暖，20°C–28°C。
明天：多云有小雨，18°C–24°C。带伞。
周日：有风凉爽，15°C–21°C。穿夹克。
周一：再次晴朗，17°C–25°C。适合户外活动。

questions.stem: What will the weather be like tomorrow?
questions.stemZh: 明天天气怎么样？
questions.explanation: 预报说“Tomorrow: cloudy with light rain”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What should people wear on Sunday?
questions.stemZh: 周日人们应该穿什么？
questions.explanation: 预报说“Sunday: windy and cool... Wear a jacket”，因此选B。

text: Last Friday, our class went to the Anhui Museum. We saw old bronze objects and beautiful paintings. A guide told us stories about them. My favourite part was a VR show about an old village. It felt very real. We had lunch in a park nearby. We went back to school at three. It was an interesting day.
translation: 上周五，我们班去了安徽博物院。我们看到了古代青铜器和美丽的画作。一位导游给我们讲了它们的故事。我最喜欢的部分是一个关于古老村落的VR展示。它感觉很真实。我们在附近的公园吃午饭。我们三点回到学校。这是有趣的一天。

questions.stem: Where did the class go last Friday?
questions.stemZh: 上周五全班去了哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“our class went to the Anhui Museum”，因此选A。

questions.stem: What was the writer's favourite part?
questions.stemZh: 作者最喜欢的部分是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“My favourite part was a VR show”，因此选C。

text: Last summer, my family took a trip to a small town in Anhui. We stayed for three days. We visited an old street with stone houses. We also went boating on a clean river. The food there was delicious. We took many photos. The trip was short but unforgettable.
translation: 去年夏天，我们一家去安徽的一个小镇旅行。我们待了三天。我们参观了一条有石头房子的老街。我们还在一条清澈的河上划船。那里的食物很美味。我们拍了很多照片。这次旅行短暂但难忘。

questions.stem: How long did the family stay in the town?
questions.stemZh: 一家人在镇上待了多久？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We stayed for three days”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What did they do on the river?
questions.stemZh: 他们在河上做了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We also went boating on a clean river”，因此选B。

text: In my family, everyone shares housework. My father washes dishes and takes out the rubbish. My mother cooks and cleans the kitchen. I sweep the floor and feed the fish. My little sister puts away her toys. We do housework together on weekends. It makes our home clean and warm. I think children should learn to do housework from an early age.
translation: 在我家，每个人都分担家务。父亲洗碗、倒垃圾。母亲做饭、打扫厨房。我扫地、喂鱼。妹妹收拾玩具。我们周末一起做家务。这让我们的家干净温暖。我认为孩子应该从小学做家务。

questions.stem: What does the father do in the family?
questions.stemZh: 父亲在家里做什么？
questions.answerText: He washes dishes and takes out the rubbish.
questions.explanation: 短文说“My father washes dishes and takes out the rubbish”，因此参考答案为该句。

questions.stem: What does the writer think children should learn?
questions.stemZh: 作者认为孩子应该学习什么？
questions.answerText: They should learn to do housework from an early age.
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“I think children should learn to do housework from an early age”，因此参考答案为该句。

text: In Anhui, people like rice and noodles. A famous local food is Huizhou noodles. They are often served with vegetables and meat. During festivals, families make special dishes together. Food is not only for eating. It brings family members together and carries happy memories.
translation: 在安徽，人们喜欢米饭和面条。一种著名的当地食物是徽州面条。它们通常配蔬菜和肉。节日期间，家人一起做特别的菜。食物不仅仅是为了吃。它让家人团聚，承载快乐的回忆。

questions.stem: What is a famous local food in Anhui?
questions.stemZh: 安徽著名的当地食物是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A famous local food is Huizhou noodles”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does food bring according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，食物带来什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“It brings family members together and carries happy memories”，因此选C。

text: Volunteering is a good way to help others. Students can volunteer at a library, a park or a community centre. They can read to children, clean the park or help old people. Volunteering also helps students learn new skills and make friends. Even two hours a week can make a difference.
translation: 志愿服务是帮助他人的好方法。学生可以在图书馆、公园或社区中心做志愿者。他们可以给孩子们读书、打扫公园或帮助老人。志愿服务也帮助学生学新技能、交朋友。即使每周两小时也能带来改变。

questions.stem: Where can students volunteer?
questions.stemZh: 学生可以在哪里做志愿者？
questions.answerText: At a library, a park or a community centre.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Students can volunteer at a library, a park or a community centre”，因此参考答案为该句。

questions.stem: What can volunteering help students do?
questions.stemZh: 志愿服务能帮助学生做什么？
questions.answerText: Learn new skills and make friends.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Volunteering also helps students learn new skills and make friends”，因此参考答案为“Learn new skills and make friends.”。

text: Healthy habits are important for teenagers. First, eat three meals a day and never skip breakfast. Second, exercise for at least one hour every day. Third, go to bed before ten and get enough sleep. Fourth, limit screen time. Too much phone time is bad for your eyes. Small habits make a big difference.
translation: 健康习惯对青少年很重要。第一，一日三餐，绝不不吃早餐。第二，每天至少锻炼一小时。第三，十点前睡觉，获得充足睡眠。第四，限制屏幕时间。看手机太多对眼睛有害。小习惯带来大改变。

questions.stem: How long should teenagers exercise every day?
questions.stemZh: 青少年每天应该锻炼多久？
questions.explanation: 短文说“exercise for at least one hour every day”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Why should teenagers limit screen time?
questions.stemZh: 青少年为什么应该限制屏幕时间？
options: Too much phone time is bad for eyes.
optionsZh: 看手机太多对眼睛有害。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Too much phone time is bad for your eyes”，因此选B。

text: On a freezing December day in Tongxin County, Ningxia, the quiet winter air was suddenly broken by screams—a 4-year-old boy had fallen through the ice into an icy lake! People rushed to the edge, but no one dared step onto the cracking surface. At that critical moment, 13-year-old Li Jiating, a seventh-grade student, stepped forward. "I'm light—I'll go!" she said. She took a long pipe and crawled (爬) carefully toward the ice hole. As she reached out to give the pipe to the boy, the ice broke again. Both she and the boy fell into the freezing water. But Li Jiating didn't let go. She held tightly onto the pipe until adults on the shore pulled her out. Soon after, firefighters arrived and rescued the boy. Soaked and shivering, Li Jiating quietly rode her bike home without saying a word. Her father asked about her wet clothes, and she smiled and "lied": "A water truck splashed me!" It wasn't until 11 p.m. that night, when his sister called, that the father learned the truth. "I'm scared and sad, but also proud of her kindness," he said.
translation: 在同心县一个冰冷的十二月天，安静的冬日空气突然被尖叫声打破——一个4岁男孩从冰面掉进了冰冷的湖里！人们冲到岸边，但没有人敢踏上正在开裂的冰面。在这关键时刻，13岁的七年级学生李佳婷站了出来。“我轻——我去！”她说。她接过旁观者递来的一根长管子，小心翼翼地朝冰洞爬去。当她伸手把管子递给男孩时，冰面再次破裂。她和男孩都掉进了冰冷的水中。但李佳婷没有松手。她紧紧抓住管子，直到岸上的大人把她拉了出来。不久后，消防员赶到，救出了男孩。浑身湿透、瑟瑟发抖的李佳婷默默地骑自行车回家，一句话也没说。父亲问她衣服怎么湿了，她笑着“撒谎”说：“一辆洒水车溅了我一身！”直到当晚11点，他姐姐打来电话，父亲才知道真相。“我既害怕又难过，但也为她的善良感到骄傲，”他说。

questions.stem: Why did Li Jiating decide to crawl on the ice to save the boy?
questions.stemZh: 李佳婷为什么决定在冰面上爬行去救男孩？
options: She was the strongest person in the crowd.
She had received professional ice-rescue training.
She wanted to get rewards from the boy's parents.
She thought her light weight would not break the ice easily.
optionsZh: 她是人群中最强壮的人。
她接受过专业的冰面救援训练。
她想从男孩父母那里得到奖励。
她认为自己的体重轻，不容易压破冰面。
questions.explanation: 短文说“‘I'm light—I'll go!’ she said”，说明她认为自己体重轻，不容易压破冰面，因此选D。

questions.stem: Li Jiating "lied" to her father about her wet clothes probably because ________.
questions.stemZh: 李佳婷对父亲“撒谎”说衣服湿了，可能是因为________。
options: she was too cold to talk
she didn't want her father to worry about her
she was scared and could not speak
she was too shy to talk about it
optionsZh: 她不想让父亲为她担心
她太害羞了，不愿谈论这件事
questions.explanation: 她回家后对父亲“lied”说被洒水车溅湿，结合她默默回家“without saying a word”的行为，可以推断她不想让父亲担心，因此选B。

questions.stem: What can we infer from the father's words "I'm scared and sad, but also proud of her kindness"?
questions.stemZh: 从父亲的话“我既害怕又难过，但也为她的善良感到骄傲”中可以推断出什么？
options: The father thought his daughter was too reckless.
The father wanted his daughter to get more honors.
The father only cared about his daughter's safety.
The father had mixed feelings about his daughter's act.
optionsZh: 父亲认为女儿太鲁莽了。
父亲想让女儿获得更多荣誉。
父亲只关心女儿的安全。
父亲对女儿的行为有着复杂的感受。
questions.explanation: “scared and sad”是对女儿安危的后怕与心疼，“proud of her kindness”是对女儿善举的肯定，说明父亲情感复杂，因此选D。

questions.stem: What is the writer's main purpose in writing this passage?
questions.stemZh: 作者写这篇文章的主要目的是什么？
options: To teach children how to rescue people on ice.
To praise Li Jiating's kindness and courage.
To warn people not to walk on ice in winter.
To introduce a famous school in Ningxia.
optionsZh: 教孩子们如何在冰上救人。
赞扬李佳婷的善良和勇气。
警告人们冬天不要在冰上行走。
介绍宁夏一所著名的学校。
questions.explanation: 短文详细叙述了李佳婷救人的过程和她不张扬的态度，结尾引用父亲的话突出她的kindness，整体目的是赞扬她的善良与勇气，因此选B。

Wherever you are on your writing journey, you will find support, ideas and welcoming smiles here. Our learning program includes courses and lectures on writing. Our special activity is one-to-one instructions. You can get USEFUL advice on your writing. There's also an evening party full of fun. This is a truly happy experience to be with others who share similar interests in writing with you. Join us for 2026! For more information, see the website: www.xxx.xxx.

questions.stem: How long does the Writers' Summer School last?

questions.stem: What is the special activity in the summer school?
questions.stemZh: 暑期学校的特色活动是什么？
questions.explanation: 广告说“Our special activity is one-to-one instructions”，因此选D。

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the text?
questions.stemZh: 这段文字的目的是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文开头“Welcome to the Writers' Summer School!”并介绍了项目的时长、活动和报名方式，目的是介绍这个写作项目，因此选D。
