text: It was just a common Wednesday for Tom, a seventh grader, until unexpected things changed everything. That morning, Tom hurried to school but suddenly remembered his science project was still on his kitchen table. His heart sank. He had worked on it for weeks! Just as he was about to cry, his neighbor, Mr. Clark, drove by. "You look worried! Need a ride?" he asked. Thanks to Mr. Clark, Tom got to school just in time with his project. During lunch break, he found an old lady struggling with heavy bags outside the school. Even though he was hungry, Tom helped her carry the bags home. He was a little late returning to class, but his teacher didn't scold him. Why? The old lady was the headmaster's mother! He knew why Tom was late. And the headmaster thanked him in front of the whole class. The biggest surprise came after school. On his way home, Tom saw something shiny near the bus stop—a wallet! Inside, there was some money and a library card with a phone number. He called the number at once. The owner, a college student, came to get it. To thank Tom, she gave him a bookstore gift card she had just bought.
translation: 对七年级学生汤姆来说，这只是一个普通的星期三，直到意外的事情改变了一切。那天早上，汤姆匆匆赶往学校，却突然想起他的科学项目还在厨房桌子上。他的心一沉。他已经做了好几个星期了！就在他快要哭出来的时候，他的邻居克拉克先生开车经过。“你看起来很着急！需要搭车吗？”他问。多亏了克拉克先生，汤姆带着他的项目准时到了学校。午休时，他发现一位老妇人在学校外面费力地提着沉重的袋子。尽管他很饿，汤姆还是帮她把袋子搬回了家。他回教室晚了一点，但老师没有责骂他。为什么？那位老妇人是校长的母亲！他知道汤姆为什么迟到。校长在全班面前感谢了他。最大的惊喜在放学后。回家的路上，汤姆在公交车站附近看到一个闪亮的东西——一个钱包！里面有 some money 和一张写有电话号码的借书卡。他立刻打了那个电话。失主是一名大学生，来取走了钱包。为了感谢汤姆，她给了他一张刚买的书店礼品卡。

questions.stem: Why did Mr. Clark give Tom a ride to school?
questions.stemZh: 克拉克先生为什么开车送汤姆去学校？
options: Because Tom was late for school.
Because Mr. Clark was Tom's teacher.
Because Tom's science project was too heavy.
Because Tom looked worried and needed help.
optionsZh: 因为克拉克先生是汤姆的老师。
因为汤姆的科学项目太重了。
因为汤姆看起来很着急，需要帮助。
questions.explanation: 克拉克先生说“You look worried! Need a ride?”，说明他是因为看到汤姆着急才主动帮忙，因此选D。

questions.stem: What can we infer about the owner of the wallet?
questions.stemZh: 关于钱包的主人，我们可以推断出什么？
options: She was a teacher at Tom's school.
She was one of Mr. Clark's students.
She might be a student who liked reading.
She might be too busy to remember her wallet.
optionsZh: 她是汤姆学校的一名老师。
她是克拉克先生的学生之一。
她可能是一个喜欢阅读的学生。
她可能太忙了，忘了钱包。
questions.explanation: 钱包里有一张借书卡，失主是一名大学生，说明她可能喜欢阅读，因此选C。

questions.stem: Which is the correct order of the events according to the text?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，以下事件的正确顺序是什么？
questions.explanation: 事件顺序为：搭克拉克先生的车(a)→帮老妇人搬袋子并被校长感谢(c)→发现钱包(b)→收到大学生的礼品卡(d)，因此选B。

questions.stem: How did Tom's feelings change during the day?
questions.stemZh: 汤姆这一天的感受是如何变化的？
questions.explanation: 汤姆先因忘带项目而worried，得到克拉克帮助后thankful，被校长公开感谢时感到proud，最后觉得这是lucky的一天，因此选A。

text: On Saturday morning, I planned to go to the pool but Mom asked me to watch my five-year-old sister Lyssa and three-year-old brother Dougie because she had an important job interview. "Couldn't Julie watch them instead?" I asked unhappily. "She can't. Please help me today," Mom said. After she left, Lyssa wanted to paint, and Dougie wanted to play with water. Soon the kitchen was a mess. I felt my face turn red with anger. Then I remembered Mom's words: "Stay calm and think." I took a deep breath. I gave Lyssa paper and crayons, and I filled a small basin with water for Dougie. We played together and had lunch. When Mom came back, she smiled and said, "Thank you. You did a great job." I didn't go to the pool, but I learned something more important—patience.
translation: 星期六早上，我本来打算去游泳池，但妈妈让我照看五岁的妹妹莉萨和三岁的弟弟道吉，因为她有一个重要的工作面试。“不能让朱莉照看他们吗？”我不高兴地问。“她不行。今天请帮帮我，”妈妈说。她走后，莉萨想画画，道吉想玩水。很快厨房一团糟。我感到脸气得发红。然后我想起了妈妈的话：“保持冷静，动动脑筋。”我深吸了一口气。我给莉萨纸和蜡笔，给道吉接了一小盆水。我们一起玩，吃了午饭。妈妈回来时，笑着说：“谢谢你。你做得很好。”我没有去成游泳池，但我学到了更重要的东西——耐心。

questions.stem: Why did the writer stay home on Saturday morning?
questions.stemZh: 作者星期六早上为什么留在家里？
options: To help Mom by watching the younger children.
questions.explanation: 短文说“Mom asked me to watch my five-year-old sister Lyssa and three-year-old brother Dougie”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What did the writer do when the kitchen became a mess?
questions.stemZh: 厨房变得一团糟时，作者做了什么？
options: Took a deep breath and stayed calm.
questions.explanation: 短文说“I took a deep breath”，这是她想起妈妈的话“Stay calm and think”后的行动，因此选C。

questions.stem: What lesson did the writer learn from the experience?
questions.stemZh: 作者从这次经历中学到了什么？
options: Swimming is more fun than babysitting.
Patience is more important than going to the pool.
optionsZh: 游泳比照看孩子更有趣。
耐心比去游泳池更重要。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“I learned something more important—patience”，因此选B。

text: On the island of Koh Panyee in Thailand, there is a village built on water. The boys there love football. They run and shout, but these boys are especially good at keeping control of the ball because their football field is a raft (木筏) in the middle of the sea. The story of Panyee FC begins back in 1986. Some of the young boys from the village were watching the World Cup Football Championships on television. They dreamed of playing football like the stars they saw. So they used old fishing boats and pieces of wood to make a floating football field. They practised for hours every day, even when the weather was bad. That first year, they made it to the semi-finals of the local football competition. Since 2004, the Panyee Football Club has won the Thai Youth Football Championships seven times. The boys of Koh Panyee show us that where you start does not decide how far you can go.
translation: 在泰国Koh Panyee岛上，有一个建在水上的村庄。那里的男孩们热爱足球。他们奔跑呼喊，但这些男孩特别擅长控球，因为他们的足球场是海中央的一块木筏。Panyee足球俱乐部的故事始于1986年。村里一些小男孩在电视上观看世界杯足球锦标赛。他们梦想像看到的球星一样踢球。于是他们用旧渔船和木板做了一个漂浮的足球场。他们每天练习几个小时，即使天气恶劣也坚持。第一年，他们就打进了当地足球比赛的半决赛。自2004年以来，Panyee足球俱乐部已经七次赢得泰国青年足球锦标赛冠军。Koh Panyee的男孩们告诉我们：起点并不能决定你能走多远。

questions.stem: What is special about the boys' football field?
questions.stemZh: 男孩们的足球场有什么特别之处？
options: It is a raft in the middle of the sea.
optionsZh: 它是海中央的一块木筏。
questions.explanation: 短文说“their football field is a raft in the middle of the sea”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What did the boys use to make their floating football field?
questions.stemZh: 男孩们用什么来建造他们的浮动足球场？
options: Old fishing boats and pieces of wood.
questions.explanation: 短文说“they used old fishing boats and pieces of wood”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What can we learn from the story of Panyee FC?
questions.stemZh: 从Panyee FC的故事中我们可以学到什么？
options: Only rich people can play football well.
Where you start does not decide how far you can go.
You should always watch the World Cup on TV.
Football is dangerous on the sea.
optionsZh: 只有富人才能踢好足球。
起点不能决定你能走多远。
你应该总是在电视上看世界杯。
questions.explanation: 短文最后一句点明主旨“where you start does not decide how far you can go”，因此选B。

text: Drones (无人机) are used in many fields today. In agriculture, farmers use drones to spray (喷洒) crops and check the health of their fields. In cities, drones help deliver packages and take photos for maps. During emergencies, drones can find missing people in mountains or forests. They can also carry medicine to places that are hard to reach. Drones are fast and can reach places that people cannot easily get to. However, drones also bring problems. They can be noisy, and some people worry about privacy because drones can take pictures from the sky. Laws are being made to control how and where drones can fly. If we use them wisely, drones can make our lives better and help protect the environment.
translation: 如今无人机被用于许多领域。在农业中，农民用无人机喷洒庄稼、检查田地的健康状况。在城市里，无人机帮助递送包裹、拍摄地图照片。在紧急情况下，无人机可以在山区或森林中找到失踪的人。它们还可以把药品送到难以到达的地方。无人机速度快，能到达人们不容易去的地方。然而，无人机也带来问题。它们可能很吵，有些人担心隐私，因为无人机可以从空中拍照。正在制定法律来控制无人机的飞行方式和地点。如果我们明智地使用它们，无人机可以让我们的生活更美好，也有助于保护环境。

questions.stem: How do farmers use drones according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，农民如何使用无人机？
options: To spray crops and check fields.
questions.explanation: 短文说“farmers use drones to spray crops and check the health of their fields”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why are some people worried about drones?
questions.stemZh: 为什么有些人担心无人机？
options: Drones can be noisy and take pictures from the sky.
optionsZh: 无人机可能很吵，还能从空中拍照。
无人机不能在山区飞行。
questions.explanation: 短文说“They can be noisy, and some people worry about privacy because drones can take pictures from the sky”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is the writer's attitude towards drones?
questions.stemZh: 作者对无人机的态度是什么？
options: Drones can be helpful if used wisely.
Drones are only useful in cities.
optionsZh: 应该完全停止使用无人机。
如果明智使用，无人机会有帮助。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“If we use them wisely, drones can make our lives better and help protect the environment”，因此选C。

text: Coconuts are one of the most useful plants in the world. People use every part of the coconut tree. The water inside a coconut is a natural drink full of vitamins. The white meat can be eaten fresh or made into oil. The shell can be used as a bowl or turned into charcoal (木炭). The leaves can be used to make roofs and baskets. Coconut trees also help the environment. Their roots hold the soil and stop it from washing away. In some countries, coconut shells are burned to make electricity. Scientists are also studying how coconut waste can be used to make plastic substitutes. The coconut truly is a tree of life.
translation: 椰子是世界上最有用的植物之一。人们利用椰子树的每一个部分。椰子里的水是一种富含维生素的天然饮料。白色的椰肉可以鲜食或制成油。椰壳可以用作碗，或制成木炭。叶子可以用来做屋顶和篮子。椰子树也有助于环境。它们的根固定土壤，防止土壤流失。在一些国家，椰壳被燃烧用来发电。科学家们还在研究如何利用椰子废料制造塑料替代品。椰子真是一棵生命之树。

questions.stem: What can the water inside a coconut be used as?
questions.stemZh: 椰子里的水可以用作什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“The water inside a coconut is a natural drink”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How do coconut trees help the environment?
questions.stemZh: 椰子树如何帮助环境？
options: Their roots hold the soil and stop it from washing away.
They clean the air in cities.
optionsZh: 它们的根固定土壤，防止土壤流失。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Their roots hold the soil and stop it from washing away”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why does the writer call the coconut "a tree of life"?
questions.stemZh: 作者为什么把椰子称为“生命之树”？
options: Because it lives longer than other trees.
Because every part of it can be used in useful ways.
Because it only grows near the sea.
Because it produces the most oxygen.
optionsZh: 因为它比其他树活得久。
因为它的每个部分都能被有效利用。
因为它产生的氧气最多。
questions.explanation: 短文从椰汁、椰肉、椰壳、叶子、根等方面说明椰子树的多种用途，最后总结“The coconut truly is a tree of life”，因此选B。

text: Longtaitou, or the Dragon-Heads-up Festival, falls on the second day of the second lunar month. It marks the start of spring and farming. According to an old story, the dragon wakes up from its winter sleep on this day and raises its head, bringing rain for the crops. On this day, people in many parts of China have their hair cut. It is believed that having a haircut on Longtaitou brings good luck. People also eat special foods. Noodles are called "dragon's beard," dumplings are called "dragon's ears," and spring rolls are called "dragon's scales." These names show people's respect for the dragon and their hope for a good harvest. Longtaitou reminds us that Chinese culture is closely connected to nature and farming.
translation: 龙抬头，又称龙头节，在农历二月初二。它标志着春天和农耕的开始。根据一个古老的故事，龙在这一天从冬眠中醒来，抬起头，为庄稼带来雨水。在这一天，中国许多地方的人会理发。人们相信在龙抬头理发能带来好运。人们还会吃特殊的食物。面条被称为“龙须”，饺子被称为“龙耳”，春卷被称为“龙鳞”。这些名称显示了人们对龙的尊敬和对丰收的期盼。龙抬头提醒我们，中国文化与自然和农耕紧密相连。

questions.stem: When is Longtaitou?
questions.stemZh: 龙抬头是什么时候？
options: On the first day of the first lunar month.
On the second day of the second lunar month.
On the 15th day of the eighth lunar month.
On the fifth day of the fifth lunar month.
questions.explanation: 短文说“falls on the second day of the second lunar month”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Why do people have their hair cut on Longtaitou?
questions.stemZh: 人们为什么在龙抬头理发？
options: Because they believe it brings good luck.
Because the dragon asks them to.
Because it is a farming rule.
optionsZh: 因为他们相信这会带来好运。
因为龙要求他们这样做。
因为这是一条农耕规则。
questions.explanation: 短文说“It is believed that having a haircut on Longtaitou brings good luck”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the name "dragon's beard" refer to?
questions.stemZh: “龙须”指的是什么食物？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Noodles are called 'dragon's beard'”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What does Longtaitou remind us of?
questions.stemZh: 龙抬头提醒我们什么？
options: The connection between Chinese culture and nature and farming.
The story of a dragon in winter.
The best time to cut hair.
optionsZh: 中国文化与自然和农耕的联系。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“Longtaitou reminds us that Chinese culture is closely connected to nature and farming”，因此选B。

text: When I was in primary school, I had trouble with spelling. One day, my teacher gave us ten words to learn. I studied hard with my mother and felt confident. But when the test came, I wrote "carpet" correctly, then "neighbor" without the "h," and "rhythm" with only an "r." By the time I got to "suburban," my confidence was gone. I got a D minus. For years, I thought I was stupid. Then, in middle school, a teacher told me I had dyslexia (阅读障碍). She said my brain works differently, and that many creative people have it. I started to understand myself better. I learned to use tools and strategies to help me read and write. Now I am successful in my job, and I tell young people who struggle with learning that being different is not being wrong.
translation: 小学时，我在拼写方面有困难。有一天，老师给了我们十个单词要学。我和妈妈一起努力复习，感到很自信。但考试时，我正确地写出了“carpet”，然后写“neighbor”时漏了“h”，写“rhythm”时只写了一个“r”。写到“suburban”时，我的信心已经没了。我得了D减。多年来，我以为自己很笨。后来，在中学，一位老师告诉我我有阅读障碍。她说我的大脑运作方式不同，许多有创造力的人都有这种情况。我开始更好地理解自己。我学会了使用工具和策略来帮助我阅读和写作。现在我在工作中很成功，我告诉那些在学习上挣扎的年轻人：与众不同并不等于错误。

questions.stem: What was the writer's problem in primary school?
questions.stemZh: 作者小学时的问题是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“I had trouble with spelling”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How did the writer feel after getting a D minus?
questions.stemZh: 得了D减之后，作者感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文说“my confidence was gone”和“I thought I was stupid”，说明作者感到沮丧，因此选C。

questions.stem: What helped the writer change his/her understanding of himself/herself?
questions.stemZh: 什么帮助作者改变了对自己的认识？
questions.explanation: 短文说“a teacher told me I had dyslexia... I started to understand myself better”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What message does the writer want to give to young people?
questions.stemZh: 作者想给年轻人传递什么信息？
options: Everyone should be good at spelling.
Being different is not being wrong.
You should never ask for help.
optionsZh: 每个人都应该擅长拼写。
与众不同并不等于错误。
你永远不应该寻求帮助。
学习困难会随着年龄消失。
questions.explanation: 短文最后说“I tell young people who struggle with learning that being different is not being wrong”，因此选B。

text: Every year, the world wastes about 930 million tons of food. At the same time, more than 820 million people do not have enough to eat. XYZ Food Bank is working to fix this problem. You can help too! Just drop off some food so that we can continue to feed people in need. We accept: canned food, biscuits, rice, boxed juice, noodles and candy. Please do not bring opened food, expired (过期的) food, or food that needs to be kept in a fridge. Every little bit makes a difference. Come and offer your help! Email us at stophunger@syzfoodbank.com.
translation: 每年，全世界浪费约9.3亿吨食物。与此同时，超过8.2亿人没有足够的食物。XYZ食物银行正在努力解决这个问题。你也可以帮忙！只需送来一些食物，让我们能继续帮助有需要的人。我们接受：罐头食品、饼干、大米、盒装果汁、面条和糖果。请不要带已开封的食品、过期食品或需要冷藏的食品。每一点都有帮助。来提供你的帮助吧！发邮件至stophunger@syzfoodbank.com。

questions.stem: How many people suffered from hunger last year according to the text?
questions.stemZh: 根据文字，去年有多少人遭受饥饿？
questions.explanation: 文字说“more than 820 million people suffered from hunger”，因此选A。

questions.stem: Which of the following can you drop off at XYZ Food Bank?
questions.stemZh: 以下哪一项可以送到XYZ食物银行？
questions.explanation: 文字在“We accept”中列出了“canned food”，并明确排除已开封、过期和需冷藏的食品，因此选C。

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the text?
questions.stemZh: 这段文字的目的是什么？
options: To ask people to give away food.
To tell people to protect the earth.
questions.explanation: 文字在说明饥饿和浪费问题后说“You can help too! Just drop off some food”，目的是呼吁人们捐赠食物，因此选C。

text: The 2025 CCTV Spring Festival Gala featured a special performance that combined traditional yangge dance with modern robot technology. Sixteen humanoid robots named Unitree H1 teamed up with sixteen dancers from the Xinjiang Art Institute. They performed traditional yangge dance steps, such as scarf-throwing, in perfect timing with their human partners. The performance showed that innovation does not replace traditions, but helps them develop. Many people watched the show online and shared their excitement. One viewer wrote, "It was amazing to see old and new come together." The show became one of the most talked-about moments of the gala.
translation: 2025年央视春节联欢晚会呈现了一个特别的节目，将传统秧歌与现代机器人技术相结合。十六台名为Unitree H1的人形机器人与新疆艺术学院的十六名舞者合作。他们与人类搭档完美配合，表演了传统秧歌舞步，如抛手绢。这个表演表明，创新不会取代传统，而是帮助传统发展。许多人在网上观看了这个节目并分享了他们的兴奋。一位观众写道：“看到新旧融合，真是太棒了。”这个节目成为春晚最受关注的话题之一。

questions.stem: How many robots performed in the show?
questions.stemZh: 有多少台机器人参加了表演？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Sixteen humanoid robots named Unitree H1”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What traditional dance step did the robots perform?
questions.stemZh: 机器人表演了什么传统秧歌动作？
questions.explanation: 短文说“such as scarf-throwing”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the performance show according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，这个表演表明了什么？
options: Traditional dance is out of date.
The gala only welcomes young people.
optionsZh: 机器人将取代人类舞者。
questions.explanation: 短文说“innovation does not replace traditions, but helps them develop”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Where is this passage most likely from?
questions.stemZh: 这段文字最可能来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文报道了2025年春晚的一个节目及其反响，具有新闻报道的特征，因此选B。

text: Grace and her younger brother Harry live in England. One summer day, they wrote short messages, put them into glass bottles and threw the bottles into the sea. They hoped they might someday hear back from the people who found the bottles. Just six months later, their mum got an unexpected online message. A man from Denmark had found Harry's bottle. He wrote back to say hello. About a year after that, Grace received a reply too—from a girl in Sweden. The two families now keep in touch. Grace says, "We never thought throwing a bottle into the sea would bring us friends in other countries. Small actions can lead to big surprises."
translation: 格蕾丝和弟弟哈里住在英国。一个夏日，他们写了一些简短的信息，放进玻璃瓶，然后把瓶子扔进海里。他们希望有一天能收到发现瓶子的人的回复。仅仅六个月后，他们的妈妈收到了一条意外的网上信息。一位丹麦男子发现了哈里的瓶子。他回信问好。大约一年后，格蕾丝也收到了一封回信——来自瑞典的一个女孩。两家人现在保持着联系。格蕾丝说：“我们从没想过把瓶子扔进海里会给我们带来其他国家的朋友。小小的举动可以带来大大的惊喜。”

questions.stem: Why did Grace and Harry throw bottles into the sea?
questions.stemZh: 格蕾丝和哈里为什么把瓶子扔进海里？
options: To hope for replies from finders.
optionsZh: 希望收到发现者的回复。
questions.explanation: 短文说“They hoped they might someday hear back from the people who found the bottles”，因此选B。

questions.stem: Who found Harry's bottle?
questions.stemZh: 谁发现了哈里的瓶子？
questions.explanation: 短文说“A man from Denmark had found Harry's bottle”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the story mainly tell us?
questions.stemZh: 这个故事主要告诉我们什么？
options: Bottles are bad for the sea.
Small actions can bring unexpected surprises.
Children should not go to the sea alone.
optionsZh: 小小的举动可以带来意想不到的惊喜。
孩子们不应该独自去海边。
questions.explanation: 短文最后引用格蕾丝的话“Small actions can lead to big surprises”，点明主旨，因此选B。

text: The Maori people are the first people of New Zealand. They came to New Zealand from Polynesia more than 700 years ago. Maori culture is rich and special. The haka is a traditional Maori dance. It is often performed by a group, with strong movements and loud shouts. The haka is not only a war dance; it is also used to welcome important guests and to celebrate success. The marae is the center of Maori community life. It is a place for meetings, ceremonies and storytelling. Today, Maori culture is an important part of New Zealand's national identity. Many schools teach the Maori language, and Maori art and music are popular around the world.
translation: 毛利人是新西兰的第一批居民。700多年前，他们从波利尼西亚来到新西兰。毛利文化丰富而独特。哈卡是毛利人的传统舞蹈。它通常由一群人表演，动作有力，喊声洪亮。哈卡不仅是战舞，也用于欢迎贵宾和庆祝成功。会堂是毛利社区生活的中心。它是开会、举行仪式和讲故事的场所。今天，毛利文化是新西兰民族认同的重要组成部分。许多学校教授毛利语，毛利艺术和音乐在世界各地都很受欢迎。

questions.stem: Where did the Maori people come from?
questions.stemZh: 毛利人来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They came to New Zealand from Polynesia”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is the haka used for besides being a war dance?
questions.stemZh: 除了作为战舞，哈卡还用于什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“it is also used to welcome important guests and to celebrate success”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What is the marae?
questions.stemZh: 会堂是什么？
options: The center of Maori community life.
questions.explanation: 短文说“The marae is the center of Maori community life”，因此选C。

text:
NOTICE
The school library will hold a "Read and Share" week from May 12th to May 16th. During the week, students can borrow up to five books at a time. On Wednesday afternoon, there will be a story-telling activity in Room 302. On Friday, students can exchange books with each other in the reading room. Please bring your library card. For more information, ask Ms. Wang at the library desk.
translation:
通知
学校图书馆将于5月12日至5月16日举办“阅读与分享”周。活动期间，学生一次最多可借五本书。周三下午将在302室举行讲故事活动。周五，学生可以在阅览室互相交换书籍。请带上借书卡。了解更多信息，请到图书馆服务台询问王老师。

questions.stem: How many books can students borrow at a time during the week?
questions.stemZh: 活动期间学生一次最多可以借几本书？
questions.explanation: 通知说“students can borrow up to five books at a time”，因此选C。

questions.stem: What can students do on Friday?
questions.stemZh: 学生星期五可以做什么？
questions.explanation: 通知说“On Friday, students can exchange books with each other”，因此选B。

text: Exercise is good for both body and mind. When you exercise, your body produces endorphins (内啡肽). These are natural chemicals that make you feel happy and relaxed. Exercise also helps you sleep better and concentrate on your schoolwork. You don't need to run a marathon. Even a 20-minute walk or a short bike ride can help. Try to find an activity you enjoy, and do it with a friend. You will feel the difference.
translation: 运动对身心都有好处。当你运动时，身体会产生内啡肽。这些是让你感到快乐和放松的天然化学物质。运动还帮助你睡得更好，更能集中精力学习。你不需要跑马拉松。即使20分钟的散步或短途骑车也有帮助。试着找一项你喜欢的活动，和朋友一起做。你会感受到不同。

questions.stem: What are endorphins?
questions.stemZh: 内啡肽是什么？
options: Natural chemicals that make you feel happy.
optionsZh: 让你感到快乐的天然化学物质。
questions.explanation: 短文说“These are natural chemicals that make you feel happy and relaxed”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer suggest doing?
questions.stemZh: 作者建议做什么？
options: Finding an activity you enjoy and doing it with a friend.
optionsZh: 找一项你喜欢的活动，和朋友一起做。
questions.explanation: 短文说“Try to find an activity you enjoy, and do it with a friend”，因此选B。

text: Last Sunday, my classmates and I went to a farm for a school trip. We helped the farmer feed the chickens and pick tomatoes. We also learned how to make cheese. At noon, we had a picnic under a big tree. In the afternoon, we played games and took photos. We went back to school at four. We were tired but very happy. It was a day to remember.
translation: 上周日，我和同学们去农场进行学校旅行。我们帮农民喂鸡、摘西红柿。我们还学习了如何制作奶酪。中午，我们在一棵大树下野餐。下午，我们玩游戏、拍照。我们四点回到学校。我们很累但非常开心。这是值得记住的一天。

questions.stem: What did the students help the farmer do?
questions.stemZh: 学生们帮农民做了什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We helped the farmer feed the chickens and pick tomatoes”，因此选A。

questions.stem: How did the students feel at the end of the day?
questions.stemZh: 一天结束时学生们感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We were tired but very happy”，因此选B。

text: Our school has some new rules. Students must wear school uniforms from Monday to Friday. They must arrive at school before 7:50 a.m. In the classroom, they must keep quiet and listen to the teacher. They must not use phones during lessons. After school, they must not run in the hallways. These rules help students learn better and stay safe.
translation: 我们学校有一些新规定。周一到周五学生必须穿校服。他们必须在早上7:50之前到校。在教室里，他们必须保持安静，听老师讲课。上课期间不能使用手机。放学后，不能在走廊里奔跑。这些规定帮助学生更好地学习并保持安全。

questions.stem: When must students arrive at school?
questions.stemZh: 学生必须什么时候到校？
questions.explanation: 短文说“arrive at school before 7:50 a.m.”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What must students NOT do during lessons?
questions.stemZh: 上课期间学生不能做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“They must not use phones during lessons”，因此选C。

text: Healthy eating is important for students. A good lunch should have rice or noodles, some meat or fish, and a lot of vegetables. Fruit is a good choice for a snack. Try not to drink too many sweet drinks. Water is the best. Eating well gives you energy and helps you think clearly in class.
translation: 健康饮食对学生很重要。一顿好的午餐应该有米饭或面条、一些肉或鱼，以及大量蔬菜。水果是零食的好选择。尽量不要喝太多甜饮料。水是最好的。吃得好给你能量，帮助你在课堂上思路清晰。

questions.stem: What should a good lunch have?
questions.stemZh: 一顿好的午餐应该有什么？
options: Rice or noodles, meat or fish, and vegetables.
optionsZh: 米饭或面条、肉或鱼、蔬菜。
questions.explanation: 短文说“A good lunch should have rice or noodles, some meat or fish, and a lot of vegetables”，因此选B。

questions.stem: What is the best drink according to the passage?
questions.stemZh: 根据短文，最好的饮料是什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Water is the best”，因此选C。

text: A community library is a good place for people of all ages. You can borrow books, magazines and DVDs there. The library also has free Wi-Fi and computers. Children can join story time on Saturday mornings. Adults can take free classes, such as computer classes and English classes. The library is open from 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. every day except Monday.
translation: 社区图书馆是适合所有年龄段的人的好地方。你可以在那里借书、杂志和DVD。图书馆还有免费Wi-Fi和电脑。孩子们可以参加周六上午的故事时间。成年人可以参加免费课程，如电脑课和英语课。图书馆除周一外每天上午9点到晚上8点开放。

questions.stem: What can children do at the library on Saturday mornings?
questions.stemZh: 孩子们星期六上午可以在图书馆做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文说“Children can join story time on Saturday mornings”，因此选B。

questions.stem: When is the library closed?
questions.stemZh: 图书馆什么时候关闭？
questions.explanation: 短文说“open from 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. every day except Monday”，因此选A。
